UseContext.SourceString: 猎人等级经验，用于提升猎人等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to increase hunter level.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色等级经验，用于角色提高等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to increase character level.

UseContext.SourceString: 收集足够的谕石，可前往魔女之家兑换对应的奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Collect enough Oracle Stones, then visit the Witch's House to claim rewards.

Description.SourceString: 不知前路、难以落地的盲目乌鸦衔着的宝石，无人知晓它们来自何方。有传言说捡到「谕石」的人会被厄运缠身，倘若不小心捡到也不用在意，位于各地的魔女之家中的「魔女」小姐能够消弭这份厄运。
Description.LocalizedString:
Gems, carried by blind, lost ravens that are unable to land, their origins unknown to all.
Rumors say that those who pick up Oracle Stones will be struck by misfortune… Though, don't worry if you happen to find one; the mysterious lady from the Witch's House can dispel your misfortune.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后解锁「环期赏令-精锐猎人补给」
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Circle Bounty: Elite Hunter Supplies

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后解锁「环期赏令-荣誉猎人补给」
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Circle Bounty: Honor Hunter Supplies

ItemName.SourceString: 晋升「环期赏令-荣誉猎人补给」
ItemName.LocalizedString: Upgrade to Circle Bounty: Honor Hunter Supplies

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后从「环期赏令-精锐猎人补给」晋升为「环期赏令-荣誉猎人补给」，若未激活「环期赏令-精锐猎人补给」则无法使用
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to upgrade from Circle Bounty: Elite Hunter Supplies to Circle Bounty: Honor Hunter Supplies. Cannot be used if Circle Bounty: Elite Hunter Supplies has not been activated.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后解锁「异晶开采凭证」
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Riftcrystal Mining Permit

UseContext.SourceString: 可以提供1000点的角色经验，用于角色提高等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Provides 1,000 points of character EXP, used to increase character level.

Description.SourceString:
「新生代猎人的个人见解，晋升攻略先行放送！」
——这是一份「呗果」上获得999+「芝麻」的猎人攻略，曾有刚领到猎人证的新手尝试验证其成效，最后只留下了一句评论：小……心……异……象！
Description.LocalizedString:
"Notes from a Rising Hunter: Your Guide to Promotion!"
—This is a hunter's guide that garnered 999+ Sesame ratings on Bagel. A rookie who had just received their hunter's license tried to put the book into practice, leaving only one comment: Be… ware… of… Anomalies!

UseContext.SourceString: 可以提供5000点的角色经验，用于角色提高等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Provides 5,000 points of character EXP, used to increase character level.

Description.SourceString:
「天选猎人才知道的行业秘则！异象、测验与记事本。」
——这是一份「呗果」上收藏10000+的猎人攻略，没有认真的猎人，没有准备好的弧盘，没有帅气的异能，只剩下「在都市接连收服高级异象小弟」的轻小说日常，收藏量很高大概是因为猎人们都想被幸运眷顾吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
"How I Became The Chosen Hunter - Anomalies, Tests, And Notes"
—This is a hunter's guide with over 10,000 bookmarks on Bagel. No serious hunters, no powerful arcs, no flashy Espers, just a slice-of-life light novel about taming high threat Anomalies into minions around the city. The high bookmark count is probably because hunters wish to be blessed by such luck.

UseContext.SourceString: 可以提供20000点的角色经验，用于角色提高等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Provides 20,000 points of character EXP, used to increase character level.

Description.SourceString:
《从Ⅰ到VIII，特级猎人的异象目录，也要一网打尽！》
——这是一份「呗果」上「开心果」投喂999999+的猎人攻略，但记录的特殊异象从未有人见过，直到某天某个匿名用户上传了一张表意不明的画作图片，画内模糊的身影、令人费解的场景好像在极力从侧面印证着什么……
Description.LocalizedString:
"From I to VIII: The Ultimate Hunter's Anomaly Catalog!"
—No one had ever seen the special Anomalies it documented until one day, when an anonymous user uploaded a cryptic image. Its blurry figures and puzzling scenes seemed to obliquely validate something…

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后提升空幕「驱动」或「卡带」1000点经验值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants 1,000 EXP to a Module or a Cartridge.

Description.SourceString: 「带上我？也行吧，反正本屑不差这点屑。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Take me along? Sure, why not—it's not like I have anything better to do."

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后提升空幕「驱动」或「卡带」5000点经验值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants 5,000 EXP to a Module or a Cartridge.

Description.SourceString: 「啧，太勉强了吧。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Tsk, that's pushing it."

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后提升空幕「驱动」或「卡带」20000点经验值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants 20,000 EXP to a Module or a Cartridge.

Description.SourceString: 「屑之上，我即井主。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Above all trash, I am the lord of this manhole."

UseContext.SourceString: 完成「零度同行」活动任务获得，可用于提升同行等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained by completing the Zero's Companion event quests. Used to increase the Companion Level.

Description.SourceString: 一起加油吧！伙伴！
Description.LocalizedString: Let's give it our all, partner!

UseContext.SourceString: 养成消耗的基础货币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Basic currency for character and item upgrades.

Description.SourceString: 一种弱小到处在食物链底端的生物类异象，形似一只小小的甲壳虫，为求生存会在城市中拟态成硬币外观与碰撞声响等待被人捡起，在流通中寻找更好的生机。
Description.LocalizedString: A Bio Anomaly shaped like a small beetle, which is weak and at the bottom of the food chain. To survive in the city, it transforms into a coin upon the sound of collision, lying in wait to be picked up and thereby stands a better chance of survival through circulation.

UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 质地细腻的豆制品，只有技艺高超的老师傅才能抓住最好的时机，将其凝固成最完美的样子。
Description.LocalizedString: A delicately-textured soy product. Only highly skilled masters can seize the best timing to solidify it into the most perfect shape.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 纤维细软，富含脂肪的肉类食材，拥有多种烹制方式，与其生前相比，广受欢迎。
Description.LocalizedString: A fine-fibered, fat-rich meat. Can be cooked in various ways. Widely popular compared to when it was alive.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 纹理清晰，口感丰富的肉类食材，营养价值和轻食价格成正比。所以，牵着一头牛去健身房门口的话……价格能再涨涨吗？
Description.LocalizedString: A meat with a clear texture, multi-layered taste, and nutritional value that well exceeds its cheap price. Perhaps the price would go up a bit more if the cows went to the gym…?

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 白里透红，光滑Q弹的肉类食材，可以提供优质的蛋白质和热量，减肥好选择……炸鸡不算。
Description.LocalizedString: Glowing, smooth, and springy meat. Provides high-quality protein and calories, making it a good choice for those on a diet. Just don't go and fry it!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 光滑的禽类的卵，上面粘着一点泥土，一点草屑，或许还带着生命还未真正开始时就酝酿起的温度。
Description.LocalizedString: Freshly laid poultry eggs, with traces of mud and grass still clinging to them. They might even still hold a hint of warmth!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 经过特殊处理的肉制品，肉糜灌入肠衣之后，经风干处理，极易保存携带，异象猎人的随身不二之选。
Description.LocalizedString: A specially-processed meat product where minced meat is stuffed into casings and dried for easy storage and transportation. A favorite for Anomaly Hunters!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 经过熏制的肉制品，精选后腿肉，锁住丰润的油脂，就算是再干巴的面包，加上一片都能令人口齿生香。
Description.LocalizedString: A smoked meat product with carefully selected hind leg meat that retains the rich fat. Even the driest bread becomes a delicacy if you add a slice of this.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 爽脆甘甜的根茎蔬菜，据说狼外婆就是用它做成美丽的蛋糕敲开了小兔子的门，胡萝卜们暂未表明会对这一邪恶行为负责。
Description.LocalizedString: A crispy, sweet root vegetable. They say that the Big Bad Wolf used it to bake a beautiful cake as a trap for those poor bunnies. The carrots refuse to take responsibility for this despicable act.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 带有辛辣气味的植物，吃起来跟闻起来的味道简直一模一样。据说除了增加食欲外，还能祛湿止痛？
Description.LocalizedString: A plant that smells spicy and tastes exactly as it smells. Besides increasing one's appetite, it also removes excess dampness from your system and relieves pain.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 香味独特的菌类，其貌不扬但极具营养价值。特别警告，请勿抢夺并食用蕈童的蘑菇伞。
Description.LocalizedString: A fungus with a unique aroma, unremarkable in appearance but highly nutritious. Warning: some fungi may be poisonous!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 酸甜多汁的植物果实，究竟是蔬菜还是水果的争论一直居高不下，或许税法已经给出了答案。
Description.LocalizedString: A juicy, sour-but-sweet plant. The debate on whether it's a vegetable or a fruit is still ongoing. We may have to refer to the tax laws for the answer…

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 一层又一层的植物，如果你愿意一层一层地剥开它的心，你就会发现你一层又一层地剥开了它……用这个表白会成功吗？
Description.LocalizedString: A plant that has countless layers. "I'd peel off your layers one by one, just so I can reach your heart hidden inside"… How does that pickup line sound?

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 一层又一层的植物，如果你愿意一层一层地剥开它的心，你就会发现，它会攻击所有试图剥开它的人。
Description.LocalizedString: A plant that has countless layers. Try peeling the layers off and it will retaliate by making you cry…

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 结实的植物，价格低廉，便于种植，更重要的是不管怎么烹饪都很好吃，对于厨房新手来说是非常友好的食材呢。
Description.LocalizedString: A sturdy plant that's cheap, easy to grow and, most importantly, delicious no matter how you cook it. A truly friendly ingredient for kitchen novices!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 爽脆清甜的植物果实，平平无奇的外观，平平无奇的味道，有些无趣，却也怀念。
Description.LocalizedString: A crispy, sweet fruit with an ordinary appearance and taste. It may be somewhat boring, but it's also nostalgia-inducing.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 甜美可口的植物果实，没有外皮，也没有核，稍加清洗就可以一整个完整的放进嘴里，完美的植物，像童年。
Description.LocalizedString: A sweet, delicious fruit without skin or a core. Can be eaten whole after just a bit of washing. This epitome of perfection tastes just like childhood!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 酸甜多汁的植物果实，切开的一瞬间，汁水迸发的那一刻，好像看到了夏天。
Description.LocalizedString: A fruit with abundant sour-but-sweet juice that flows out the moment it's cut open. A true summery delight!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 身披鬃毛的植物果实，外壳坚硬，内里却柔软，盛着甘甜的汁水。它一定是经历很多的悲伤的事情，才会把自己武装起来吧呜呜。
Description.LocalizedString: A fruit covered in bristles, hard on the outside but soft inside, containing the sweetest juice. Makes you wonder what it must have been through in its life to have developed such a thick shell… poor thing.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 生活在淡水中的鱼类，肉质鲜美却也暗藏杀机，柔软的小刺躲藏在美味之中，逃过舌头的追捕然后狠狠扎进喉咙，好痛！
Description.LocalizedString: A freshwater fish that is delicious but also surprisingly dangerous due to the tiny, soft bones hiding in the delicate flesh. If you allow them to escape your tongue's pursuit and stab into your throat, it'll be a true nightmare!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 几块切割整齐的海鱼段，肉质紧实而油润，光是拿在手中，就能闻到大洋深处的海风气味
Description.LocalizedString: Several neatly cut sea fish fillets with firm, succulent flesh. When you hold them in your hands, you can faintly smell the ocean breeze from the deep sea.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 饱满丰盈的海鲜食材，褪去外壳后变得Q弹柔软，就算只是简单烹饪都能有无法替代的鲜美滋味。
Description.LocalizedString: A plump, rich ingredient from the seas. Becomes springy and soft after its shell is removed. Even the simplest cooking methods can result in an impeccable taste!

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 横行霸道的动物，全身覆盖坚硬的甲壳，不过对于老饕来说，花一点点时间才能享受到美味，也是一种生活情调。
Description.LocalizedString: A sideways-walking crustacean covered in a hard shell. A true gourmet won't mind spending a little time prodding through shells in order to enjoy the delicacy inside. That's what makes life worth living, don't you think?

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 攻击性很高的动物，如果可以的话，请在烹饪时多煮一会，这样味道会更加浓郁……绝对不是为了报复呢。
Description.LocalizedString: A highly aggressive animal. Try to cook it a bit longer for a richer taste—definitely not for revenge or anything.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.SourceString: 好的咖啡豆自然要搭配好的冲调方式，「9℃ COFFEE」手冲咖啡体验课绝赞开课中。
Description.LocalizedString: Good beans require the proper brewing method to bring out their flavor, and there's no place better to learn than 9°C Coffee's hand-drip coffee experience. Classes now open.

UseContext.SourceString: 店铺里常见贩卖的食材，可以在店铺里制作成菜肴出售
UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.LocalizedString: The ultimate question for cooking novices: Is this white stuff sugar or salt? It's sugar.

UseContext.LocalizedString: A common ingredient. Can be made into dishes in your own shop and sold to customers.

Description.LocalizedString: The ultimate question for cooking novices: Is this white stuff sugar or salt? It's salt.

Description.SourceString: 原是一批老旧的盗版游戏卡带，传闻有人在这批卡带中玩到过来自未来的游戏。自此之后这批卡带就变成了游戏爱好者之间的紧俏货，谁不想体验未来的游戏呢?
Description.LocalizedString: These were an old batch of pirated game cartridges. It was rumored that someone had played a game from the future with these cartridges. Since then, these cartridges have become a hot item amongst passionate gamers. Who wouldn't want a try at the games from the future?

UseContext.SourceString: 城市特产，用于对应的角色等级突破

Description.SourceString: 放好曲谱，挺胸、收腹、两脚与肩同宽。你将如同顶级小提琴家一般将这首曲子完美演绎。演奏结束后小提琴会消失，而你将永久学会这首曲子。需要注意的是，切记左手持弓，右手持琴，否则……
Description.LocalizedString: Put the sheet in place and get poised. You will perform this piece as if you were a top violinist. At the end of the performance the violin will disappear and you will have learned the piece forever. Note that you must hold the bow in your left hand and the violin in your right, otherwise…

Description.SourceString: 每次打开时，书皮里包的书都会不同，虽然都是些随处可以买到的书籍，但是对于没有目的性，只是想随意阅读的人来说非常方便。唯一不方便的是，没有读完全书时，记得不要合上。
Description.LocalizedString: Each time you open it, the books wrapped in the cover will be different. Although these books are not hard to come by, they are very convenient for people who just want to read aimlessly and casually. The only inconvenience is remembering not to close the book until you finish it.

Some believe this is just a publicity scam, but some customers have no doubt about it. An oddly dressed woman who wraps herself very tight is a loyal consumer of these blind boxes.

UseContext.LocalizedString: A handwritten recipe from someone in BAC. Unlocks Unmanned Rocket.

Description.SourceString: 「在四下无人的工位上，我内心某种情感正猛烈地翻涌。心脏的位置像长出了无数只胳膊，正因暂停了工作而抓挠着，好难受……我必须得到缓解，我渴望自己变成可嵌入办公网络的模组，身体无时无刻流淌着复杂的信息，输入、处理、输出……」
Description.LocalizedString: In the deserted workspace, something fierce is surging violently within me. It's as if countless arms grow from my heart, scratching and tickling at my insides because I stopped working, driving me to madness… I must find relief, I need to become a mindless module integrated into the office network, my body a nonstop stream of complex numbers and information, simply inputting, processing and outputting…

UseContext.SourceString: 热销断货的情人节甜点特刊，可以解锁菜品「草莓盒子蛋糕」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: The sold-out Valentine's Day dessert special unlocks the recipe for Strawberry Box Cake.

Description.SourceString:
明明是再普通不过的草莓盒子蛋糕，只是点缀了奶油和草莓，便拥有如此高人气……若不是自己亲手烘焙，你都怀疑某个偷心魔女趁你不注意——往原料里混入了几滴魔法药水。
「这，确实不是异象！」在异象管理局里，薄荷吞下了最后一块草莓盒子蛋糕。
这些蛋糕样本是从绘空町的民众家中收集来的，其原型是地方杂志在情人节特刊附赠的特别企划——「草莓盒子蛋糕」配方。在网络上，「草莓盒子蛋糕」以异常的表白成功率引起了异象管理局的关注。
如果不是异象，那「草莓盒子蛋糕」为何总能激发食客的爱意呢？
Description.LocalizedString:
An ordinary molten strawberry cake, adorned with cream and strawberries, has become surprisingly popular! If you hadn't baked it yourself, you'd suspect a witch had slipped a few drops of love potion into the ingredients.
"This is definitely not an Anomaly!" Mint said, scarfing down the last piece at BAC.
These cake samples were collected from Illusion Town residents, based on a recipe featured in a local magazine's Valentine's Day special—Strawberry Box Cake. The cake's online presence caught BAC's attention due to its unusually high success rate in love confessions.
If it's not an Anomaly, why does it always spark love in those who eat it?

Description.SourceString:
被捕捉到的盲眼幻妄。

「淡蓝色塑料壳里有好多声音。
你听。怨灵纠缠，咬牙切齿，喧哗骚动，氤氲起的灯雾又退散开来。
我们披着冷冽，遗世孤立却又为世界撕开不信任的外壳。」

Captured blind delusions.

"So many voices inside the light blue plastic shell.
Listen. Vengeful spirits entangle, gnashing their teeth, clamoring in chaos, as the luminous mist rises then disperses.
We wear frost like a mantle, isolated from the world yet tearing away its distrustful shell."

Description.LocalizedString: Arachne's dress hem spins around the dance floor, round and round, blooming into flowers that never cease.

Description.SourceString: 唯有「舞会皇后」才能佩戴的冠冕，只是——「欲戴其冠，必承其重。」
Description.LocalizedString: A crown that only the "Ball Queen" may wear, but remember—"Heavy is the head that wears the crown."

UseContext.SourceString: 阿拉克涅的舞会完美谢幕后得到的伴手礼，可用于角色异能提升。

Description.LocalizedString: Nobility is merely an entry ticket to this grand celebration, and even a scepter forged of gold is nothing more than a stepping stone for Arachne.

Description.SourceString: 当生命变得可以衡量，它又将价值几何？

Description.SourceString: 干瘪的种子又要如何发芽？

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是羸弱的幼鸟，可怜的孩子，向你献上最真挚的祝福。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you take on the role of a fragile nestling. Poor child, may you receive the most sincere blessings.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是健康的白鸽，快飞吧，趁着翅膀还在。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you embody a healthy white dove. Fly now, while your wings are still strong.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演的结局由你来定，你可以宣布这是平安的一天，或者相反？
Description.LocalizedString: The ending of this performance is yours to decide. Will you declare it an ordinary day, or perhaps the opposite?

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是一个新兵，先从站岗开始吧。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you take on the role of a recruit. Start with sentry duty.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是一名尉官，请遵循士兵守则。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you embody an officer. Please adhere to the code.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是白蔷薇上将，你的职责是消灭花园里的每一朵白蔷薇。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are the General. You will eliminate every white rose in the garden.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的随机身份是一名游客，快来吧，盒子里什么都有。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are assigned the random role of a tourist. Come quickly, the box has everything you need.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的随机身份是一名常来的游客，你已经知道这些空盒子里都是什么了，但还是伸出了手。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are assigned the random role of a frequent visitor. You already know what these empty boxes contain, yet you still reach out your hand.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是藏在游客中的绅士，摘下帽子，鞠躬致意，敬这场美妙的派对。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are assigned the role of a gentleman hidden among tourists. Remove your hat, bow gracefully, and pay respects to this wonderful party.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是参与者，面前这张牌是红心3……很抱歉，你猜错了。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are assigned the role of a participant. The card before you is the 3 of Hearts… Sorry, you guessed wrong.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是参与者，面前这张牌是红心3……恭喜，你猜对了。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are assigned the role of a participant. The card before you is the 3 of Hearts… Congratulations, you guessed correctly.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是庄家，面前那张牌是红心3或者所有牌。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are assigned the role of the dealer. The card before you is either the 3 of Hearts or all cards.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是无辜的观众，是镣铐的提供者，是未来的凶手。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are assigned the role of an innocent spectator, a provider of shackles, and a future murderer.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演你的身份是盲从者，你们一起屏息，试图从无声的水中听到锁舌的声音。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you are assigned the role of a blind follower. Together, you all hold your breath, attempting to hear the sound of a latch from the silent water.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色异能强化材料，用于提升角色的异能等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Esper enhancement material. For Esper Ability progression.

Description.SourceString: 这场表演中你将死去，然后成为第二个你。
Description.LocalizedString: In this performance, you will die and become your second self.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得后自动使用，耐力永久增加10点。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used automatically on acquisition. Permanently increases Stamina by 10.

Description.SourceString: 迈达斯科技公司与食品巨头贝弗瑞集团合作研发的革命性能量棒，提取多种超级食材精华与某种未被公开的异象活性成分，能显著提升异能者的长期体能。
Description.LocalizedString: A revolutionary energy bar developed by Midas Technologies in collaboration with the food giant Beverry Group. It is made by extracting the essence of a variety of super ingredients with a certain undisclosed anomaly active ingredient. Can significantly enhance the long-term physical performance of Espers.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 一件技艺精湛的复刻品，它甚至也会像真的苹果核一样，缓慢腐朽。
Description.LocalizedString: A masterfully crafted replica, which even mimics the slow decay of a real appleseed.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 一件近乎完美的制品，连苹果核上的虫洞都栩栩如生。
Description.LocalizedString: An almost perfect creation, with even the wormholes in the appleseed looking incredibly lifelike.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 一件杰作，现在它金光灿灿，足以引起纷争。
Description.LocalizedString: A true masterpiece, now gleaming with golden brilliance, enough to spark envy and conflict.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 错落无法成节的音符，稚嫩的手落在小木琴上，是对新世界的一次伟大探索。
Description.LocalizedString: Erratic notes from a child's xylophone, marking a great exploration of a new world.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 一小节没有名字的音乐，一如那懵懂的情感，描述不清却足够真挚。
Description.LocalizedString: Unnamed music, like innocent emotions—indescribable but sincere.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 一曲或高昂或平淡的交响乐，现在指挥棒就在手中，挥动，演出开始！
Description.LocalizedString: A dynamic symphony. Wave the baton and let the performance begin!

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 试用装总是比正装好使，这是常识。
Description.LocalizedString: Trial versions always work better than the official release. It's common knowledge.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 至少便于携带是它的优点，记得把包装拆开刮刮干净。
Description.LocalizedString: It's lightweight and easy to carry, which is a plus. Be sure to cut open the packaging and scrape it clean.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 请允许我收回前言，正装——才是最完美的！
Description.LocalizedString: I take back what I said before—the official version is truly perfect!

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 已经有些融化的冰淇淋，吝啬的老板竟然用线头做装饰品。
Description.LocalizedString: A partially melted ice cream with loose thread scraps as decoration—courtesy of a stingy owner.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 经典款香草味冰淇淋，有着几十年如一日的不变口感和线头装饰品。
Description.LocalizedString: A classic vanilla ice cream with a taste that hasn't changed for decades, complete with the signature loose thread scraps decorations.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 私人订制限定款冰淇淋，保留装饰品的同时，似乎添加了一些特殊材料来丰富口感。
Description.LocalizedString: A custom limited-edition ice cream that keeps the signature decorations while apparently adding special ingredients to enhance the flavor.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 这真是一场不能更糟糕的戏剧表演，在妆造劣质的演员开口前，你已经陷入了昏睡。
Description.LocalizedString: This has to be the worst theatrical performance possible—you've fallen asleep before the poorly made-up actors could even speak their first lines.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 在欣赏过众多的戏剧之后，你成为一名合格的戏剧大师，就这样。
Description.LocalizedString: After appreciating countless theatrical performances, you've become a qualified Drama Master. That's it.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘突破材料，可以提升弧盘的突破等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension material. For Arc development.

Description.SourceString: 坐在最佳观影区的你，已经可以优雅地为每一场戏剧鼓掌，哪怕那位演员刚刚忘词。
Description.LocalizedString: Seated in the prime viewing area, you now gracefully applaud every performance—even when an actor has just flubbed their lines.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘升级材料，包含500点弧盘经验，可以用于升级弧盘。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc upgrade material. Grants 500 Arc EXP.

Description.SourceString: 稀释过后的弧盘染剂，可满足弧盘的日常保养需求，极其精妙的水和原料配比，至少比水有用。
Description.LocalizedString: A diluted arc dye for daily maintenance, using a precise ratio of water and ingredients. Works better than just water, at least.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘升级材料，包含2500点弧盘经验，可以用于升级弧盘。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Arc upgrade material. Grants 2,500 Arc EXP.

Description.SourceString: 经典款的弧盘染剂，让您的弧盘焕然一新，畅销多年的秘密在于从不公开畅销的秘密。
Description.LocalizedString: A classic arc dye which revitalizes your arc with its secret formula.

UseContext.SourceString: 弧盘升级材料，包含10000点弧盘经验，可以用于升级弧盘。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An arc upgrade material. Grants 10,000 Arc EXP.

Description.SourceString: 添加了某种特殊物质的弧盘染剂，能快速提升弧盘性能且无副作用，如果价格昂贵不算副作用的话。
Description.LocalizedString: A special arc dye. Enhances arc performance quickly without side effects, except for the high price.

UseContext.SourceString: 维特海默值
UseContext.LocalizedString: Wertheimer Index

Description.SourceString: 维特海默值
Description.LocalizedString: Wertheimer Index

Description.CultureInvariantString: 寿司，汉堡，果汁，看起来很美味

UseContext.LocalizedString: Member of CSU-2

Description.SourceString: 解锁与薄荷的羁遇。
Description.LocalizedString: Unlocks Bond with Mint.

UseContext.SourceString:
可于「标准棋盘」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
「茶子捏造谎言，茶子捏造真相。」
UseContext.LocalizedString:
Can be rolled on the Standard Board for rewards.
"Lies are fabricated. Truths are fabricated."

UseContext.SourceString:
可于「限定棋盘」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
「谎言星罗棋布，见到你就是真实。」
UseContext.LocalizedString:
Can be rolled on the Limited Board for rewards.
"Lies are countless, and you bring truth."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「王牌一代目」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "The Ichi-daime," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「柯林斯家族火热扩招中，现在报名可以免试直升……易聘屋上是这么写的吧？」
Description.LocalizedString: "The Coluccis are doing a major hiring spree—apply now to skip the entire interview process and get hired right off the bat… at least that's what it says on EZ-Hire, right?"

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「独酌胧月流」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "Misty Tipsy Style," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「岁暮醉对雪与月，随性又一年。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Drunk on wine, the moon is high—snow drifts gently, another year gone by."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「久梦初醒时」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "Fading Reverie," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「恰似一枕恬静的梦，一曲悠长的歌。」
Description.LocalizedString: A serene dream upon a quiet pillow, accompanied by a lingering song.

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「无归路」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "Forsaken Path," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「为一片烟尘构筑秩序。」
Description.LocalizedString: Where smoke and dust wander, order is written.

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「破晓前」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "Before the Dawn," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「勿再踟蹰，由此反照的辉光会点亮赤月的暗面。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Hesitate no longer. Let this reflected radiance light the dark side of the Crimson Moon."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「生命线」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "The Lifeline", to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「骰子向前滚落停下，它给出回答。」
Description.LocalizedString: "The dice tumbles forth, comes to rest, and reveals its answer."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「惑心谲影」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board "Alluring Shadows" to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「执迷不醒，甘之如饴。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Hopelessly devoted, and happy to stay that way."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「全频带漫游中！」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board "Surfing All Channels!" to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「因为电波会指引我们相遇，哪怕隔着宇宙、时间和次元。」
Description.LocalizedString: "The signal will bring us together, no matter the distance, the time, or the dimension."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「预言终幕时」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "Foretold Finale," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「或许正是我们无可回避，命运才因此成为命运。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Perhaps fate is simply that which we cannot escape."

UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "Dazzling Star," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「你想要的答案是什么？」
Description.LocalizedString: "What answer do you seek?"

UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "Android Dreams," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「你好，你拨打的用户正在通话中，和你通话哦！~*」
Description.LocalizedString: "Hello! The person you're calling is currently busy… talking to you!~*"

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可在限定棋盘「离线的算式」中进行投掷获得所需物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Only usable on the Limited Board, "Offline Equations," to obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 「少年会成长为怎样的大人，这道题的解——」
Description.LocalizedString: "What kind of adult will the boy become? The answer is—"

UseContext.SourceString: 用于参与弧盘研募计划和兑换弧盘。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used for participating in the Arc Research Program and exchanging for Arcs.

Description.SourceString: 「其一为创造真理，其二为星的轨迹，其三为神的法则。」
Description.LocalizedString:
"The first is the creation of truth, the second is the trajectory of stars, and the
third is the law of gods."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「决意特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Resolve Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「月亮变化无常，可它只是挂在天上。」
Description.LocalizedString: Ever-changing as it is, the moon merely hangs in the sky.

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「启门特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Dreamgate Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「瞧啊，钥匙上写着『安全出口』。」
Description.LocalizedString: Look, the key says "Emergency Exit".

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「摄心特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Spellbound Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「别思考，别停下，别让恐惧追上你。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Drop thinking, keep moving. Don't let fear catch up."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「万籁特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Soundscape Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「宇宙在向我们歌唱。」
Description.LocalizedString: "The universe sings for us."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「猛虎特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Tiger Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「所有事情都可以交给最伟大的一代目。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Leave everything to the one and only Ichi-daime!"

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「名月特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Bright Moon Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「时间是一条盘旋而上的河流。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Time flows like a river, winding ever upward."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「夜曲特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Nocturne Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「如水流淌的歌，蜿蜒走过今夜的长梦。」
Description.LocalizedString: "A song flows like water, winding through the long dream of night."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「追猎特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Pursuit Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「穿破迷雾，前行，追猎，永不止步。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Pierce the mist. Press onward. Give chase. Never yield."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「栖羽特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Roostfeather Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「一滴眼泪落在地上，一只鸟儿将它衔走。」
Description.LocalizedString: "A tear falls to the earth, and a bird carries it away."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「日月星特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Celestial Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「从这里开始，每一步都在走向月的另一面。」
Description.LocalizedString: "From this point on, every step takes you closer to the far side of the moon."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「回音特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Echo Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「向空洞无物之处呼唤那道振翅飞走的美好幻影。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Calling out to a beautiful phantom as it takes flight into the void."

UseContext.SourceString: 仅可参与「密钥特刊」弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can only be used to participate in the Encryption Special Arc Research Program and claim the current program rewards.

Description.SourceString: 「多想重返结局还没有被盖棺论定的存档点。」
Description.LocalizedString: "If only I could return to a save point from before the ending was set in stone."

It loads the condition of the user's Character Pixels based on Character Photo Paper and fixes the sequential imbalance of Character Pixels with the sloshing sound of the specially programmed base solution, thus reducing the Noise in the Character Resolution Map under the Anomaly's influence. Grants 60 Character Pixels.

Description.SourceString:
00149留言——
入场了不要东张西望，这张「假脸」可经不起细看。
虹膜识别后及时取出隐形镜片，不想瞎的话。
通过红外线区要跳的「第十一套广播体操」再复习一次。
止汗剂、止汗剂、止汗剂，这是最重要的。
Description.LocalizedString:
00149 Message—
Upon entry, don't look around. This "fake face" can't go up against close scrutiny.
If you don't want to go blind, remove contact lenses promptly after iris recognition.
Review the "Eleventh Set of Broadcast Gymnastics" in the infrared zone again.
Deodorant, deodorant, deodorant, this is the most important thing.

UseContext.SourceString: 同时激活唱片机、随声听与车载音乐《NightRun》。
UseContext.LocalizedString: "NightRun" is now available on Record Players, Portable Players, and Radios.

Description.SourceString: 金属嵌合的撞击声，带动手腕的吸入感，一次、两次……六次……灯光流动了起来，意识流动了起来，一切流动了起来，他像往常一样逃离了这个夜晚900秒。
Description.LocalizedString: The sound of metal clashing, the sensation of something sucking on his wrist—once, twice… six times… Lights streamed by; his consciousness began to slip; everything began to flow together, and finally, he made his routine escape from the night for 900 seconds.

UseContext.SourceString: 同时激活唱片机、随声听与车载音乐《Elysium》。

Description.SourceString:
《花组画·梦径》，作者：毕其尔·怀特斯，佚名。
怀特斯在日记中多次提到他在游学时结识了一位至交好友，经常相约探讨艺术，甚至一起睡在画室中彻夜创作，《花组画》正是创造于该段时期。或许也是受到了这位友人的影响，该时期怀特斯的画作用色更加浅淡清新，以描绘事物具体形象为主。
《梦径》为这组画的第一张，是由怀特斯根据友人口述的梦中小径景象绘制而成。
Description.LocalizedString:
"Flowers: Dream Path" by Bichir Whites, and an anonymous contributor.
Whites mentioned multiple times in his diary that he met a close friend during his travels, and they would often meet to discuss art. They even slept side-by-side in the studio, painting through the night. The "Flowers" series was created during this period. Perhaps influenced by this friend, Whites' paintings from this time used lighter, fresher colors and focused mainly on depicting the concrete forms of objects.
"Dream Path" is the first painting in this series, created by Whites based on his friend's description of a pathway from a dream.

Description.SourceString:
《花组画·蝶恋花》，作者：毕其尔·怀特斯，佚名。
怀特斯在日记中多次提到他在游学时结识了一位至交好友，经常相约探讨艺术，甚至一起睡在画室中彻夜创作，《花组画》正是创造于该段时期。或许也是受到了这位友人的影响，该时期怀特斯的画作用色更加浅淡清新，以描绘事物具体形象为主。
《蝶恋花》为这组画的第三张，怀特斯在听说了当地一个凄美的爱情故事之后绘制的，另一位则为这篇画作题了一句诗。
「蝶使寻枝初破蕊，半卷胭脂，羞被东风窥。」
Description.LocalizedString:
"Flowers: Butterflies to Flowers" by Bichir Whites, and an anonymous contributor.
Whites mentioned multiple times in his diary that he met a close friend during his travels, and they would often meet to discuss art. They even slept side-by-side in the studio, painting through the night. The "Flowers" series was created during this period. Perhaps influenced by this friend, Whites' paintings from this time used lighter, fresher colors and focused mainly on depicting the concrete forms of objects.
"Butterflies to Flowers" is the third painting in this series, created by Whites after hearing a tragic local love story. The other person wrote a poem for this artwork.
"The butterfly messenger seeks branches where buds first bloom, half-rolled rouge petals, shy of the eastern wind's gaze."

Description.SourceString:
「据说只要在傍晚时分，用这把小提琴演奏，或许能见到未来。」
——上一任买家试过了，是假的。
但这依旧是一把做工精良的小提琴，明明只有四根弦，但从琴弦中流淌出的旋律，却能紧紧抓住听者的心。
「略显平淡的演奏，但若能配上青春的旋律，也会看到充满希望的未来吧。」在这把琴的琴盒中这样写到。
Description.LocalizedString:
"They say if you play this violin at dusk, you might glimpse the future."
The previous owner tried it. It's fake.
Regardless, this is still a finely crafted violin. Despite having only four strings, the melodies that flow from them can captivate any listener's heart.
"The performance may seem plain, but paired with youthful melodies, perhaps you'll see a future full of hope." That's what was written inside this violin's case.

Description.LocalizedString: A soft rug commonly placed in homes. This rug would pair perfectly with any modern, minimalist interior. Timeless and classic.

Description.LocalizedString: A practical doormat for a home's entrance. The contrast of blue and white brings a fresh and youthful vibe to any room.

Description.LocalizedString: A soft rug commonly placed in homes. Its long strands and thick style resemble the mossy underbrush of a forest floor, with a beautiful pink path intersecting in between, and leading off into a dream.

UseContext.SourceString: 可以装饰家里的摆件，增加舒适度和收藏值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A home decor item. Increases Comfort and Collection with each piece.

Description.SourceString: 常在家中放置的实用脚垫。独特的叶片纹理设计，用凹凸表面刮除鞋底泥沙，兼具美感与功能性。
Description.LocalizedString: A practical doormat for a home's entrance. This mat's distinctive leafy pattern and raised texture balance both a cute, earthy style and function.

UseContext.LocalizedString: A home decor item. Increases Comfort and Collection with each piece.

Description.SourceString: 常在家中放置的实用脚垫。穿行于银河边缘时，不小心惊醒了沉睡的星座。既是实用的脚垫，也是地上低调的装饰画。
Description.LocalizedString: A practical doormat for a home's entrance. While drifting listlessly along the edge of the galaxy, this little star awoke as part of a grand constellation. It can also be used as a practical floor mat.

UseContext.SourceString: 丰富你的贴纸样式。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to customize your sticker style.

UseContext.SourceString: 用于更换你的社交头像。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to change your social avatar.

UseContext.SourceString: 用于更换你的头像框。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to change your Frame.

UseContext.SourceString: 用于更换你的战斗头像。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to change your combat avatar.

UseContext.SourceString: 可以用它来模拟你的战斗招式。
UseContext.LocalizedString: You can use this to simulate your combat moves.

Description.SourceString: 早雾「赠送」的装饰品。早雾很高兴地送出了这份独一无二的礼物，总觉得上面还挂着亮晶晶的口水。
Description.LocalizedString: An ornament "gifted" by Sakiri. She happily presented this one-of-a-kind gift, though it seems to still have some glistening drool on it…

UseContext.SourceString: 传闻在湛望角东边的Z42环海公路旁，有人看到过奥布里在那条人行道上散步。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Rumor has it that Aubury was spotted taking a walk along the sidewalk near the Coastal Highway Z42, to the east of Azure Vista.

Description.SourceString:
奥布里特供观光线，仅需「一」袋美味大骨头，即可拥有「三」重奏导游。
「很抱歉，目前仅供未成年乘坐。」
「让让，巨星出街。」
「汪！是榴莲味吗？」
Description.LocalizedString:
Aubury's special sightseeing route. For just "one" Yummers Bone, you get "three" tour guides.
"Sorry, this ride is currently only available to kids."
"Make way, superstar coming through."
"Woof! Is that durian flavor?"

UseContext.SourceString: 爱丽丝烘焙坊打折券，象征了与爱丽丝之间的友谊。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An Alice's Bakery discount coupon that offers discounted prices at any location. A token of friendship with Alice.

Description.SourceString: 爱丽丝赠送的折扣券，持有该券去任意爱丽丝烘焙坊都可以享受八折友情价。爱丽丝很喜欢你，友谊就像魔法一样神奇！
Description.LocalizedString: A discount coupon from Alice that offers 20% off at any Alice's Bakery location. Alice really likes you—friendship truly is magic!

UseContext.SourceString: 招财进宝，摆放在店铺中将增加人流量。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Brings prosperity and good fortune. Place in shops to increase traffic.

Description.SourceString: 以粉爪银行吉祥物为原型设计的异象摆件，有时会带来意想不到的惊喜。前提是——在粉爪银行办张卡。
Description.LocalizedString: An anomaly decoration designed after Pink Paws Bank's mascot, which sometimes brings unexpected surprises. The catch is—you'll need an account at PPB first.

UseContext.SourceString: 「副手」形象的滑翔伞。（功能暂未开放）
UseContext.LocalizedString: A paraglider in the image of the Underboss. (Feature not yet available)

Description.SourceString: 由塔吉多仿照「副手」制作的滑翔伞，拥有外观专利的「柯林斯一代目」表示勉勉强强有点像吧，并慷慨地允许「副手的副手」加入家族。
Description.LocalizedString: A paraglider made by Taygedo in imitation of the Underboss. "The Ichi-daime of the Coluccis" with its patented appearance grudgingly admits there's a slight resemblance, and generously allows the "Underboss-of-the-Underboss" to join the family.

UseContext.SourceString: 塔吉多形象的家具摆件
UseContext.LocalizedString: A decorative furniture piece featuring Taygedo.

Description.SourceString: 可爱的家居摆件，记录了塔吉多这一塔生中最难忘的时刻（目前是这样），和一段失败的奔现。
Description.LocalizedString: An adorable home decoration that captures Taygedo's most unforgettable moment in his life (so far), along with a failed attempt at meeting an online friend in person.

UseContext.SourceString: 薄荷办公室的进入权限。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Access permission for Mint's office.

Description.SourceString:
薄荷赠送的密钥，使用后可以进入薄荷的办公室。
特别备注：请勿帮薄荷收拾办公室。
Description.LocalizedString:
A key given by Mint that grants access to her office.
Note: Do NOT clean my office.

UseContext.SourceString: 伊波恩仓库的备用钥匙，拥有它将解锁伊波恩的仓库。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Spare Key to Eibon's Warehouse. Grants access to Eibon's warehouse.

Description.SourceString: 伊波恩仓库的备用钥匙。塔吉多将信任交给了你，和仓库中的珍宝一起。
Description.LocalizedString: A spare key to Eibon's warehouse. Taygedo has entrusted you with both his trust and the treasures within the warehouse.

UseContext.SourceString: 薄荷睡衣系列服装(服装功能开发中)
UseContext.LocalizedString: Mint Pajama (Outfit function in development)

Description.SourceString:
Q3节日限定衣装，舒适但又不失设计的睡衣款，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「玛丽有只小黑猫，耳朵是母亲的，身体是父亲的，兄弟姐妹是它的四肢，无论玛丽走到哪里，它总是跟着跑。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday exclusive outfit, a comfy yet stylish pajama design perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Mary had a little black cat, that had its mother's ears, its father's body, and its sibling's limbs—wherever Mary went, it would always follow."

UseContext.SourceString: 解锁载具"麦昆"
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks the vehicle "McQueen."

Description.SourceString: 白藏赠送的载具。据说在早晚高峰时候可以获得特殊加成，成为城市车流中的一道红色闪电。
Description.LocalizedString: A vehicle from Baicang. It's said to receive special bonuses during rush hour, becoming a streak of red lightning through the city traffic.

UseContext.SourceString: 早雾睡衣系列服装(服装功能开发中)
UseContext.LocalizedString: Sakiri Pajama (Outfit function in development)

Description.SourceString:
Q3节日限定衣装，舒适但又不失设计的睡衣款，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。。
「女巫有一片南瓜地，里面有会魔法的干干净净的南瓜，和不会魔法的麻麻赖赖的南瓜。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday exclusive outfit, a comfy yet stylish pajama design perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"The witch cared for a pumpkin patch where some pumpkins were clean and magical, while others were messy and ordinary…"

UseContext.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔风格载具涂装。（功能尚未开放）
UseContext.LocalizedString: Daffodill vehicle livery. (Feature not yet available)

Description.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔设计的载具涂装，灵感源自于爱丽丝烘焙坊某一年推出的新甜品。因为其独特的造型和味道，仅售卖了三天便不再售卖。达芙蒂尔倒是很喜欢它的高热量。
Description.LocalizedString: A vehicle Livery designed by Daffodill, inspired by a special dessert once offered at Alice's Bakery. Due to its unique shape and flavor, it was only sold for three days before being discontinued. Daffodill, though, was quite fond of its high caloric content.

UseContext.SourceString: 白鲸书店的会员卡，和埃德嘉一起读书吧。(使用后获取随机猎人攻略。)
UseContext.LocalizedString: Moby-Dick Bookstore membership card. Why not join Edgar for a reading session? (Use to obtain a random Hunter's Guide.)

Description.SourceString: 埃德嘉每周都会去参加白鲸书店的读书会，每周都会有新的收获。
Description.LocalizedString: Edgar attends the Moby-Dick Bookstore's reading club every week, always gaining something new from each session.

UseContext.SourceString: 浔的特殊服装(服装功能开发中)
UseContext.LocalizedString: Hotori Special Outfit (Outfit function in development)

Description.SourceString:
知名独立设计师「無」为浔特别定制的衣装，只有相当隆重的场合浔才会换上这身新衣。
「名月下，幽兰泣无声，烟渺渺。」
Description.LocalizedString:
A special outfit custom-designed for Hotori by the renowned independent designer "Mu"—which Hotori only wears for the most formal occasions.
"Under the bright moon, silent tears of dark orchids fall through the misty haze."

UseContext.SourceString: 娜娜莉睡衣系列服装(服装功能开发中)
UseContext.LocalizedString: Nanally Pajama (Outfit function in development)

Description.SourceString:
Q3节日限定衣装，舒适但又不失设计的睡衣款式，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「从前在森林里有一只孤单的小灰狼，为了交到朋友，它带上了丝绒做的红斗篷。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday exclusive outfit, a comfy yet stylish pajama design perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Once upon a time, there was a lonely little gray wolf in the forest who donned a velvet red cape, hoping to make friends."

UseContext.SourceString: 打开获得一个随机的蓝色品质空幕驱动块。

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants 1 random Purple Cartridge from Diabolos, Crimson: Twin Butterflies, or Devil's Blood: Curse series.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants 1 random Blue Cartridge from Lost Radiance, Fireflies and the Forest, or Street Boxer series.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants 1 random Blue Cartridge from Diabolos, Crimson: Twin Butterflies, or Devil's Blood: Curse series.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants 1 random Blue Cartridge from Speedy Hedgehog, Kingdom's Guard, or Shadow Creed series.

UseContext.SourceString: 可以在「迈达斯弧盘工坊」兑换弧盘。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be exchanged at the Midas Arc Workshop for Arcs.

Description.SourceString: 异象在被泯除后掉落的沙状物质，如果不快速收集的话很快便会消失。尽管拥有完全不合规的异象编号却没有任何有关该物质的记述，亦无法用语言描述它的特征，当人长时间注视该物质时甚至会因为涌入脑中的大量信息而感到眩晕。
Description.LocalizedString: A sand-like substance dropped when Anomalies are nullified, which quickly disappears if not collected promptly. Despite having a completely non-standard Anomaly designation, there are no records about this substance, nor can its properties be described in words. Those who gaze at it for extended periods may experience dizziness due to the flood of information rushing into their minds.

UseContext.SourceString: DSD潮玩店的vip卡，购物可以获得DSD潮玩店积分。
UseContext.LocalizedString: With this card, you can accumulate VIP Points while shopping at DSD POP.

UseContext.SourceString: 日蚀说，要有双休。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Eclipse said: let there be weekends.

Description.SourceString:
日蚀说，要有双休。
于是就有了双休（日蚀专属版）。
Description.LocalizedString:
Eclipse said, "Let there be double days off."
And thus, the double days off came into being (Eclipse Exclusive Edition).

UseContext.SourceString: 「我们！意念！合一！-良心巨汪！」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: "We! Are! One! —Conscientious Giant Pup!" Quest Item

Description.SourceString: 某宠物用品厂商最新研发的宠物头部按摩神器。据说没有一只爱宠能够在它的魔爪下还能够保持理智。「哼！汪们绝不会向这东西低头！」「继续、继续！不要停！呜呼~起飞！」
Description.LocalizedString: A newly developed pet head massager from a pet product manufacturer. It's said that no pet can remain rational under its claws! "Hmph! We dogs will never bow to this thing!" "Arf. Woof! Keep going, keep going! Don't stop! Woohoo!"

UseContext.SourceString: 「从捏造开始的恋爱大作战」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: Quest Item - Love that Begins with Lies

Description.SourceString: 口感爽滑、海洋风味的硬质糖果！每一粒都由定制贝壳装饰包裹，发售数量有限。
Description.LocalizedString: Smooth, ocean-flavored hard candy! Each piece is wrapped in a custom shell decoration. Limited quantities available.

UseContext.SourceString: 安魂曲情有独钟的番茄果冻。酸甜适中，带着番茄独有的清新风味，是她最最眷恋的味道。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Tomato jelly that Lacrimosa has a special fondness for. Perfectly balanced between sweet and sour with the unique freshness of tomatoes. It's the taste she treasures most.

Description.SourceString: 「番茄酱暴走现场实录！」任务道具
Description.LocalizedString: "Tomato Jelly Rampage: Live Report!" Quest Item

UseContext.SourceString: 一份装得满满的多口味冰淇淋，融合香草、草莓、巧克力等多种经典口味，是家庭聚会和炎炎夏日的最佳选择。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A generously filled multi-flavor ice cream. Combines classic tastes like vanilla, strawberry, and chocolate. The perfect choice for family gatherings and scorching summer days.

Description.SourceString: 「番茄酱暴走现场实录！」任务道具
Description.LocalizedString: "Tomato Jelly Rampage: Live Report!" Quest Item

UseContext.SourceString: 深受顾客欢迎的「咔叽玛薯霸」，和薯条兽的薯条相比也毫不逊色。
UseContext.LocalizedString: The hugely popular Clicky Fries that can easily hold their own against even the Frizzle.

Description.SourceString: 「出发，美味调查队！」任务道具
Description.LocalizedString: "Let's Go, Delicious Investigators!" Quest Item

UseContext.SourceString: 「柯林斯首领轶事-家族信物大作战！」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: "Colucci Anecdote - Family Token Showdown!" quest item.

Description.SourceString: 柯林斯家族的信物。与其他信物不同的是，你拥有的这枚是真正的隐藏款。
Description.LocalizedString: A token of the Colucci Family. Unlike other tokens, the one you possess is truly a hidden exclusive.

UseContext.SourceString: 「传说起点的究极漂移！」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: Drift Away, Legend! Quest Item

Description.SourceString:
兰斯——为飞驰而生。
                      广告语的意思是：非常建议用于佳节晚宴、赛后庆祝、走亲访友，非常不建议作为燃料使用。
Description.LocalizedString:
Reims—Born to Race.
What the slogan really means is: Highly recommended for holiday dinners, post-race celebrations, and family visits. Absolutely not recommended as fuel.

UseContext.SourceString: 「自我表达指南-知识的厚度」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: "Guide to Self-Expression - Weight of Knowledge" quest item.

Description.SourceString: 一张普通的会员卡。从边角的磨损可以看出它经常被拿出使用，但它的表面仍然光洁如新，证明所有者对它爱护有加。
Description.LocalizedString: An ordinary membership card. The worn edges indicate frequent use, yet its surface remains pristine, showing how much the owner cherishes it.

UseContext.SourceString: 「写给你的逆行诗」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: "A Retrograde Poem for You" Quest Item

Description.SourceString: 由于海鲜店老板的不信任，需要先付30000方斯的押金，才能得到货车钥匙……有点担心这些押金最后能不能要回来呢，不会到最后还要倒贴钱打工吧？
Description.LocalizedString: Due to the seafood shop owner's distrust, I need to pay a 30,000 Fons deposit first before getting the truck key fob… I'm not sure if I'll actually get this deposit back in the end. I hope I won't end up paying out of my own pocket to work here!

UseContext.SourceString: 「写给你的逆行诗」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: "A Retrograde Poem for You" Quest Item

Description.SourceString:
夏刑草，遇夏枯靡，逢雪方生。
于是，那个连哭泣都不敢的雪人，用撼一座城市，逆一个季节的勇气——
为友人筑起了「永恒的冬天」。
Description.LocalizedString:
Solifugae Vita withers in summer, and blooms only in snow.
So the snowman who dared not even cry, gathered the courage to shake a city and reverse a season—
Creating an "eternal winter" for their friend.

Description.SourceString: 弹珠可以再买，能偷偷吃辣条的机会可不多！
Description.LocalizedString: You can always buy more marbles, but the chance to secretly munch on spicy sticks don't come around often!

Description.SourceString: xxxx年xx月xx日，xx时xx分xx秒，7斤7两，谢谢大家的祝福……不要问我在哪钓的。
Description.LocalizedString: XXXX-XX-XX, XX:XX:XX, 5 kg. Don't ask where, don't ask how. I fished it. Thanks for your praise.

UseContext.SourceString: 小帕离开后，你发现了一张它留下的照片。
UseContext.LocalizedString: After Puff left, you discovered a photo it had left behind.

Description.SourceString: 这张照片，是你们之间仅剩的回忆纽带了……你没哭。只是眼睛里有点进雪。
Description.LocalizedString: This photograph is the only connection left between you… You're not crying. There's just some snow in your eyes.

Description.SourceString: 一位未来的飞镖大师，对于帮她找到飞镖的人的谢礼。拿上它吧，或许你也能成为飞镖大师！
Description.LocalizedString: A token of gratitude from a future dart master to whoever helped her find her dart. Take it with you—maybe you'll become a dart master too!

UseContext.SourceString: 塔吉多将为你修理车辆！(车辆维修费用将减免10%。)
UseContext.LocalizedString: Taygedo will repair your vehicle! (Vehicle repair costs reduced by 10%.)

Description.SourceString:
「Tayge,taygedo!」
「修车这种小事情，就交给伟大的塔吉多大人吧！」
两个词真的可以翻译出这么多字吗……
Description.LocalizedString:
"Tayge, taygedo!"
"Leave repairs to the great Taygedo!"
Can those two words really translate into so many characters…

UseContext.SourceString: 可前往「迈达斯弧盘工房」兑换弧盘「千金难买你开心」。

Description.SourceString: 承载许愿之力的硬币，是勤劳的纳库佩达赠予世人的馈赠，24小时不眠不休地推动命运的齿轮，实现人们的愿望。如果仔细聆听，大概冥冥之中会有一句：嗯！对你的愿望表示肯定。
Description.LocalizedString: A coin that carries the power of wishes. A gift bestowed upon the world by the diligent Nacupeda, working tirelessly 24 hours a day to turn the gears of fate and fulfill people's wishes. If you listen carefully, you might faintly hear a voice blessing your wishes: "Mhm!"

UseContext.SourceString: 受一位出车祸的司机委托传递的资料袋，他的弟弟似乎急需这份文件，把它送到折千市场便利店吧。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A document bag entrusted by a driver who was in a car accident. His brother seems to urgently need these documents, so deliver it to the Origami Market Convenience Store.

UseContext.SourceString: 一位游客在露营地丢失的吉他，把它交还给露营地的管理员吧。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A guitar lost by a tourist at the campsite. Return it to the campsite manager.

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于激活异象家具「咕咕警报」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to activate the Anomaly Furniture Coocoo Alert.

Description.SourceString: 为咕咕造一个只有黑夜的梦，而月亮永不坠落，好叫它永远醒着。
Description.LocalizedString: Create a dream of endless night for Coocoo where the moon never sets, so it may stay awake forever.

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于激活异象家具「玛门」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to activate the Anomaly Furniture "Mammon".

Description.SourceString: 祂目视，祂允诺，以金钱填满欲望的沟壑，放还吧，祂低语。
Description.LocalizedString: It beholds, It promises, filling the chasms of desire with wealth. Let go, It whispers.

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于提升「银边管家」的职称。

Description.LocalizedString: It was said that the butlers personally embroider all the lace trimmings, so the transition from Silver Edge to Golden Edge is simply a matter of changing threads.

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于激活异象家具「何人的头盔」。

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于激活异象家具「无名刃」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to activate the Anomaly Furniture "Nameless Blade".

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于激活异象家具「空铠甲」。

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于激活异象家具「旧滑板」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to activate the Anomaly Furniture "Old Skateboard".

Description.SourceString: 悬赏奖金和战利品全都要，这才是一个合格的异象猎人。

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于升级异象家具「玛门」。

Description.LocalizedString: On every cold armor plate that once burned hot, the king's name is engraved.

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于升级异象家具「仿制幽灵车」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to upgrade the Anomaly Furniture "Replica Ghost Car".

Description.SourceString: 一次，两次，乃至上万次，直到血管中奔涌的燃油也被烧尽。
Description.LocalizedString: Once, twice, even ten thousand times, until the fuel rushing through its veins is finally burned away.

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于升级异象家具「旧滑板」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to upgrade the Anomaly Furniture "Old Skateboard".

Description.SourceString: 究竟是什么使今日家庭如此不同，如此有吸引力？
Description.LocalizedString: What exactly makes today's families so different, so appealing?

UseContext.LocalizedString: Use to upgrade the Anomaly Furniture "Paper Plane".

Description.SourceString: 以碎纸片织就的羽翼，也能自由地飞翔吗？
Description.LocalizedString: Can wings woven from scraps of paper truly soar free?

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于升级异象家具「双鱼旗」。

Description.SourceString: 红鲤鱼蓝鲤鱼与绿鲤鱼。
Description.LocalizedString: Red carp, blue carp, and green carp.

UseContext.SourceString: 可作为礼物赠送给角色并增加400点好感度。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be given as a gift to characters and increases Affection by 400 points.

Description.SourceString: 棉棉打了一个哈欠，落下很多棉絮，就像太阳晒过一样暖洋洋的。
Description.LocalizedString: Fluffy yawned and shed cotton fluff everywhere, as warm and cozy as sunshine.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可以召唤「起司」，快门一响，万物定格，时光停驻，静默一切。但把世界定格成静止照片的效果仅有一次，绝无重拍机会。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons Cheese. Snap the shutter, and the world freezes—time stops, and silence falls. This "still photograph" effect can only be used once. No retakes.

Description.SourceString: 「起司」外形酷似照相机，按下快门时，可使拍摄范围内所有生物都瞬间陷入「时间停滞」状态——身体无法移动，意识陷入沉寂，恍若被囚禁于一帧静止的画面中。起司是一次性异象，使用后会立刻泯除，普通人受「起司」影响严重，定格时间可长达数十小时，且事后完全丧失记忆，只能模糊记起刺眼的闪光灯。部分异能者仅会被定格住几分钟，且能清晰回忆起拍摄前的全部细节，包括相机持有者的身份。因其潜在用途包括暗杀、逃脱和挟制，普通人无缘得见，现主要流通于地下市场的悬赏交易中。
Description.LocalizedString: Cheese looks just like a camera, but when you press the shutter, it instantly freezes all living beings within the shooting range in a state of time suspension. Their bodies cannot move and their consciousness falls silent, as if trapped within a single frozen frame. Cheese is a one-time-use Anomaly that immediately disappears after use. Ordinary people are severely affected by Cheese, with freeze duration lasting up to dozens of hours, and they completely lose their memory afterward, only vaguely recalling a blinding flash. Some Espers are only frozen for a few minutes and can clearly recall all details before the shot, including the identity of the camera holder. Due to its potential uses including assassination, escape, and hostage situations, ordinary people have no access to it, and it currently circulates mainly in underground market bounty trades.

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于初级倒带。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be used for Easy Rewind.

UseContext.LocalizedString: 可用于「都市闲趣」玩法中获得奖励，每周自动恢复至上限。大亨系统可以额外提高都市活力的可恢复上限。

Description.LocalizedString: Once Character Pixels reach their cap, Photo Paper Supply begins regenerating over time. It restores 1 point every 18 minutes, up to a maximum of 2,400 points, and can be converted to Character Pixels at a 1:1 ratio.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可以召唤「棉绒绒」，它们的忍耐值为零，受到攻击后会原地反击，化身肌肉猛兔，使出爱的勾拳。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons Fluffy, a zero-tolerance companion who immediately counterattacks when provoked. Watch as Fluffy transforms into a muscular battle rabbit, delivering powerful, loving hooks.

Description.SourceString: 「棉绒绒」是一种外形酷似白色兔子的温顺异象生物，依赖棉织品而生，会发出「棉棉~棉棉」的声音，常在阳光充足的午后成群出现。被棉绒绒「加工」后的被子，会格外蓬松温暖，令人酣睡好梦，因此正常情况下，棉绒绒不存在威胁。但其对火焰极度敏感，一旦遭遇灼烧便会触发「狂暴化」，原本温顺的外表会在暴怒中彻底崩解，取而代之的是无穷的愤怒与铁拳。
Description.LocalizedString: Fluffy is a docile Anomaly creature that resembles a white rabbit in appearance. It survives by feeding on cotton textiles and makes "fluff fluff" sounds, often appearing in groups during sunny afternoons. Blankets "processed" by Fluffy become exceptionally soft and warm, providing deep, restful sleep. Under normal circumstances, Fluffy poses no threat. However, it is extremely sensitive to flames. Once exposed to burning, it triggers a "rage mode" where its originally gentle appearance completely breaks down in fury, replaced by endless anger and iron fists.

UseContext.SourceString: <!>使用后将变身团三郎
UseContext.LocalizedString: After use, you will transform into Danzaburo.

Description.SourceString: <!>异象：团三郎背景描述
Description.LocalizedString: Strange Phenomenon: Background Description of Tuan Saburo

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后召唤「向导」，「向导」将为你指引附近心仪之物的所在。跟着向导走，宝贝少不了。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons The Guide, your companion to nearby treasures. Follow its lead, and fortune is sure to follow.

Description.SourceString: 最初，「向导」被发现于一场营救事件——某位在野外迷路的异象猎人，在昏暗的树林里遇见了一团漂浮的环形烟圈，它无声地变换着形状，为猎人指引方向，带他走出绝境。如今，这些烟圈形态的「向导」已随处可见，被投放至大型商场与旅游景点，取代了传统的导购员。当有人询问位置时，向导总知道捷径……虽然不一定是安全的。
Description.LocalizedString: Initially, The Guide was discovered during a rescue operation. An Anomaly Hunter who got lost in the wilderness encountered a floating ring of smoke in the dim forest. It silently shifted shapes, guiding the Hunter and leading him out of danger. Today, these smoke ring-shaped Guides can be seen everywhere, deployed in large shopping malls and tourist attractions, replacing traditional store assistants. When someone asks for directions, The Guide always knows a shortcut… though not necessarily a safe one.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后召唤「尖叫电波」，为音频镀上复古质感，每段被电波抚摸过的声音，都在讲述一个关于时间的故事。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons Screaming Airwaves, infusing sound with a vintage texture. Every note and whisper carries the stories of time itself.

Description.SourceString: 这台缠绕着老式真空管与跳频火花的异象制品收音机，永远在寻找「不够复古」的音乐。当它捕捉到忧郁旋律时，生锈的旋钮会疯狂自转，将曲子暴改成黑胶唱片特有的复古底噪。那些让老乐迷沉醉的「炒豆子杂音」，是收音机为失真的浪漫保留的频率，是时间洪流里不曾锈蚀的岁月。
Description.LocalizedString: This Anomaly product radio, wrapped in old vacuum tubes and frequency-hopping sparks, is forever searching for music that's "not vintage enough." When it captures melancholic melodies, its rusty knobs spin wildly, brutally transforming songs into the distinctive vintage crackle of vinyl records. Those "popping bean sounds" that enchant old music fans are the frequencies the radio preserves for distorted romance - the years that never rusted in time's torrential flow.

UseContext.SourceString: 一副神秘的墨镜，镜片泛着微光，由「窥窥」精心收藏。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A mysterious pair of sunglasses with lenses that gleam faintly, carefully collected by Peepy.

Description.SourceString: 无人注意的墙缝里，寄居着名为「窥窥」的异象，它没有完整的形体，甚至没人说得清它的轮廓，因为目击者所能确认的，只有一只躲在墙缝后的眼睛。「窥窥」痴迷于观察人类生活的细枝末节：早餐摊蒸腾的热气、情侣在路灯下欲言又止的指尖、醉汉对着垃圾桶嘟囔的脏话……这些鲜活的生活都让它感到某种温暖的痒意。可惜这种小心翼翼的窥视，总会被人当成一种冒犯，随后发出惊叫与怒叱。现在……「窥窥」学聪明了，它收藏了一堆墨镜，笃定这是完美的伪装，幻想自己正戴着它们，坦然地融进这熙攘的人群。
Description.LocalizedString: In the unnoticed cracks of walls dwells an anomaly called "Peepy." It has no complete form, and no one can even describe its outline. All witnesses can confirm is a single eye hiding behind the wall cracks. Peepy is obsessed with observing the minutiae of human life: steam rising from breakfast stalls, lovers' hesitant fingertips under streetlights, drunkards mumbling profanities at trash cans… All these vivid moments of life give it a kind of warm, tingling sensation. Unfortunately, this careful voyeurism is always perceived as an intrusion, followed by screams and angry shouts. Now… Peepy has gotten smarter. It has collected a pile of sunglasses, convinced they're the perfect disguise, fantasizing that it's wearing them and boldly blending into the bustling crowds.

UseContext.SourceString: 将滴眼液滴入眼睛后，可暂时进入「其他人视角」来看世界。
UseContext.LocalizedString: After applying the eye drops, you can temporarily enter another person's view to see the world.

Description.SourceString: 滴入左眼——看见他的枷锁，滴入右眼——理解她的孤独。异象制品滴眼泪，滴完后可短暂进入「他人视角」，借一双眼睛，重新审视世界。滴完眼药水后，原本坐在公园长椅上的人，突然发现自己正四脚着地，变成了自家的宠物狗。但眼前一片模糊，风景褪色，整个世界都变得灰扑扑，这就是狗的视角啊，连红绿灯都分不清楚。但神奇的是，只要看到长椅上的「自己」，眼前就会变成明亮的黄色。原来在狗狗眼里……主人是会发光的。
Description.LocalizedString: Drop into the left eye to see his chains, drop into the right eye to understand her loneliness. Anomaly product eye drops that, once applied, briefly allow you to enter another's view and borrow their eyes to re-examine the world. After using the eye drops, someone sitting on a park bench suddenly finds themselves on all fours, transformed into their own pet dog. Everything becomes blurry, the scenery fades, and the whole world turns dull gray. This is a dog's view after all, unable to even distinguish traffic lights. Miraculously, whenever they look at their "self" on the bench, everything turns bright yellow. It turns out that in a dog's eyes… their owner glows!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“微风的悄悄话”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Whispers on the Breeze

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」收容二组薄荷的名片。
看到这张名片，是不是就会想起薄荷呢？那就立刻打开呗果，和薄荷聊聊天吧！薄荷的话匣子里总是有聊不完的话题，她绝对会第一时间回复你！当然了，出勤时间除外。
Description.LocalizedString:
Mint's namecard as a member of CSU-2.
Does seeing this card make you think of Mint? Then open up Bagel and chat with her right away! Mint's always got endless topics to talk about, and she'll absolutely reply in a flash! Well, except when she's on duty, of course.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“小小纸片”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Just a Little Card

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D四队队长白藏的名片。
陈述简洁，排版清晰，正经得不像是白藏的名片——当然，也确实不是他自己制作的。显而易见，功劳都得归结于他那靠谱的副队。至于他的态度嘛……一张小小的纸片而已，如何定义得了一个活生生的、复杂的人呢？
Description.LocalizedString:
Baicang's namecard as the Captain of ETD-4.
Concise wording, clean layout, and so professional that it doesn't seem like Baicang's card at all. Of course, that's because he didn't actually make it himself. All credit goes to his dependable Lieutenant. As for Baicang's take on it… well, how could a little piece of paper ever define a living, complex person?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“欢迎光临”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Welcome

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」管家的正式名片。
持本名片到店可享受伊波恩管家亲自招待并有优惠折扣！但对阿德勒先生本人来说，这张名片的存在意味着漂泊半生的旅人，也终于有了歇脚之处。
Description.LocalizedString:
The official namecard of the Butler of Eibon Antique Shop.
Present this card at the shop to receive personal service from the Eibon Butler, along with a special discount! But for Adler himself, the very existence of this card signifies something more: a wanderer who drifted through half a lifetime has finally found a place to call home.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“家族成员”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Family Member

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店员早雾的名片。
「什么叫你还没有名片？柯林斯家族的成员怎么能没有名片，快做一张去！」因为这种原因诞生的名片，不知道早雾对这张名片到底是什么态度，至少娜娜莉很满意。
Description.LocalizedString:
Sakiri's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
"What do you mean you don't have a namecard? How can a member of The Coluccis not have a namecard? Go get one made right now!" This namecard was born from that exact demand. It's unclear how Sakiri actually feels about it, but at least Nanally is satisfied.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“唯一确定性”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: The One Certainty

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店员达芙蒂尔的名片。
人拥有名片意味着什么呢？就好像狗狗拥有了写着自己名字的铭牌吗？她尚且不太明白其中的含义。唯独能确信的是——以前，她总是在不同的任务中使用不同的姓名代号。现在，她只要做「达芙蒂尔」就可以。
Description.LocalizedString:
Daffodill's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
What does it mean for a person to have a namecard? Is it like a dog having a tag with its name on it? She doesn't quite understand the significance yet. But one thing she knows for certain: before, she always used different codenames for different missions. Now, she just needs to be Daffodill.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“正式申请”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Formal Application

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店员埃德嘉的名片。
照片出自埃德嘉的个人简历。埃德嘉为应聘伊波恩古董店做足了准备……实际上，都没派上用场。
不过，被埃德嘉当作「面试官」尊敬的塔吉多过足了瘾。
Description.LocalizedString:
Edgar's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
The photo is from Edgar's personal resume. Edgar went all out preparing to apply for a position at Eibon Antique Shop… but in the end, none of it was actually necessary.
Still, Taygedo, whom Edgar respectfully treated as the "interviewer," got a real kick out of it.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“风水问题”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: A Feng Shui Issue

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店长浔的名片。
几乎每一桩结局是被次品、假货所骗的古董收购交易，都通过这张名片找到了浔的头上。所以她偶尔会掏出来打量，寻思着是不是照片文字在设计布局上的位置出了什么毛病……风水角度的。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hotori's namecard as the Owner of Eibon Antique Shop.
Almost every antique acquisition deal that ends with the buyer being duped by fakes or inferior goods somehow traces back to Hotori through this card. So every now and then, she takes it out for a good look, wondering if there's something wrong with the placement of the photo and text in the layout… from a feng shui perspective.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“老大的派头”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Boss Vibes

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店员娜娜莉的名片。
凹凸有形的纸面暗纹（睡觉时压皱的）、低奢的配色（彩印经费不够）、隐约可见的装饰性线条（手抖涂出去了）……种种细节彰显着名片持有者神秘且高贵的身份。这个叫「老大的派头」，相信有人能懂。
Description.LocalizedString:
Nanally's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
The textured watermark patterns on the paper (crumpled from sleeping on it), the understated luxury color scheme (ran out of budget for color printing), the faintly visible decorative lines (hand slipped while drawing)… Every detail speaks to the mysterious and noble identity of the card's owner. She calls this "boss vibes." Surely someone out there gets it.

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D四队队员安魂曲的……名片？

Lacrimosa's… namecard? As a member of ETD-4.

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D四队副队长翳的名片。
名片应包含基本姓名、职位、公司全称、详细地址和有效联络方式，如电话号码、邮箱、呗果账号和芝码等，确保客户和合作伙伴能够便捷地取得联系——而这张在统一格式下制作的名片似乎稍显信息不足，翳颇有微词。
Description.LocalizedString:
Skia's namecard as Lieutenant of ETD-4.
A namecard should include essential information such as the holder's name, title, full company name, detailed address, and valid contact methods like phone number, email, Bagel account, and Sesame Codes, ensuring that clients and partners can easily get in touch. However, this card, produced in a standardized format, seems to fall short on information. Skia is not amused.

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D四队队员法帝娅的名片。
当名片上印着一个热烈乖张的口红印时，接收方往往会露出一个有趣的表情。譬如，误认作一场邀约的窃喜；跳脱于正常社交范围的尴尬；一闪而过的鄙夷……实际上，这只是一个测试游戏。她从中窥见对方的底色，并乐此不疲。
Description.LocalizedString:
Fadia's namecard as a member of ETD-4.
When a bold and provocative lipstick mark is printed on a namecard, the recipient tends to have an interesting reaction. A secret thrill from mistaking it for an invitation, perhaps. The awkwardness of something beyond normal social norms. A fleeting flash of disdain… In truth, it's all just a little test. She uses it to catch a glimpse of their true colors, and she never gets tired of it.
