UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：业务之星
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained name card: Model Employee

Description.SourceString: 小吱被抓拍到的一张照片。不要被外表迷惑哦，超强的业务能力才是小吱真正的「杀手锏」。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Chiz. Don't be fooled by her looks. Her true strength is in her business skills.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：从不出错的眼光
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: An Unerring Eye

Description.SourceString: 浔被抓拍到的一张照片。遇到稀罕宝贝，不论价值几何，该出手时就出手，这是浔一贯的作风。
Description.LocalizedString: A candid photo of Hotori. When she spots a rare treasure, price is never the question. She always knows when to make her move

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：往日的回声
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Echoes of the Past

Description.SourceString: 海月被抓拍到的一张照片。有时候，海月仍会思念她最好的朋友们：就像踏上旅程的人，偶尔也会回望故乡。
Description.LocalizedString: A candid photo of Aurelia. She still sometimes thinks of her closest friends, like a traveler glancing back at home.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：真智能吗？
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Smart? Says Who?

Description.SourceString: 卡厄斯被抓拍到的一张照片。异象管理局为许多特殊员工开办了「现代智能设备常识课」，尽管如此，卡厄斯还是需要队长私下为他开小灶，以免挂科。
Description.LocalizedString: A candid photo of Chaos. The Bureau of Anomaly Control runs a "Modern Smart Device Basics" course for many of its special employees. Chaos, however, still needs Captain to tutor him on the side if he has any hope of passing.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：赤红流星
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Crimson Meteor

Description.SourceString: 真红被抓拍到的一张照片。C.S.U偶尔可以放开手脚去对付棘手的目标，因此也会留下一些时髦的影像——但还是不建议市民在尚未确认异象泯除时就拿着照片去索要签名。
Description.LocalizedString: A candid snapshot of Shinku. CSU occasionally gets to cut loose against troublesome targets, leaving behind some pretty stylish shots—but citizens are still advised not to ask for autographs until the Anomaly has been confirmed nullified.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：收容没有事故
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Containment no Breach

Description.SourceString: 伊洛伊被抓拍到的一张照片。罐头里面有什么？咖啡？可乐？还是异象？
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Iroi. What's in the can? Coffee? Cola? Or perhaps an Anomaly?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：花落再收刀
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: After the Bloom

Description.SourceString: 残虹被抓拍到的一张照片。刀刃出鞘的瞬间，万千幻梦升腾。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Zankou. The moment the blade clears its sheath, countless dreamlike visions bloom.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：贞在加载
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Now Loading: Xiaozhen

Description.SourceString: 灵可被抓拍到的一张照片。「前方监测到神秘电波！」小贞加载中，灵可向前冲！
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Linko. "Mysterious frequency detected ahead!" Xiaozhen powers up as Linko charges forward!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：「工作」时间
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Working Hours

Description.SourceString: 黑羽被抓拍到的一张照片。「工作中，请勿打扰。」黑羽房间的门上有时会挂上这样的标牌。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Blackbird. "Working. Do not disturb." A sign bearing these words can sometimes be found hanging on her door.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：比拥抱更接近的蓝
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Heartbeats in Blue

Description.SourceString: 明音凛被抓拍到的一张照片。在演出后的舞台上，两人背靠着休息。默契让她们无需多言，更不必看着对方便能相互理解。因为背靠是比拥抱更能让心脏贴近的方式。每一声心跳都在诉说：群星簇拥的满月，你是否也在某处同我一起仰望呢？
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Akane Rin. After the show, she and her companion rest back to back beneath the lingering stage lights. Between them, there is no need for words. Some bonds are quiet like that—felt rather than spoken. Beneath a full moon wreathed in stars, are you looking up at the same sky?

UseContext.SourceString: 夏成豆腐店八折券，和店主速太友谊的见证。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Natsunari Tofu 20% off coupon. Testament to your friendship with the owner, Sota.

Description.SourceString: 速太赠送的折扣券，持有该券前往夏成豆腐店消费，即可享受友情折扣价。速太见证了新时代「海特洛车神」的诞生，也请你别忘了多关照这位前任「车神」的新事业！
Description.LocalizedString: A discount coupon from Sota. When presented at Natsunari Tofu, you'll receive a special friend discount. Sota has witnessed the birth of the new God Racer of Hethereau, so please don't forget to support the tofu ventures of this Former God Racer of Hethereau!

UseContext.SourceString: 可用于提升角色的都市特技等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to increase a character's Life Skills level.

Description.SourceString: 「在一千个斑斓梦境中，种下一千枚种子。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Plant a thousand seeds in a thousand fever dreams."

ItemName.SourceString: 初级角色异能材料自选箱
ItemName.LocalizedString: Character Esper Material Selection Box I

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从雏鸟的希冀、新兵的怯懦、初次的期许、思维的同频、水波的迟疑中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Nestling's Longing, FNG, First Expectations, Synchronicity of Thought, or Hesitation of the Waves.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从白鸽的振翅、尉官的谨慎、已知的倦怠、信仰的共鸣、倒悬的轻响中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Dove's Flutter, CO's Caution, Known Weariness, Resonance of Faith, or Suspended Whispers.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从「橄榄枝」「白蔷薇」「黑帽子」「心跳夜」「第二人」中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: The Olive Branch, White Rose, Black Hat, Heart-Racing Night, or The Second Self.

ItemName.SourceString: 初级弧盘突破材料自选箱
ItemName.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension Material Selection Box I

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从铁制苹果核、螺旋乐碎屑、液态梦试用装、无味冷点心、入门级戏剧芯中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Iron Appleseed, Beaty, Liquid Dream Trial Kit, Flavorless Cold Dessert, or Beginner Drama Core.

ItemName.SourceString: 中级弧盘突破材料自选箱
ItemName.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension Material Selection Box II

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从银质苹果核、螺旋乐小节、液态梦旅行装、原味冷点心、大师级戏剧芯中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Silver Appleseed, Versey, Liquid Dream Travel Kit, Plain Cold Dessert, or Master Drama Core.

ItemName.SourceString: 高级弧盘突破材料自选箱
ItemName.LocalizedString: Arc Ascension Material Selection Box III

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从金色苹果核、螺旋乐齐奏、罐装液态梦、特制冷点心、典藏级戏剧芯中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Golden Appleseed, Harmony, Liquid Dream Can, Special Cold Dessert, or Collector's Drama Core.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从失落絮语、褪色掠影、模糊数符、悬想幻妄中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Lost Whispers, Fading Silhouette, Blurred Numeral, or Suspended Delusions.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从茫昧絮语、失焦掠影、未解数符、渴念幻妄中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Obscure Whispers, Blurred Silhouette, Unsolved Numeral, or Yearning Delusions.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从悖谬絮语、晦暗掠影、扭曲数符、超验幻妄中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Paradoxical Whispers, Chaos Silhouette, Distorted Numeral, or Transcendent Delusions.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从倾诉花种、上膛骑士火花塞、妄想彼端的一页、水月色拨片、护巢残片、斑斓的票根、海之泪中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Confessional Flower Seed, Charging Knight Spark Plug, A Page from Delusion's Shore, Water Moon Pick, Nestguard Fragment, Colorful Ticket Stub, or Tear of the Sea.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从好狗狗印章、名为炫耀的裙袂中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Good Boy Stamp or Dress Sleeves of Vanity.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从好狗狗印章、名为炫耀的裙袂、记忆的永恒中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Good Boy Stamp, Dress Sleeves of Vanity or Eternal Memory.

ItemName.LocalizedString: Anomaly Pilgrimage Material Selection Box II

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从好狗狗印章、名为炫耀的裙袂、记忆的永恒、空心花籽中自选一件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Good Boy Stamp, Dress Sleeves of Vanity, Eternal Memory or Hollowflower Seeds.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从早雾、哈索尔、白藏、法帝娅、达芙蒂尔、九原中选择一名角色加入队伍。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Allows you to invite Sakiri, Hathor, Baicang, Fadia, Daffodil, or Jiuyuan to join your team.

ItemName.LocalizedString: Puka Membership Program S-Class Arc Selection Box

UseContext.SourceString: 开启后可在下列弧盘中选择一个：现实避难所、漆黑青春妄想、好狗狗走四方、茶花会、焰魂狂飙、引爆全场、面具下的泪、永恒圆舞曲、鲸之歌。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Open to choose one of the following Arcs: Reality Refuge, Youthful Fantasy, Good Boy's Grand Adventure, Camellia Society, Raging Flames, Blow up the Crowd, Tears Beneath the Mask, Eternal Waltz, or Song of the Whale.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从早雾、哈索尔、白藏、法帝娅中选择一名角色加入队伍。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Allows you to invite Sakiri, Hathor, Baicang, or Fadia to join your team.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从娜娜莉、安魂曲、浔中选择一名角色加入队伍。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Allows you to invite Nanally, Lacrimosa, or Hotori to join your team.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从阿德勒、薄荷、翳中选择一名角色加入队伍。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Allows you to invite Adler, Mint, or Skia to join your team.

UseContext.SourceString: 可前往「迈达斯弧盘工房」兑换弧盘「思考喵」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be exchanged at the Midas Arc Workshop for Arc - Contemplative Cat.

Description.SourceString: 毛茸茸软乎乎的毛线球，即使是猫猫异象，也会因为轻轻一碰就发出满足的呼噜声。
Description.LocalizedString: A fluffy, soft yarn ball. Even kitten Anomalies would purr with satisfaction from just a single touch!

UseContext.SourceString: 无主的储物柜钥匙，可以用来打开城市里的「一格」储物柜格口。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An ownerless locker key that can be used to open "Griddy" storage lockers throughout the city.

Description.SourceString: 一把钥匙能打开一个格口，拥有了钥匙，就拥有了格口。
Description.LocalizedString: One key opens one locker compartment. With the key, you own the compartment.

Description.SourceString:
食材准备：
鸡蛋3个、玉米油35克、牛奶40克、低筋面粉50克、白砂糖30克、半个柠檬
制作步骤：
1.将蛋清蛋白分离至两个盆中.
2.重新取一个盆加入玉米油35克和牛奶40克搅拌成酸奶状。
3.加入蛋黄和低筋面粉划搅拌至顺滑状态。
4.从冰箱取出蛋清，加入柠檬汁，分三次加入白糖充分打发。
5.取1/3的蛋白霜加入蛋黄糊中混合均匀。
6.将混合好的蛋糕糊倒入蛋白霜盆中混合均匀。
7.将蛋糕糊倒入模具中，用牙签在将表面气泡划破。
8.送入烤箱上下火150度60分钟。
Description.LocalizedString:
Ingredients:
3 eggs, 35g corn oil, 40g milk, 50g cake flour, 30g granulated sugar, half a lemon
Instructions:
1. Separate egg whites and yolks into two bowls.
2. In a new bowl, add 35g corn oil and 40g milk, whisk until yogurt-like consistency.
3. Add egg yolks and cake flour, mix until smooth.
4. Take egg whites from refrigerator, add lemon juice, gradually add sugar in three portions and whip thoroughly.
5. Take 1/3 of the meringue and fold into the egg yolk mixture until evenly combined.
6. Pour the mixed cake batter into the meringue bowl and fold until evenly combined.
7. Pour cake batter into mold, use a toothpick to pop surface bubbles.
8. Bake in oven at 150°C for 60 minutes.

Description.SourceString:
「是透过窗扉照进屋内的阳光，是推开门的第一口空气，是街角传来的乐声，就连落在发间的雨，穿过指间的风都想第一时间与你分享。」
「信纸太短，想说的话却又太多。如果这封信能传达出万分之一的想念，如果你见信时恰好也听到街角的乐声响起。」
……
这样写，会不会太夸张了？
Description.LocalizedString:
"It's the sunlight streaming through the window into the room, The first breath of air when you open the door. The music drifting from the street corner. Even the rain falling on your hair, the wind passing through your fingers—I want to share it all with you in that very moment."
"This letter is too short, but there's so much I want to say. If this letter could convey even one ten-thousandth of how much I miss you… If when you read this, you happen to hear that music from the street corner too…"
…
Is this too over the top?

Description.LocalizedString: This is a story about friendship and bonds, the past, present, and future.

UseContext.SourceString: 可以提供1000点的角色经验，用于角色提高等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Provides 1,000 points of character EXP, used to increase character level.

Description.SourceString:
「新生代猎人的个人见解，晋升攻略先行放送！」
——这是一份「呗果」上获得999+「芝麻」的猎人攻略，曾有刚领到猎人证的新手尝试验证其成效，最后只留下了一句评论：小……心……异……象！
Description.LocalizedString:
"Notes from a Rising Hunter: Your Guide to Promotion!"
—This is a hunter's guide that garnered 999+ Sesame ratings on Bagel. A rookie who had just received their hunter's license tried to put the book into practice, leaving only one comment: Be… ware… of… Anomalies!

Description.SourceString: 动画「猫与狗」联动DSD推出的系列玩偶，在联动特别剧情中，水手肯特以及司机大路又将展开一段全新的故事。
Description.LocalizedString: A series of dolls released through a collaboration between the anime "The Cat and The Dog" and DSD. In the special collaboration storyline, sailor Kent and driver Luigi will embark on a brand new adventure.

UseContext.SourceString: 可以提供1000点的角色经验，用于角色提高等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Provides 1,000 points of character EXP, used to increase character level.

Description.SourceString:
「新生代猎人的个人见解，晋升攻略先行放送！」
——这是一份「呗果」上获得999+「芝麻」的猎人攻略，曾有刚领到猎人证的新手尝试验证其成效，最后只留下了一句评论：小……心……异……象！
Description.LocalizedString:
"Notes from a Rising Hunter: Your Guide to Promotion!"
—This is a hunter's guide that garnered 999+ Sesame ratings on Bagel. A rookie who had just received their hunter's license tried to put the book into practice, leaving only one comment: Be… ware… of… Anomalies!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「娜娜莉」专属角色时装「华丽飞踢」及「头像-华丽飞踢」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Nanally Outfit & Avatar: Phoenix Kick.

Description.SourceString:
一套设计独特的格斗服。娜娜莉为此特地报名了格斗训练班。
「什么时候去上训练课？呃……下次一定！」
Description.LocalizedString:
A fighting outfit with a unique design. Nanally specifically enrolled in a combat training class for this.
"When am I going to attend the training sessions? Uh… Next time for sure!"

Description.SourceString:
据说是某位知名设计师为浔特别定制的衣装，其价值足够再开十家伊波恩。
「名月下，幽兰泣无声，烟渺渺。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Rumored to be a custom outfit specially designed for Hotori by a famous designer. Its value could open ten more Eibons. 
"Under the bright moon, orchids weep in silence, mist drifts endlessly."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「安魂曲」专属角色时装「千里莺啼」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Lacrimosa Outfit: Nightingale's Crescendo.

Description.SourceString: 幸福的降临或许总是毫无章法，宛如一场横冲直撞的「硬着陆」。就像昭示幸福来临的蝙蝠飞入窗棂时，也总伴着清脆的巨响和散落一地的碎玻璃那样。
Description.LocalizedString: Happiness sometimes arrives without rhyme or reason, like a reckless hard landing. Just as the bat that foretells good fortune flies through the window lattice, it always comes with a crisp crash and shattered glass strewn across the floor.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「卡厄斯」专属角色时装「放晴日」及「头像-放晴日」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Chaos Outfit & Avatar: Clear Skies.

Description.SourceString: 休闲街头风格着装，简易单品与独特的配饰碰撞，亦能彰显个性。
Description.LocalizedString: A casual streetwear look that pairs simple pieces with bold accessories to express true individuality.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「真红」专属角色时装「地海高校生」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Shinku Outfit: Student of Terrasea.

Description.SourceString:
让人联想到青春感的学院风穿搭。据说每个人在这段时期都会逃避和追逐阴影中的那个自己……即使没有也会想办法找一个出来。
「不要随便用这种蠢透了的方式来解读……唉，算了。」
Description.LocalizedString:
A neat, preppy outfit with the fresh charm of campus life. They say youth is spent either fleeing from one's inner shadow or chasing after it… and even those without a shadow will find a way to cast one.
"Don't read something that ridiculous into it… Ugh, whatever."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「残虹」专属角色时装「秋色闲章」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Zankou Outfit: Autumn Vignette.

Description.SourceString: 残虹研习现代时尚后为自己定制的私服。比起平日里的打扮，这套行装更方便她融入城市的人群，但至于其是否时尚，仍有待商榷。
Description.LocalizedString: Zankou's custom casualwear, created after studying modern fashion. It helps her blend into the city crowd, though whether it actually looks fashionable is still up for debate.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「灵可」专属角色时装「星间漫游」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Linko Outfit: Surfing Among Stars.

Description.SourceString:
灵可的奇思妙想总是没有边界，自从淘到这套时装之后，她就总在想自己有没有可能能接收到世界以外的电波。
她的背包里装着一座小小花园，也装着继续前行的勇气。植物会长大，旅途也是。
Description.LocalizedString:
Linko's imagination knows no limits. Ever since she found this outfit, she's wondered whether she can tune in to signals from beyond this world.
Her backpack holds a tiny garden and the courage to keep going. Plants grow, and so does the journey.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「黑羽」专属角色时装「不凋羽」及「头像-不凋羽」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Blackbird Outfit & Avatar: Unfazed Denim.

Description.SourceString: 黑羽的居家服装。无事的时候，黑羽会对原本平平无奇的衣物做一些颇具个人风格的改造，而这套至今仍是她最爱的休闲穿着。
Description.LocalizedString: Blackbird's favorite loungewear. When she has time to kill, she likes taking perfectly ordinary clothes and giving them a distinctly Blackbird makeover. This set, somehow, has yet to be dethroned.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「黑羽」专属角色时装「牧星者」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Blackbird Outfit: Wandering Stars.

Description.SourceString:
每一个占卜之人都渴望解明万物的隐喻，命运于她而言，恰似天幕中不歇流转的繁星。
「于穹顶万千星座中，我窥见你与我辉映的命运。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Those who read the stars spend their lives searching for meaning in every sign. To her, destiny is written in the endless dance of the heavens.
"Among all the stars above, I saw yours and mine bound to the same fate."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「黑羽」专属角色时装「红与黑」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Blackbird Outfit: Rouge et Noir.

Description.SourceString: 黑羽诸多收藏中的一件套装。不同于往日风格，夺目的红怒放在复古的衣装上，张扬而动人。看来除了古董，黑羽在着装方面也有着相当挑剔的品味。
Description.LocalizedString: One of the many outfits in Blackbird's collection. It's a bolder look than usual, with vivid crimson set against vintage tailoring—flashy, elegant, and hard to miss. Turns out Blackbird is every bit as discerning about clothes as she is about antiques.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「明音凛」专属角色时装「节能生活」及「头像-节能生活」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Akane Rin Outfit & Avatar: Off the Clock.

Description.SourceString: 「非必要的事情不做，必要的事情一律从简。」
Description.LocalizedString: "If it's not worth doing, don't bother. If it is, do the bare minimum."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「明音凛」专属角色时装「茜色丝绒」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Akane Rin Outfit: Cozy Velvet.

Description.SourceString: 只有在重要节日才会穿出来的服饰。「一年也穿不了几次，就不必考虑什么节能穿搭了吧？」
Description.LocalizedString: An outfit saved for special occasions. "I only wear it a few times a year. Surely I can let the whole energy-saving thing slide, right?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「明音凛」专属角色时装「吧台特调」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Akane Rin Outfit: House Special.

Description.SourceString: 「问问题可以，先点杯饮料。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Ask away—but order a drink first."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「明音凛」专属角色时装「舞台之星」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Akane Rin Outfit: Shining Idol.

Description.SourceString: 全身心投入的飒爽英姿，成为舞台上最闪耀的星星。
Description.LocalizedString: Give it everything you've got, own the stage, and be the star everyone remembers.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「明音凛」专属角色时装「全金属摇滚」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Akane Rin Outfit: Full Metal Rock.

Description.SourceString: 每个少女都有不为人知的狂野一面。当年在学校收取「保护费」的事情，或许不是传闻？——「那只是在学校开演唱会的票钱！」
Description.LocalizedString: Every girl has a wild side she doesn't advertise. So maybe those old rumors about her running a protection racket at school weren't entirely made up. "Those were concert tickets! I was putting on a show!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「Exe」专属角色时装「X%」及「头像-X%」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Exe Outfit & Avatar: X%.

Description.SourceString:
对于极少放假的工作狂来说，这是极低概率才会出现的穿着。
为什么会有人在不用上班的休息时间……反而看起来心情更差的样子？
Description.LocalizedString:
A rare sight: a workaholic finally taking a day off.
So why do they look even more miserable when they don't have to work…?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「Exe」专属角色时装「蓝雪」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Exe Outfit: Blue Snow.

Description.SourceString:
秋冬季在室外需要多披上一件风衣，莫名很适合搭配一杯热咖啡的印象。
那条围巾轻盈而柔软地缠绕住脖颈，不可思议的是比看起来更加保暖。
Description.LocalizedString:
In fall and winter, a trench coat is the perfect extra layer for heading outdoors. Somehow, it just seems to go with a hot cup of coffee.
The scarf feels soft and light around your neck, yet keeps you surprisingly warm.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「Exe」专属角色时装「不逝于雨」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Exe Outfit: Untouched by Rain.

Description.SourceString:
特别的户外防水服饰，可能会导致被判定为雨夜的杀人鬼或死神一类的角色。
——洗刷不去的颜色所代表的是，绝不容许消逝的一切瞬间。
Description.LocalizedString:
An eye-catching waterproof outfit that could get you mistaken for a killer on a rainy night—or even the Grim Reaper.
—Colors that won't wash away, for moments we refuse to let fade.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「曳尔沐」专属角色时装「微风精灵」及「头像-微风精灵」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Elyms Outfit & Avatar: Windflower.

Description.SourceString:
去朋友家串门时穿的，清爽而舒适的休闲装扮。
戴上眼镜时整体印象会迷幻般地变调，感觉要开始讲课……或者是讲述一段新的、人与人的故事了。
Description.LocalizedString:
A fresh, comfortable casual outfit for dropping by a friend's place.
Add the glasses, and there's something almost dreamlike about the look—as though they're about to give a lecture… or tell another story about how people connect.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「曳尔沐」专属角色时装「千年虫之谜」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Elyms Outfit: Y2K Mystique.

Description.SourceString:
*使用并进入当前编队后，会改变界面表现。

一度流行过的复古未来时尚风潮。镭射！荧光！像素！怀旧科技制品！
「真好啊~人们以乐天的态度和欢悦的心情，『想象』着技术发展的绚丽未来——」
Description.LocalizedString:
*Changes the interface appearance when this outfit is equipped and its wearer is in your current lineup.

A throwback to a once-popular retro-futurist fashion trend. Holographic finishes! Fluorescent colors! Pixels! Retro tech!
"How wonderful! People once 'imagined' a dazzling, high-tech future with such hope and excitement—"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「曳尔沐」专属角色时装「花海追想」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Elyms Outfit: Drifting Petals.

Description.SourceString:
仿佛是在妖精居住的梦幻岛上会有的学园制服，一抹美妙的童话色彩。
「冬去春来，是时候和你最好的朋友结个伴，去踏青郊游如何~？」
Description.LocalizedString:
A school uniform straight out of Neverland, where fairies live—a little touch of storybook magic.
"Winter's over, and spring is here! Why not head out and enjoy it with your best friend?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「M1000」适用涂装「萌虎来袭-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Tiger Incoming!" livery for the M1000 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 柯林斯家族特供涂装，风驰电掣，全城制霸！用上这款涂装，你就是家族的一员了哦！
Description.LocalizedString: Colucci family exclusive livery. Lightning fast and ready to dominate the city! Slap this on your ride and you're one of the family!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Pursuit V8」适用涂装「萌虎来袭-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Tiger Incoming!" livery for the Pursuit V8 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 柯林斯家族特供涂装，风驰电掣，全城制霸！用上这款涂装，你就是家族的一员了哦！
Description.LocalizedString: Colucci family exclusive livery. Lightning fast and ready to dominate the city! Slap this on your ride and you're one of the family!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「LaVelox」适用外观「金风迎客来」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Golden Breeze" livery for the LaVelox vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 伊波恩特别联名外观，繁复纹饰如画卷般展开。起初，浔小姐对于将自己的形象用于车辆装饰一事十分抗拒。不过在得知联名报酬后，浔小姐愉快地答应了下来。
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive Eibon collaboration livery, with intricate patterns unfurling like a scroll. At first, Hotori rejected any attempt to use her likeness as decoration for a vehicle. However, the mention of collaboration profits quickly changed her mind.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Blizzard-V4」适用涂装「秋色残影-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Autumn Haze" livery for the Blizzard-V4 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 伊波恩特别联名涂装。车身的花纹由浔小姐亲自设计。
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive Eibon collaboration livery. The design was done by Hotori.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Pendragon」适用涂装「番茄酱巡航-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Ketchup Cruise" livery for the Pendragon vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 异象管理局特别联名涂装。黑色车身加以红色线条，使得整车宛如经过番茄酱洗礼。不知为何，在使用这款涂装之后，总觉得车上应该多装一些番茄酱……
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive Bureau of Anomaly Control collaboration livery. The black body and red lines make the entire car look like it's been doused in ketchup. For some reason, you feel like you might need more ketchup…

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Novis ST-X 950」适用涂装「猎犬奔袭-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Hound Blitz" livery for the Novis ST-X 950 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 「我之前还一直在担心，这玩意会不会把我的脸印上去……因为之前在大街上看到过别人的款式。幸好没有，这下我自己也能用上啦！这配色真帅啊！」
Description.LocalizedString: "I was actually kinda worried this thing would print my face on it… I’ve seen other people’s versions out on the street before. Thank god it doesn’t! Now I can finally use it myself! This colorway looks awesome!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Blizzard-V4」适用涂装「赤炎龙影」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Hidden Dragon" livery for the Blizzard-V4 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 紫红色的火焰在车身燃烧——本涂装的配色与花纹由真红本人选择。
Description.LocalizedString: Purple-red flames blaze across the car body. This livery's colors and patterns were chosen by Shinku herself.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「B100」适用涂装「我们仨-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Three's Company" livery for the B100 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 小羊有三只，收容二组的好朋友是三个。真巧呀~
Description.LocalizedString: Three little lambs, three best friends for CSU-2. Funny how that works.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「热风」适用涂装「白沙幻境-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Sandy Mirage" livery for the Sirocco vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 如同一片花瓣，落入茫茫白沙之中。
Description.LocalizedString: A petal falls into an endless sea of white sand.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「旧时光」适用涂装「高速运转的灵可」和饰件「兜个鬼风」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Turbo Linko" livery and "Ghost Ride" accessory for the Yesteryear vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 「出现了！小贞！我们的脸出现在车轮上了！」「臭小鬼，长这么大第一次见痛车吗？！」
Description.LocalizedString: "Look, Xiaozhen! There we are! Our faces are on the wheels!" "You little brat, is this seriously your first time seeing an itasha?!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「旧时光」适用涂装「夜色飞羽」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Nightplume" livery for the Yesteryear.

Description.SourceString: 黑色的鸟儿随你前行。没看到吗？明明它的羽毛散了一地……
Description.LocalizedString: A black bird follows you wherever you go. Can't see it? Look closer—its feathers are scattered all around you…

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「旧时光」适用涂装「音速流星」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Starbeat Rush" livery for the Yesteryear.

Description.SourceString: 脚踏板踩出动感的节奏，链条传动出美妙的旋律。
Description.LocalizedString: The pedals keep a lively beat as the chain carries the melody.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得滑翔翼皮肤「副手的副手」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Glider Skin "Underboss-of-the-Underboss".

Description.SourceString: 由娜娜莉设计的滑翔翼涂装。「我是副手的副手。现在我带着你滑翔，那么你就是副手的副手的副手！哈哈哈！」
Description.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed by Nanally. "I'm the underboss of the underboss. And since I'm the one gliding with you now, that makes you the underboss of the underboss of the underboss! Hahaha!"

Description.SourceString:
由浔设计的滑翔翼涂装，轻盈的纸伞很适合乘风而飞。
「起风了。」
Description.LocalizedString:
A glider livery designed by Hotori. Its delicate paper umbrella is perfect for riding the wind.
”The wind is rising.”

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「娜娜莉」专属角色时装「学园之星」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Nanally's exclusive outfit The Popular Kid.

Description.SourceString:
学院风格服装，兼顾美观与舒适。袖标由娜娜莉自行制作，本人对此颇为满意。
「咳咳，柯林斯有柯林斯的风纪！」
Description.LocalizedString:
School uniform style clothing that balances both beauty and comfort. The armband was handmade by Nanally herself, and she's quite satisfied with it.
"Ahem, Colucci has its own standards of discipline!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「零」专属角色时装「猎人不上班」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Zero's exclusive outfit Hunter Off Duty.

Description.SourceString:
俏皮又不失帅气的着装，层叠的衣衫和亮眼的配饰，尽显随性自由。
「一流的猎人，也该有一流的衣品~」
Description.LocalizedString:
Playful yet stylish attire with layers and eye-catching accessories, showcasing a carefree personality.
"A first-rate hunter should have first-rate fashion sense too!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「零」专属角色时装「城市漫游者」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Zero's exclusive outfit City Wanderer.

Description.SourceString: 轻便合身、简洁利落，永不出错的穿搭，帮助你轻松融入人群。
Description.LocalizedString: Light and fitted, clean and sharp styling that never goes wrong, helping you blend into crowds with ease.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「零」专属角色时装「学园随想」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Zero's exclusive outfit School Musings.

Description.SourceString:
学院风格着装，低调配色辅以经典花纹，彰显精致的优等生气质。
「明天的联谊会，要一起去吗？」
Description.LocalizedString:
Preppy academic attire with understated colors complemented by classic patterns, showcasing the refined aura of an honor student.
"Want to attend tomorrow's mixer together?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「零」专属角色时装「涂鸦进行时」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Zero's exclusive outfit Graffiti in Progress.

Description.SourceString: 充满童趣的背带裤套装，独特的印花图案与不对称设计，个性十足。就算身上溅到颜料，也会被当作印花的一部分。
Description.LocalizedString: A playful overalls set full of childlike charm, featuring unique printed patterns and an asymmetrical design with loads of personality. Even if you get paint splattered on it, it'll just look like part of the print.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「薄荷」专属角色时装「致玛丽」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Mint's exclusive outfit To Mary.

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「玛丽有只小黑猫，耳朵是母亲的，身体是父亲的，兄弟姐妹是它的四肢，无论玛丽走到哪里，它总是跟着跑。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Mary had a little black cat, with ears from her mother, a body from her father, and siblings as its limbs. Wherever Mary went, it would always follow along."

UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Sakiri's exclusive outfit Pumpkin Magic.

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「女巫有一片南瓜地，里面有会魔法的干干净净的南瓜，和不会魔法的麻麻赖赖的南瓜。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"A witch had a pumpkin field with squeaky clean magical pumpkins, and scruffy non-magical pumpkins."

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「从前在森林里有一只孤单的小灰狼，为了交到朋友，它带上了丝绒做的红斗篷。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Once upon a time, there was a lonely little gray wolf in the forest who donned a velvet red cape, hoping to make friends."

Description.SourceString:
以鬼兰花为主题的高级定制套装，这套在影楼非常容易出效果。
不过从价格角度来考虑的话，大概只有在伊波恩开店前、资金还充裕的那时候才有商量余地。
Description.LocalizedString: A custom couture outfit themed after the Ghost Orchid, purchased when Hotori still had plenty of startup funds after opening her shop.As for later… even after selling her car, she never once considered parting with this piece. She must really love it.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「小吱」专属角色时装「青竹猗猗」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Chiz Outfit: Verdant Grace.

Description.SourceString:
粉爪银行某年年会的表演着装，彼时的乔望尼先生正异常沉迷这种黑白色生物。
「我、我们银行是要和胖达火锅联名吗……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Performance outfit from Pink Paws Bank's annual annual gala. At the time, Mr. Giovanni had developed an unusual fascination with a particular black-and-white animal 
"Are we… are we partnering with Panda Hotpot now?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「达芙蒂尔」专属角色时装「都市浮光」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Daffodill Outfit: City Glimmer.

Description.SourceString: 浔自费购入的衣装，用以改善小水仙沉闷的衣柜，达芙蒂尔为此新买了五个不同的眼罩用来搭配它。
Description.LocalizedString: Hotori personally purchased this outfit to brighten up Daff's rather dull wardrobe. In response, Daffodill bought five different eye patches just to match it.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「安魂曲」专属角色时装「旧忆挽歌」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Lacrimosa Outfit: Yesterday's Melody.

Description.SourceString:
颓废华丽的盛装，适合在出席古堡晚宴时穿着。
「夜空倾覆而下，浸透庭园里的玫瑰。多年之后，她们仍静默地绽放，而故事的后文终究无人知晓。」
Description.LocalizedString:
A decadent, ornate formal dress, perfect for a castle banquet.
"The night sky poured over the garden, soaking its roses in muted darkness. Years later, those flowers still bloom in silence, and the rest of the story has faded into shadow."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「安魂曲」专属角色时装「黑白童谣」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Lacrimosa Outfit: Piano Key Sonatina.

Description.SourceString:
就像夜与昼一样，这世上黑白分明的东西有很多：浓缩咖啡与拿铁咖啡，奶牛猫与牛奶猫，钢琴的黑键与白键，日常打扮的安魂曲和偶尔换上白裙子出门的安魂曲。
「白裙子，很好看。但是，容易弄脏……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Like night and day, some things in this world are simply black and white: espresso and latte, tuxedo cats and white cats, piano keys, Lacrimosa's everyday outfit, and the white dress she wears only once in a while.
"White dresses are pretty. But… they get dirty so easily."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「安魂曲」专属角色时装「鎏金交响诗」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Lacrimosa Outfit: Gilded Rhapsody.

Description.SourceString: 闪耀之物往往很沉重。今天上班路上总觉得比往日飞得更累，或许不是安魂曲的错觉。
Description.LocalizedString: Things that shine are often heavy. Lacrimosa feels unusually tired flying to work today. Maybe it isn't just her imagination.

Description.LocalizedString: A sharply tailored racing suit, as irreplaceable as the partner at your side.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Shinku Outfit: Dragonhunter.

Description.SourceString: 万千风暴向心口收束，猎龙之人将踏上她的征途。
Description.LocalizedString: Countless storms gather in her heart, and the dragonhunter sets forth on her quest.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「真红」专属角色时装染色「猎龙者·炽日」。

每一个占卜之人都渴望解明万物的隐喻，命运于她而言，恰似天幕中不歇流转的繁星。
「于穹顶万千星座中，我窥见你与我辉映的命运。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Those who read the stars spend their lives searching for meaning in every sign. To her, destiny is written in the endless dance of the heavens.
"Among all the stars above, I saw yours and mine bound to the same fate."

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Shinku Outfit: Dawn Patrol.

Description.SourceString:
"昭示着好胜心的专业竞赛泳装。海滨似乎总有让人变得坦率的魔力，又或者在水中破开浪潮的畅快感也推了一把。
「在享受夏日这件事上也要全力以赴。」"
Description.LocalizedString:
A pro-grade racing swimsuit that reveals her competitive spirit. The beach has a way of drawing out one's true self—or perhaps that is simply the thrill of cutting through the waves.
"Go all out—even when you’re enjoying summer."

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Iroi Outfit & Avatar: Summer Dream.

Description.LocalizedString: The Coluccis are expanding into open waters, and Captain Nanally is ready to set sail! All aboard, for the family!

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive recolored Iroi Outfit: Archmage - Ashenveil.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Iroi Outfit & Avatar: Dreamweaver.

Description.SourceString:
她将群星编入梦境。
一片宇宙的重量，对于睡着的伊洛伊来说刚刚好。
Description.LocalizedString:
She weaves the stars into the dreamscape.
As Iroi sleeps, the weight of a universe rests lightly upon her.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「伊洛伊」专属角色时装染色「织梦者·熔流」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive recolored Iroi Outfit: Dreamweaver - Emberflow.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive recolored Iroi Outfit: Dreamweaver - Tidesong.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Shinku Outfit: Normie Heroine.

Description.SourceString: 真红低着头，试图在人群中隐去身影一一毕竟，只要没人靠近，就不会有人受伤，对吧?
Description.LocalizedString: Shinku kept her head lowered, trying to vanish into the crowd. After all, if no one came close, then no one would get hurt… right?

UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Iroi's limited recolored outfits: Channeling… - Flameheart, Channeling… - Suncrest, and Channeling… - Wildwood.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「M1000」适用涂装「特工驾到-涂装」和饰件「特工驾到-车顶饰件」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained the Livery: Agent Arrival and Roof Accessory: Agent Arrival for Vehicle: M1000.

Description.SourceString: 《特工Z世代》联名款涂装，靓丽特工，随你穿行于都市人潮间！
Description.LocalizedString: "Gen Z" collab livery—stylish agents ready to cruise through the bustling city streets with you!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Blizzard-V4」适用涂装「焚天上乘」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Heavenfire Supreme" livery for the Blizzard-V4 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 「迦楼罗」成员自主设计的涂装。火焰燎燃，烧尽世间一切罪恶与不公。
Description.LocalizedString: A livery designed by Garuda members, with blazing flames that purge the world of evil and injustice.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「ST79」适用涂装「薄荷出击！-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Mint Rush" livery for the ST79 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 异象管理局特别联名涂装。薄荷，想要陪你走过每一道风景！
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive Bureau of Anomaly Control collaboration livery. Mint wishes to join you on all your adventures!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Griffin」适用涂装「暗夜玫瑰-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Midnight Rose" livery for the Griffin vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 斯特利速递特别联名涂装。低调沉稳的蓝色与金色交织，不张扬，却也绝不平庸。
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive Sterry Express collaboration livery. A subtle combination of blue and gold that draws the eye of any passerby.

ItemName.SourceString: 伊波恩的蓝色幽影-涂装

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Blizzard-V4」适用涂装「伊波恩的蓝色幽影-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Eibon's Blue Phantom" livery for the Blizzard-V4 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 伊波恩特别联名涂装。在浔小姐的热情推荐下，我们制作了此款达芙蒂尔形象涂装。达芙蒂尔小姐本人并未对此作出任何评价。
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive Eibon collaboration livery. It was Hotori who mentioned using daffodils. Daffodil herself has yet to comment on it.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Rover A1」适用涂装「出发咯早雾大人！-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Sakiri Roll! " livery for the Rover A1 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 伊波恩特别联名涂装。车身的贴纸由早雾亲自设计（鬼郎丸贴纸除外）。
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive Eibon collaboration livery. The decals were personally designed by Sakiri (excluding the Kiroumaru sticker).

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Porsche 918 Spyder」适用涂装「红与紫-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Rose & Violet" livery for the Porsche 918 Spyder vehicle.

Description.SourceString: Porsche 918 Spyder特供涂装，红龙的利爪撕开黑夜。
Description.LocalizedString: An exclusive livery for the Porsche 918 Spyder. The red dragon's claws tear open the night.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Porsche 918 Spyder」适用涂装「番茄酱冲刺-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Tomato Dash" livery for the Porsche 918 Spyder vehicle.

Description.SourceString: Porsche 918 Spyder特供涂装，驰骋在番茄酱的海洋中吧！
Description.LocalizedString: An exclusive livery for the Porsche 918 Spyder. Race through a sea of ketchup!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「Tide」适用涂装「乱花影-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Petal Blaze" livery for the Tide vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 船身的焰火无言燃烧。
Description.LocalizedString: Fireworks burn endlessly across the hull.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「坦途」适用涂装「积木装甲-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Brick Armor" livery for the Iron Ogre vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 坐上小时候的玩具车吧！——仅对外观作出调整，并不影响其材质与性能，敬请放心。
Description.LocalizedString: Relive your childhood behind the wheel of a toy car! Don't worry—this skin only changes the vehicle's appearance, not its materials or performance.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「坦途」适用涂装「小心涂鸦-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Caution: Graffiti!" livery for the Iron Ogre vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 「开着这个出门，不会被当成涂鸦怪吧？」
Description.LocalizedString: "Won't people mistake me for a Graffiti Goof if I drive this around?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「坦途」适用烟囱烟雾「粉色幻影」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the Petal Blush exhaust smoke effect for Iron Ogre.

Description.SourceString: 改变「坦途」车身后方烟囱的烟雾颜色与效果。
Description.LocalizedString: Changes the color and appearance of the smoke from Iron Ogre's rear exhaust stack.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「坦途」适用烟囱烟雾「纯白雾汽」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the Pastel Haze exhaust smoke effect for Iron Ogre.

Description.SourceString: 改变「坦途」车身后方烟囱的烟雾颜色与效果。
Description.LocalizedString: Changes the color and appearance of the smoke from Iron Ogre's rear exhaust stack.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「坦途」适用烟囱烟雾「幽蓝烟尘」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the Azure Mystery exhaust smoke effect for Iron Ogre.

Description.SourceString: 改变「坦途」车身后方烟囱的烟雾颜色与效果。
Description.LocalizedString: Changes the color and appearance of the smoke from Iron Ogre's rear exhaust stack.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「M1000」适用涂装「跃迁光影-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Warp Light" livery for the M1000 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: TapTap联名款涂装，和TapFamily一起开启穿梭次元的冒险~
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive TapTap collaboration livery. Team up with TapFamily and dive into a dimension-hopping adventure!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得载具「M1000」适用涂装「干杯启程-涂装」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the "Cheers to Departure" livery for the M1000 vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 哔哩哔哩游戏中心专属限定涂装，以干杯之名，和小电视一同奔赴未知的冒险！
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive Bilibili Game Center collaboration livery—In the wake of cheers and applause, venture into the unknown with Bilibili!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得滑翔翼皮肤「秩序守护者EX型」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Glider Skin "Order Guardian EX".

Description.SourceString: 以巡哨鼠鼠的座驾为原型设计的滑翔翼涂装。「滴嘟滴嘟，空中秩序维持中……话说回来，这是滑翔翼吧？这些轮子是干什么用的？」
Description.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed after Officer Whisker's vehicle. "Wee-woo, wee-woo! Maintaining order in the skies… Wait, this is a glider, right? What are these wheels even for?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得滑翔翼皮肤「王牌」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtain Glider Skin Ace.

Description.SourceString: 以巡哨鼠鼠为原型设计的滑翔翼涂装。鼠鼠强而有力的尾巴，在空中为你保驾护航。
Description.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed after Officer Whisker. Its powerful tail keeps you safe as you soar through the skies.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「零」专属角色时装「非常规衣着」及「头像-非常规衣着」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Zero Outfit & Avatar: Unconventional Attire.

Description.SourceString: 绝大多数人这辈子都不想再看见这抹橙色，但你不同。你发现它的布料结实又耐磨，而且穿着它走在街上，路人的眼神会都礼貌几分。最重要的是：它是你从那所名为「教训」的学校领到的毕业证，时刻提醒着你，要珍惜并非理所当然的自由。
Description.LocalizedString: Most people never want to see this shade of orange again for the rest of their lives, but you're different. You've found that the fabric is tough and durable, and when you walk down the street wearing it, other's gazes tend to be a bit more… polite. Most importantly, it's your diploma from the school called "Hard Lessons," a constant reminder to cherish the freedom that should never be taken for granted.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「薄荷」专属角色时装「悠闲假日」及「头像-悠闲假日」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Mint Outfit & Avatar: Leisurely Holiday.

Description.SourceString:
薄荷的居家服装。简单的服饰，彰显居家的随性与放松。
「休息日，当然要宅在家里睡大觉！」
Description.LocalizedString:
Mint's loungewear. Simple clothing that showcases the carefree and relaxed spirit of being a homebody.
"There's nothing better than staying home and sleeping in on a day off!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「法帝娅」专属角色时装「夜色秘辛」及「头像-夜色秘辛」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Fadia Outfit & Avatar: Tales of the Night.

Description.SourceString:
法帝娅的居家服装。比起穿着舒适度，她更希望用衣装点缀夜色。
「黑夜会替我们保守秘密。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Fadia's loungewear. Rather than prioritizing comfort, she prefers to use clothing to complement the night.
"The darkness will keep our secrets."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「九原」专属角色时装「自律时间」及「头像-自律时间」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Jiuyuan Outfit & Avatar: Self-Discipline Time.

Description.SourceString:
九原的居家服装。看似简单的衣装，也经由设计师精心设计。
「吸气……呼气……舒展身体，让心情平静……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Jiuyuan's loungewear. Though it looks simple, this outfit was carefully tailored by a designer.
"Breathe in… breathe out… stretch your body, let your mind find peace…"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「娜娜莉」专属角色时装「绵绵飞虎」及「头像-绵绵飞虎」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Nanally Outfit & Avatar: Fluffy Flying Tiger.

Description.SourceString:
娜娜莉的居家服装。在简单衣裙的基础上添加了富有巧思的装饰。
「正所谓如虎添翼，老虎和翅膀就是绝配！」
Description.LocalizedString:
Nanally's loungewear. Thoughtful decorations have been added to a simple dress.
"Ever heard of 'adding wings to a tiger'? Tigers and wings are a perfect combo!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「浔」专属角色时装「闲满庭」及「头像-闲满庭」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Hotori Outfit & Avatar: Recreational Courtyard.

Description.SourceString:
浔的居家服装。宽松轻便的打扮，躲闲时还是舒服最重要。
「惊鹿一声响。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Hotori's loungewear. Comfortable and lightweight—when lying around the house, comfort is paramount.
"Soft birdsong in the morning."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「小吱」专属角色时装「绒绒春日」及「头像-绒绒春日」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Chiz Outfit & Avatar: Velvet Spring Day.

Description.SourceString:
小吱的居家服装。柔软亲肤的面料，休假时间就该舒舒服服地待在家里啊。
「虽然明天也不出门，但请……请出太阳吧！」
Description.LocalizedString:
Chiz's loungewear. Soft, skin-friendly material—staying at home is the right way to spend a day off.
"I'm not going out tomorrow either, but… I hope the sun still comes out!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「安魂曲」专属角色时装「新月摇篮曲」及「头像-新月摇篮曲」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Lacrimosa Outfit & Avatar: New Moon Lullaby.

Description.SourceString:
安魂曲的居家服装。布料柔软舒适，支持随时随地倒头就睡。
「一只蝙蝠……两只蝙蝠……三……呼……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Lacrimosa's loungewear. Made of soft, cozy fabric that lets you fall asleep anytime, anywhere.
"One bat… two bats… three… zzz…"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「卡厄斯」专属角色时装「保持锻炼」及「头像-保持锻炼」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Chaos Outfit & Avatar: Never Skip.

Description.SourceString: 即使是休息日，也不能松懈锻炼！
Description.LocalizedString: Even on days off, training never stops!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「真红」专属角色时装「迷宫屋主」及「头像-迷宫屋主」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Shinku Outfit & Avatar: Labyrinth Lily.

Description.SourceString:
真红的居家服装，打定主意要在自己的收藏围绕下不受打扰地度过一阵悠闲时光时的打扮。龙的决心不容挑战。
「……不行。今天已经决定了，无论如何都不出门。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Shinku's loungewear for quiet days spent idling undisturbed among her treasures. Once a dragon has made up her mind, no force can shake her resolve.
"…No. I've already decided. I'm not going out today, no matter what."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「伊洛伊」专属角色时装「星月夜」及「头像-星月夜」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Iroi Outfit & Avatar: Starlit Night.

Description.SourceString: 月亮坠落了一千次。只有一千次而已吗？
Description.LocalizedString: The moon has fallen a thousand times. Has it truly been only a thousand?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「残虹」专属角色时装「月下闲庭」及「头像-月下闲庭」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Zankou Outfit & Avatar: Moonlit Courtyard.

Description.SourceString:
残虹的居家服装。宽松的浴袍搭配木屐，适合做一场无人打扰的长梦。
「夜色漫长啊，今夜又会发生什么呢？」
Description.LocalizedString:
Zankou's loungewear. A loose robe and wooden clogs, perfect for drifting into a long, uninterrupted dream.
"The night's still young… I wonder what it has in store."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得「灵可」专属角色时装「待机状态」及「头像-待机状态」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants the exclusive Linko Outfit & Avatar: Couch Potato.

Description.SourceString:
灵可的居家服装。简单宽松的版型，让每一次伸懒腰都毫无负担。
「如果灵感来敲门，当然要穿得方便一点去开门。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Linko's loungewear. The loose, comfy fit gives her plenty of room to stretch.
"When inspiration comes knocking, you have to be ready to answer."

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可播放音乐。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Plays music.

Description.SourceString: 方盒随身听，出门时别忘记带上一盒音乐。
Description.LocalizedString: Cubox Portable Player. Don't forget to bring a tape of music when you head out.

UseContext.SourceString: 完成环期任务获得的经验，可用于提升环期赏令等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: EXP earned from completing Circle Quests can be used to increase your Circle Bounty Rank.

Description.SourceString: 悬赏 X 历练 X 最强的异象猎人。
Description.LocalizedString: Bounty X Training X The Strongest Anomaly Hunter.

UseContext.SourceString: 完成环期任务获得的经验，可用于提升环期赏令等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: EXP earned from completing Circle Quests can be used to increase your Circle Bounty Rank.

Description.SourceString: 悬赏 X 历练 X 最强的异象猎人。
Description.LocalizedString: Bounty X Training X The Strongest Anomaly Hunter.

UseContext.SourceString: 首次完成高危委托后获得的奖赏勋章，可前往「勋章商店」兑换所需道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: A reward medal obtained after completing your first high-risk commission. Can be exchanged for items at the "Medal Shop"

Description.SourceString: 每一次胜利都值得嘉奖……冷冰冰的勋章可以换成毛绒绒的绵糖吗？
Description.LocalizedString: Every victory deserves recognition… but could these cold, hard medals be traded for fluffy cotton candy instead?

UseContext.SourceString: 在「轨外之境」收集的幽灵号行车日志，可在「异境回收站」兑换各种奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Ghost Train Logs collected in Beyond the Rails can be exchanged for various rewards at the Otherworld Salvage Station.

Description.SourceString: 列车员「浮游小姐」遗落的行车日志，其中记载了幽灵号在轨外之境运行期间的重要信息。将拾获的行车日志交给「异境回收站」的负责人，协助其开展对幽灵号的管理和研究工作，是异象猎人赚外快的一种途径。
Description.LocalizedString: A train log left behind by Miss Levi, the conductor. It contains important information about the Ghost Train's operations in Beyond the Rails. Turning in collected train logs to the manager of the Otherworld Salvage Station helps Anomaly Hunters assist with Ghost Train management and research, and earn some extra cash.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从特级猎人攻略*15、超屑井主*15、混沌染剂*15、甲硬币*150000中选择1个。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants one from the following: Elite Hunter Guide ×15, Manhole Boss ×15, Chaotic Dye ×15, or Beetle Coin ×150,000.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可从资深猎人攻略*15、井屑达人*15、无彩染剂*15、甲硬币*35000中选择1个。

UseContext.LocalizedString: Reveals all Oracle Stones within a certain range. A maximum of 3 can exist simultaneously.

Description.SourceString: 那是干枯眼眶中流下的泪水，加上悔和恨在灰烬中凝聚而成水晶，只有这样才能看见迷茫的灵魂。
Description.LocalizedString: These are tears shed from withered eye sockets, crystallized with regret and hatred among the ashes. Only through this can one see lost souls…

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可以召唤「起司」，快门一响，万物定格，时光停驻，静默一切。但把世界定格成静止照片的效果仅有一次，绝无重拍机会。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons Cheese. Snap the shutter, and the world freezes—time stops, and silence falls. This "still photograph" effect can only be used once. No retakes.

Description.SourceString: 「起司」外形酷似照相机，按下快门时，可使拍摄范围内所有生物都瞬间陷入「时间停滞」状态——身体无法移动，意识陷入沉寂，恍若被囚禁于一帧静止的画面中。起司是一次性异象，使用后会立刻泯除，普通人受「起司」影响严重，定格时间可长达数十小时，且事后完全丧失记忆，只能模糊记起刺眼的闪光灯。部分异能者仅会被定格住几分钟，且能清晰回忆起拍摄前的全部细节，包括相机持有者的身份。因其潜在用途包括暗杀、逃脱和挟制，普通人无缘得见，现主要流通于地下市场的悬赏交易中。
Description.LocalizedString: Cheese looks just like a camera, but when you press the shutter, it instantly freezes all living beings within the shooting range in a state of time suspension. Their bodies cannot move and their consciousness falls silent, as if trapped within a single frozen frame. Cheese is a one-time-use Anomaly that immediately disappears after use. Ordinary people are severely affected by Cheese, with freeze duration lasting up to dozens of hours, and they completely lose their memory afterward, only vaguely recalling a blinding flash. Some Espers are only frozen for a few minutes and can clearly recall all details before the shot, including the identity of the camera holder. Due to its potential uses including assassination, escape, and hostage situations, ordinary people have no access to it, and it currently circulates mainly in underground market bounty trades.

UseContext.SourceString: 用于切换表里世界的开关，交互后会切换到另外一个世界，用另一个视角观察世界或许会有新的发现。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A switch for toggling between the surface and hidden worlds. Interacting with it will switch to another world. Observing the world from a different view might lead to new discoveries.

Description.SourceString: 一个看起来普普通通的开关，按下吧，按下吧，将世界的表里一一看清。
Description.LocalizedString: An ordinary-looking switch. Press it, press it, and see both sides of the world.

UseContext.SourceString: 在「粉爪大劫案」玩法中可获得的积分，达到一定积分后可领取对应奖励。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Credit earned in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Reach certain credit thresholds to claim corresponding rewards.

Description.SourceString: 表现得太好有时候等于表现得不太好。
Description.LocalizedString: Sometimes performing too well is the same as not performing well enough.

UseContext.SourceString: 「浮游小姐」整日穿梭于异象空间，难免会落下几片珍贵的羽毛。若能拾起这些羽毛交还给她，想必会收到她的谢礼。不过归还时，千万不要过问她掉落这么多羽毛是否会影响毛量……即使是出于关心。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Miss Levi spends her days traveling through the Anomalous Realms, so she's bound to drop a few precious feathers along the way. If you can collect these feathers and return them to her, you'll receive a thank-you gift in return. However, when returning them, whatever you do, don't ask whether losing so many feathers affects her plumage… even if you mean well.

Description.SourceString: 可在异境补给站兑换「浮游小姐的谢礼」
Description.LocalizedString: Can be exchanged for "Miss Levi's Thank-You Gift" at the Otherworld Supply Stop

Description.SourceString:
「天选猎人才知道的行业秘则！异象、测验与记事本。」
——这是一份「呗果」上收藏10000+的猎人攻略，没有认真的猎人，没有准备好的弧盘，没有帅气的异能，只剩下「在都市接连收服高级异象小弟」的轻小说日常，收藏量很高大概是因为猎人们都想被幸运眷顾吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
"How I Became The Chosen Hunter - Anomalies, Tests, And Notes"
—This is a hunter's guide with over 10,000 bookmarks on Bagel. No serious hunters, no powerful arcs, no flashy Espers, just a slice-of-life light novel about taming high threat Anomalies into minions around the city. The high bookmark count is probably because hunters wish to be blessed by such luck.

The photo on the card is a candid shot taken by a colleague during her onboarding photoshoot. She only gives this card to those close to her. A reminder to all who join the company: Pink Paws Bank Employee Code, Rule #1: Romantic.

UseContext.SourceString: 养成消耗的基础货币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Basic currency for character and item upgrades.

Description.SourceString: 一种弱小到处在食物链底端的生物类异象，形似一只小小的甲壳虫，为求生存会在城市中拟态成硬币外观与碰撞声响等待被人捡起，在流通中寻找更好的生机。
Description.LocalizedString: A Bio Anomaly shaped like a small beetle, which is weak and at the bottom of the food chain. To survive in the city, it transforms into a coin upon the sound of collision, lying in wait to be picked up and thereby stands a better chance of survival through circulation.

UseContext.SourceString: 食堂配发的金属汤匙，结实耐用，但多次用于挖掘后也可能断裂。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A metal spoon issued by the cafeteria. Sturdy and durable, but may break after repeated digging attempts.

Description.SourceString: 不少在押人员坚信：「得汤匙者得自由。」正因如此，食堂的汤匙常常不翼而飞，其流失率堪比医生的蓝色签字笔。但显然，真正靠一把汤匙逃出生天的例子寥寥无几。合理怀疑，默许人们持有汤匙，或许正是管教用来消磨在押人员出逃积极性的潜在策略之一。
Description.LocalizedString: Many inmates firmly believe that "he who holds the spoon holds freedom." Because of this, cafeteria spoons vanish constantly, at a rate rivaling that of doctors' blue pens. Obviously, the number of successful spoon-based escapes is next to none. One might reasonably suspect that allowing inmates to keep spoons is actually a deliberate strategy by the guards to drain their enthusiasm for escape attempts.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后可以兑换30,000方斯
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to exchange for 30,000 Fons

Description.SourceString: 由粉爪银行发行的特别纪念币，颇具收藏价值，当然需要的时候也可以将这些可爱的金币兑换成真正的方斯。
Description.LocalizedString: Special commemorative coins issued by Pink Paws Bank, quite valuable for collection. Of course, when needed, these cute gold coins can also be exchanged for real Fons.

UseContext.SourceString: 一份关于特殊患者的转诊记录，涉及一位患有未知怪病的患者……
UseContext.LocalizedString: A transfer record for a special patient, about someone suffering from an unknown illness…

Description.SourceString: 「患者出现明显焦虑情绪及异常行为，其坚持用绷带自行紧缚患处，拒绝摘下，并对光、声刺激极其敏感……」
Description.LocalizedString: "The patient exhibited significant anxiety and abnormal behavior, insisting on tightly binding the affected areas with bandages and refusing to remove them. Patient also shows extreme sensitivity to visual and auditory stimuli."

UseContext.SourceString: 一份诊室内的通讯记录。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A communication record from the examination room.

Description.SourceString: 「既然病人是你接手，这次就由你代我们科室出面了，V。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Since you're handling the patient, you'll represent our department this time, V."

UseContext.SourceString: 一份手术室的事故记录。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An incident report from the operating room.

Description.SourceString: 「发生严重事故，患者术中苏醒，并███；推测原因为██试图摘取捆缚患者肢体的绷带。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Serious incident occurred. Patient regained consciousness during surgery and ███. Suspected cause: ██ attempted to remove bandages binding the patient's limbs."

UseContext.SourceString: 一封已寄出的邮件，落款写着N。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A sent email, signed by N.

Description.SourceString: 「……我不知道V在手术室里经历了什么，我只庆幸他还能派上用场，不然的话，恐怕得轮到我去接手这一群可怕的怪物了。」
Description.LocalizedString: "…I don't know what V went through in there. I'm just relieved he can still be of use. Otherwise, I'd be the one who has to take over dealing with these terrifying freaks."

UseContext.SourceString: 一封告密信。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An anonymous tip-off letter.

Description.SourceString: 「……事态紧急，恳请您立即介入调查，并对V采取隔离与控制措施。」
Description.LocalizedString: "…This is an emergency. I implore you to intervene immediately and implement isolation and containment measures for V!"

UseContext.SourceString: 一份药房内的监听文件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A surveillance file from the pharmacy.

Description.SourceString:
「V的忠诚度有待进一步观察，且疑似已对监视有所察觉，需更换更隐蔽的方式。
将确保实验进行，请您放心。」
Description.LocalizedString:
"V's loyalty requires further observation. Subject may have become aware of surveillance. Recommend switching to more covert methods.
Will ensure the experiment proceeds. Rest assured."

UseContext.SourceString: 一份监控记录，摄像头捕捉到了一个深夜的可疑人员。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A surveillance log. The camera captured a suspicious individual late at night.

Description.SourceString: 「已确认为实验员V，将就此事进行讯问。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Confirmed to be Researcher V. An interrogation will be conducted regarding this matter."

UseContext.SourceString: 一份工作日志，记录了储水间管理员的抱怨和得到的回复。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A work log documenting a complaint from the water storage room manager and the response received.

Description.SourceString: 「能不能别让203病房那个绑绷带的疯子靠近水阀？我们为他花了好多维修费了！」
Description.LocalizedString: "Could someone please keep an eye on that bandaged lunatic in Room 203 and stop him from getting near the water valves? He's costing us a fortune in repairs!"

UseContext.SourceString: 一份实验品逃逸的事故处理简报。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An incident report on the escape of test subjects.

Description.SourceString: 「护理部应急小组介入后，于02:10前控制所有逃逸实验品。」
Description.LocalizedString: "After the Nursing Department's emergency response team intervened, all escaped test subjects were contained by 02:10."

UseContext.SourceString: 一份通讯记录……
UseContext.LocalizedString: A communication record…

Description.SourceString: 「未能保全冷山医院是我部门的失职，本次行动，护理部将不惜一切代价。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Failure to secure Coldmount Hospital is a dereliction of duty by this department. In this operation, the Nursing Department will spare no cost."

UseContext.SourceString: 一份随意的日志。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A casual journal entry.

Description.SourceString: 「N主任似乎搭上了个大客户，院长特批了一笔资金，为他们建立了一个专项研究小组……」
Description.LocalizedString: "Director N seems to have landed a big client. The hospital director approved a special budget to establish a dedicated research group for them…"

Description.LocalizedString: A soft, harmless little creature with a belly so round its feet can't touch the ground… Congratulations, you just roasted a Twisty.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：累累硕果
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Bountiful Garden

Description.SourceString: 「美丽的，可怜的小花瓣儿，快到妈妈的花园里来，这里没有痛苦，没有悲伤……没有未来。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Pitiful little petal, come to Mother's garden. There is no pain here, no sorrow, no… future."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：独家风景
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Elite Viewpoint

Description.SourceString: 「这可是只有本老大才能找到的，绝佳的观景点！」
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive boss-level vantage point. Don't even think about trying to find it yourself!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：绘本的一页
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Storybook Page

Description.SourceString: 从前森林里有一个爱穿红外套的小女孩，因此大家都叫她「安魂曲」。
Description.LocalizedString: Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived in the forest and loved wearing a red coat. Everyone called her "Lacrimosa."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：夏日进行时
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Summer Time

Description.SourceString: 「这一次，你的选择是什么？」
Description.LocalizedString: "What will you chose this time?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：浪花大作战
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Splash Showdown

Description.SourceString: 太阳！沙滩！海浪！还有最最最最最重要的伙伴！
Description.LocalizedString: Sun! Sand! Waves! And, don't forget, our most, most, most important companions!

Description.SourceString: 以「邂逅~银月圆舞会」中的高人气角色浅绯祈为原型设计的玩偶，做工细腻，布料考究，渐变色的涂装宛若月光下轻盈的圆舞曲，让人一见倾心。
Description.LocalizedString: This doll, inspired by the popular character Asahi Inori from "Fleeting—A Gala under the Moonlight", features exquisite craftsmanship and high-quality fabric. Its gradient livery mimics a graceful moonlit waltz, making it instantly captivating.

UseContext.SourceString: 「活化石」特制的麻痹药，注射后会让人陷入难以查明原因的深度昏迷。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A paralytic drug specially made by Living Fossil. After injection, it induces a deep coma with a cause that's nearly impossible to determine.

Description.SourceString: 只需一小滴，就足以让你的身体呈现出完美的「多脏器衰竭」假象，骗过拘留所医务室那些过时的检测器材。切勿过量使用，以免连海特洛市立医院都对你束手无策，让你在来得及苏醒前就被推进某些……对活人来说不太妙的地方。
Description.LocalizedString: Just a single drop is enough to make your body display a convincing case of "multiple organ failure," fooling the outdated equipment in the detention center's infirmary. Don't use more than directed, or even Hethereau Municipal Hospital won't be able to help you. You'll be wheeled off to somewhere… not so great for the living, before you even get a chance to wake up.

UseContext.SourceString: 治安所岗楼的钥匙，可以打开岗楼大门，通向楼顶。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Key to the Detention Center watchtower. Unlocks the gate to reach the rooftop.

Description.SourceString: 这把小小的钥匙是通往治安拘留所最高处的唯一凭证。在这座拘留所里，高处就意味着视野，而视野则意味着自由——站在那里，高墙铁网外的荒野与海看起来触手可及。又或许，对你来说，它们真的触手可及。
Description.LocalizedString: A small key granting access to the Detention Center's top. Up here, you can see beyond the walls, the wilderness and the sea feel almost within reach. Perhaps, for you, they truly are.

UseContext.SourceString: 海特洛市治安拘留所监室中配发的床单。撕裂床单，可以获得布条。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A bed sheet issued in the cells of Hethereau Detention Center. Tear it apart to get cloth strips.

Description.SourceString: 粗糙如砂纸，坚硬如像钢板。每个躺在上面的夜晚，它所造成的痛苦都会让你更深刻地反省自己的罪行。
Description.LocalizedString: Rough as sandpaper and hard as a steel plate. Every night you spend lying on it, the pain will help you reflect more deeply on your crimes.

UseContext.SourceString: 海特洛市治安拘留所在押人员配发的拘留服。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A jumpsuit issued to detainees at the Hethereau Detention Center.

Description.SourceString: 拘留所统一服装，版型合身、面料舒适、颜色亮眼，要是平常也能穿的话……
Description.LocalizedString: Standard detention center uniform with a well-fitted cut, comfortable fabric, and bright colors. If only I could wear it normally…

UseContext.SourceString: 某种高腐蚀性消毒剂的原液，浓度足以腐蚀金属。
UseContext.LocalizedString: The undiluted form of a highly corrosive disinfectant. Concentrated enough to corrode metal.

Description.SourceString: 这种消毒液通常需要稀释后使用，用以清除伤口的感染源。但如果未经稀释，直接使用，或许也能清除某些在押人员逃离路上的障碍。
Description.LocalizedString: This disinfectant is typically diluted before use to clear infections from wounds. Though if used undiluted, it might also help clear certain obstacles for inmates looking to escape.

UseContext.SourceString: <!>非常趁手,能轻而易举击晕巡鼠哨哨
UseContext.LocalizedString: <!>非常趁手,能轻而易举击晕巡鼠哨哨

UseContext.SourceString: 印刷拙劣的盗版漫画，可用于交换物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A poorly printed bootleg manga. Can be used for trading.

Description.SourceString: 因盗版而获刑的人，在拘留所里也很难不重操旧业。这些盗版杂志虽然颜色诡异，还充斥着各种错别字，但至少让人们在铁窗内依旧可以追更。
Description.LocalizedString: People locked up for piracy can hardly resist going back to their old ways, even behind bars. These bootleg magazines may have weird colors and plenty of typos, but at least they let inmates keep up with their favorite series.

UseContext.SourceString: 拘留所的全能清洁冠军，某些有洁癖的在押人员很需要。可用于交换物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: The all-around cleaning champion of the detention center. Highly sought after by germaphobe inmates. Can be traded for items.

Description.SourceString: 干燥时像块石头，沾水后像条泥鳅。要是抓不牢，它转眼间就会溜进排水沟。
Description.LocalizedString: Hard as a rock when dry, slippery as an eel when wet. If you don't hold on tight, it'll slip down the drain before you know it.

UseContext.SourceString: 一副旧纸牌，似乎多几张或少几张也无人在意。可用于交换物品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An old deck of cards. Nobody seems to mind if there are a few extra or missing. Can be traded for items.

Description.SourceString: 拘留所里最有效的交际工具，也是不少人被关禁闭的直接原因。放轻松，这只是个游戏！
Description.LocalizedString: The most effective social tool in the detention center, and also the direct cause of many landing in solitary. Relax, it's just a game!

UseContext.SourceString: 一台老旧游戏机，能带来难以估量的精神慰藉。有些在押人员或许愿意用珍藏的宝贝来换一台。
UseContext.LocalizedString: An old handheld console that can bring immeasurable comfort to the soul. Some inmates might be willing to trade their treasured belongings for one.

Description.SourceString: 满是划痕的塑料外壳，证明它在无数次突击搜查和混乱冲突中幸存了下来。管教们搜得很严，或许是因为夜里的值班确实难熬。
Description.LocalizedString: The scratched-up plastic casing is proof that it has survived countless surprise searches and chaotic brawls. The guards are thorough when they search, perhaps because those night shifts can be so hard to get through.

UseContext.SourceString: 一台随身听，收录了不少流行金曲和经典老歌。有些在押人员或许愿意用珍藏的宝贝来换一个。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A Portable Player loaded with popular hits and classic oldies. Some inmates might be willing to trade their treasured belongings for one.

Description.SourceString: 拥有一台随身听，并不仅仅意味着拥有了一件稀罕货、一种身份的象征。最重要的是，你有了自己的专属BGM——尽管只有你自己能听到。
Description.LocalizedString: Owning a Portable Player isn't just about having a rare treasure or a status symbol. Most importantly, you now have your very own personal BGM… even if you're the only one who can hear it.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：南瓜魔法
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Pumpkin Magic

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「女巫有一片南瓜地，里面有会魔法的干干净净的南瓜，和不会魔法的麻麻赖赖的南瓜。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"A witch had a pumpkin field with squeaky clean magical pumpkins, and scruffy non-magical pumpkins."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：致玛丽
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: To Mary

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「玛丽有只小黑猫，耳朵是母亲的，身体是父亲的，兄弟姐妹是它的四肢，无论玛丽走到哪里，它总是跟着跑。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Mary had a little black cat, with ears from her mother, a body from her father, and siblings as its limbs. Wherever Mary went, it would always follow along."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：反转童话
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Reverse Fairy Tale

Description.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「从前在森林里有一只孤单的小灰狼，为了交到朋友，它带上了丝绒做的红斗篷。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Once upon a time, there was a lonely little gray wolf in the forest who donned a velvet red cape, hoping to make friends."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：华丽飞踢
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Phoenix Kick

Description.SourceString:
一套设计独特的格斗服。娜娜莉为此特地报名了格斗训练班。
「什么时候去上训练课？呃……下次一定！」
Description.LocalizedString:
A fighting outfit with a unique design. Nanally specifically enrolled in a combat training class for this.
"When am I going to attend the training sessions? Uh… Next time for sure!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：学园之星
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: The Popular Kid

Description.SourceString:
学院风格服装，兼顾美观与舒适。袖标由娜娜莉自行制作，本人对此颇为满意。
「咳咳，柯林斯有柯林斯的风纪！」
Description.LocalizedString:
School uniform style clothing that balances both beauty and comfort. The armband was handmade by Nanally herself, and she's quite satisfied with it.
"Ahem, Colucci has its own standards of discipline!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：悠闲假日
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Leisurely Holiday

Description.SourceString:
薄荷的居家服装。简单的服饰，彰显居家的随性与放松。
「休息日，当然要宅在家里睡大觉！」
Description.LocalizedString:
Mint's loungewear. Simple clothing that showcases the carefree and relaxed spirit of being a homebody.
"There's nothing better than staying home and sleeping in on a day off!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：自律时间
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Self-Discipline Time

Description.SourceString:
九原的居家服装。看似简单的衣装，也经由设计师精心设计。
「吸气……呼气……舒展身体，让心情平静……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Jiuyuan's loungewear. Though it looks simple, this outfit was carefully tailored by a designer.
"Breathe in… breathe out… stretch your body, let your mind find peace…"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：绵绵飞虎
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Fluffy Flying Tiger

Description.SourceString:
娜娜莉的居家服装。在简单衣裙的基础上添加了富有巧思的装饰。
「正所谓如虎添翼，老虎和翅膀就是绝配！」
Description.LocalizedString:
Nanally's loungewear. Thoughtful decorations have been added to a simple dress.
"Ever heard of 'adding wings to a tiger'? Tigers and wings are a perfect combo!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：猎人不上班
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Hunter Off Duty

Description.SourceString:
俏皮又不失帅气的着装，层叠的衣衫和亮眼的配饰，尽显随性自由。
「一流的猎人，也该有一流的衣品~」
Description.LocalizedString:
Playful yet stylish attire with layers and eye-catching accessories, showcasing a carefree personality.
"A first-rate hunter should have first-rate fashion sense too!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：城市漫游者
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: City Wanderer

Description.SourceString: 轻便合身、简洁利落，永不出错的穿搭，帮助你轻松融入人群。
Description.LocalizedString: Light and fitted, clean and sharp styling that never goes wrong, helping you blend into crowds with ease.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：「非常规衣着」
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Unconventional Attire

Description.SourceString: 拘留所统一服装，版型合身、面料舒适、颜色亮眼，要是平常也能穿的话……
Description.LocalizedString: Standard detention center uniform with a well-fitted cut, comfortable fabric, and bright colors. If only I could wear it normally…

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：学园随想
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: School Musings

Description.SourceString:
学院风格着装，低调配色辅以经典花纹，彰显精致的优等生气质。
「明天的联谊会，要一起去吗？」
Description.LocalizedString:
Preppy academic attire with understated colors complemented by classic patterns, showcasing the refined aura of an honor student.
"Want to attend tomorrow's mixer together?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：涂鸦进行时
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Graffiti in Progress

Description.SourceString: 充满童趣的背带裤套装，独特的印花图案与不对称设计，个性十足。就算身上溅到颜料，也会被当作印花的一部分。
Description.LocalizedString: A playful overalls set full of childlike charm, featuring unique printed patterns and an asymmetrical design with loads of personality. Even if you get paint splattered on it, it'll just look like part of the print.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：夜色秘辛
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Tales of the Night

Description.SourceString:
法帝娅的居家服装。比起穿着舒适度，她更希望用衣装点缀夜色。
「黑夜会替我们保守秘密。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Fadia's loungewear. Rather than prioritizing comfort, she prefers to use clothing to complement the night.
"The darkness will keep our secrets."

UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Priceless Orchid

Description.SourceString:
以鬼兰花为主题的高级定制套装，这套在影楼非常容易出效果。
不过从价格角度来考虑的话，大概只有在伊波恩开店前、资金还充裕的那时候才有商量余地。
Description.LocalizedString: A custom couture outfit themed after the Ghost Orchid, purchased when Hotori still had plenty of startup funds after opening her shop.As for later… even after selling her car, she never once considered parting with this piece. She must really love it.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：闲满庭
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Recreational Courtyard

Description.SourceString:
浔的居家服装。宽松轻便的打扮，躲闲时还是舒服最重要。
「惊鹿一声响。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Hotori's loungewear. Comfortable and lightweight—when lying around the house, comfort is paramount.
"Soft birdsong in the morning."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：都市浮光
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: City Glimmer

Description.SourceString: 浔自费购入的衣装，用以改善小水仙沉闷的衣柜，达芙蒂尔为此新买了五个不同的眼罩用来搭配它。
Description.LocalizedString: Hotori personally purchased this outfit to brighten up Daff's rather dull wardrobe. In response, Daffodill bought five different eye patches just to match it.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：青竹猗猗
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Emerald Bamboo

Description.SourceString:
粉爪银行某年年会的表演着装，彼时的乔望尼先生正异常沉迷这种黑白色生物。
「我、我们银行是要和胖达火锅联名吗……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Performance outfit from Pink Paws Bank's annual annual gala. At the time, Mr. Giovanni had developed an unusual fascination with a particular black-and-white animal 
"Are we… are we partnering with Panda Hotpot now?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：旧忆挽歌
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Yesterday's Melody

Description.SourceString:
颓废华丽的盛装，适合在出席古堡晚宴时穿着。
「夜空倾覆而下，浸透庭园里的玫瑰。多年之后，她们仍静默地绽放，而故事的后文终究无人知晓。」
Description.LocalizedString:
A decadent, ornate formal dress, perfect for a castle banquet.
"The night sky poured over the garden, soaking its roses in muted darkness. Years later, those flowers still bloom in silence, and the rest of the story has faded into shadow."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：黑白童谣
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Piano Key Sonatina

Description.SourceString:
就像夜与昼一样，这世上黑白分明的东西有很多：浓缩咖啡与拿铁咖啡，奶牛猫与牛奶猫，钢琴的黑键与白键，日常打扮的安魂曲和偶尔换上白裙子出门的安魂曲。
「白裙子，很好看。但是，容易弄脏……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Like night and day, some things in this world are simply black and white: espresso and latte, tuxedo cats and white cats, piano keys, Lacrimosa's everyday outfit, and the white dress she wears only once in a while.
"White dresses are pretty. But… they get dirty so easily."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：千里莺啼
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Nightingale's Crescendo

Description.SourceString: 幸福的降临或许总是毫无章法，宛如一场横冲直撞的「硬着陆」。就像昭示幸福来临的蝙蝠飞入窗棂时，也总伴着清脆的巨响和散落一地的碎玻璃那样。
Description.LocalizedString: Happiness sometimes arrives without rhyme or reason, like a reckless hard landing. Just as the bat that foretells good fortune flies through the window lattice, it always comes with a crisp crash and shattered glass strewn across the floor.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：新月摇篮曲
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: New Moon Lullaby

Description.SourceString:
安魂曲的居家服装。布料柔软舒适，支持随时随地倒头就睡。
「一只蝙蝠……两只蝙蝠……三……呼……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Lacrimosa's loungewear. Made of soft, cozy fabric that lets you fall asleep anytime, anywhere.
"One bat… two bats… three… zzz…"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：鎏金交响诗
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Gilded Rhapsody

Description.SourceString: 闪耀之物往往很沉重。今天上班路上总觉得比往日飞得更累，或许不是安魂曲的错觉。
Description.LocalizedString: Things that shine are often heavy. Lacrimosa feels unusually tired flying to work today. Maybe it isn't just her imagination.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：保持锻炼
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Never Skip

Description.SourceString: 即使是休息日，也不能松懈锻炼！
Description.LocalizedString: Even on days off, training never stops!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：放晴日
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Clear Skies

Description.SourceString: 休闲街头风格着装，简易单品与独特的配饰碰撞，亦能彰显个性。
Description.LocalizedString: A casual streetwear look that pairs simple pieces with bold accessories to express true individuality.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：最佳拍档
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Perfect Partners

Description.SourceString: 极具剪裁设计的赛车服，就像身边伙伴一样，无可替代。
Description.LocalizedString: A sharply tailored racing suit, as irreplaceable as the partner at your side.

Description.SourceString: 这是关于你的故事。
Description.LocalizedString: This is a story about you.

UseContext.SourceString: 「浮游小姐」整日穿梭于异象空间，难免会落下几片珍贵的羽毛。若能拾起这些羽毛交还给她，想必会收到她的谢礼。不过归还时，千万不要过问她掉落这么多羽毛是否会影响毛量……即使是出于关心。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Miss Levi spends her days traveling through the Anomalous Realms, so she's bound to drop a few precious feathers along the way. If you can collect these feathers and return them to her, you'll receive a thank-you gift in return. However, when returning them, whatever you do, don't ask whether losing so many feathers affects her plumage… even if you mean well.

Description.SourceString: 可在异境补给站兑换「浮游小姐的谢礼」
Description.LocalizedString: Can be exchanged for "Miss Levi's Thank-You Gift" at the Otherworld Supply Stop

UseContext.SourceString: 「浮游小姐」整日穿梭于异象空间，难免会落下几片珍贵的羽毛。若能拾起这些羽毛交还给她，想必会收到她的谢礼。不过归还时，千万不要过问她掉落这么多羽毛是否会影响毛量……即使是出于关心。

However, when returning them, whatever you do, don't ask whether losing so many feathers affects her plumage… even if you mean well.

Description.SourceString: 「浔提供了本次纪念日的全部资金，塔吉多负责了所有的采购工作，埃德嘉绘制了最完美的蛋糕制作图并由达芙蒂尔百分百完美复制，早雾和娜娜莉完成了蛋糕上的点缀，而阿德勒制作了蓬松的蛋糕胚，细腻的白奶油，甜蜜的果酱内馅，匀称的蛋糕抹面，以及每一位伊波恩成员的翻糖小人摆件……总得来说，纪念日的准备工作已经全部收尾，现在只差一个吹蜡烛的人。」
Description.LocalizedString: A full team effort went into this anniversary celebration: Hotori funded it, Taygedo did the shopping, Edgar designed the cake, and Daffodill brought it to life. Sakiri and Nanally handled the decorations, while Adler crafted the sponge, cream, jam, frosting, and even tiny fondant figures of every Eborn member.  The preparations are complete… now all that's left is someone to blow out the candles.

UseContext.LocalizedString: A note that mysteriously seems to record real world events…

Description.SourceString:
……这不是██第一次来这里。我很好奇，这座恐怖，阴森，毫无生机的医院，对你来说究竟有怎样的吸引力呢……
……但我很高兴你不止一次踏足这片死地，██，去经历，去见证，去用你的双眼寻找真相，以及真相之真相……
……我知道你会继续寻找下去的，██，因为现在，这同样也是你的噩梦……

——神秘的留言——
……我的结局早已注定……
Description.LocalizedString:
…This isn't the first time you've come here, ██. I'm curious—what kind of pull does this terrifying, eerie, lifeless hospital hold for you…
…Truthfully, I'm glad you've set foot in this dead place more than once, ██. To experience. To witness. To use your own eyes to seek the truth—and the truth behind the truth…
…I know you'll continue your search, ██, because now, reality is also your nightmare…

—Mysterious Note—
…My fate was sealed long ago…
