Description.LocalizedString: What awaits at the next stop?

UseContext.SourceString: 可作为礼物赠送给角色并增加300点好感度，赠送给安魂曲时可增加1200点好感度。（该礼物不受每次赠送次数限制）
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be given to characters as a gift, increasing Affection by 300. Grants 1,200 Affection when given to Lacrimosa. (No gifting limit.)

Description.SourceString: 「番茄百分百」推出的家庭特惠套装，份量极大，或许适合送给对番茄口味情有独钟的人？
Description.LocalizedString: A large-value bundle from Tomato 100. Perfect for tomato lovers, or as a generous gift for anyone who can't get enough tomato flavor.

UseContext.SourceString: 可作为礼物赠送给角色并增加300点好感度，赠送给卡厄斯时可增加1200点好感度。（该礼物不受每次赠送次数限制）
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be given to characters as a gift, increasing Affection by 300. Grants 1,200 Affection when given to Chaos. (No gifting limit.)

Description.SourceString: 精度极高的拼装模型，或许适合送给喜欢条分缕析的家伙？
Description.LocalizedString: A highly detailed assembly model. A perfect gift for those who enjoy taking things apart and analyzing every detail.

UseContext.SourceString: 养成消耗的基础货币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Basic currency for character and item upgrades.

Description.SourceString: 一种弱小到处在食物链底端的生物类异象，形似一只小小的甲壳虫，为求生存会在城市中拟态成硬币外观与碰撞声响等待被人捡起，在流通中寻找更好的生机。
Description.LocalizedString: A Bio Anomaly shaped like a small beetle, which is weak and at the bottom of the food chain. To survive in the city, it transforms into a coin upon the sound of collision, lying in wait to be picked up and thereby stands a better chance of survival through circulation.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：通通加入！
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Top for All

Description.SourceString: 新朋友老朋友，通通都欢迎！
Description.LocalizedString: New friends or old, there’s room for everyone at the top!

Description.SourceString: 击打或摩擦易燃物，会燃起紫色火焰，遇水也无法浇灭。燃烧充分后，火焰自行消散。「给你的伙伴们变个戏法吧！」
Description.LocalizedString: Strike or rub it against something flammable to ignite a purple flame that water can't extinguish. Once it burns out, the flame fades on its own. "Show your friends a little trick!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得贴纸：无序烟尘
UseContext.LocalizedString: Sticker: Chaos Dust

Description.SourceString: 烟雾本就自由散漫，毫无秩序，但也有个词叫「事在人为」。
Description.LocalizedString: Smoke is naturally free-spirited and unruly, with no order to speak of. But hey, where there’s a will, there's a way.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：卡好斯
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Khaos

Description.SourceString: 戴面罩的，也不一定都是坏人嘛。
Description.LocalizedString: Not everyone behind a mask is a bad guy.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：此夜启航
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Night Voyage

Description.SourceString: 穿越风暴之后会见到什么？是故土的港湾，还是未知的新世界？
Description.LocalizedString: What lies beyond the storm: the harbor of home, or an unknown new world?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“新身份”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: New Identity

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D六队队员卡厄斯的名片。
为数不多仅存着的完好的一张名片，与它同时印刷的那些名片其中有一半成为廷达罗斯的玩具，毕竟狗狗的天性就是搞破坏；还有一半随机遗失在城市各处，变成了打进卡厄斯手机里的推销电话。还好异象管理局印发员工名片是免费的。
Description.LocalizedString:
A namecard belonging to Chaos, a member of ETD-6.
One of the few copies still intact. Half of the original batch became Tindalos's toys—dogs are born to destroy things, after all. The other half were scattered across the city and somehow turned into telemarketing calls to Chaos's phone. Good thing Bureau of Anomaly Control employee namecards are free.

UseContext.SourceString: 解锁卡厄斯副驾驶乘坐功能。可以邀请卡厄斯来「小小麻雀」同台竞技。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Chaos's passenger seat feature. Used to invite Chaos to compete in Little Sparrow.

UseContext.SourceString: 解锁卡厄斯基础交互动作，可邀请卡厄斯来家做客。解锁都市偕游事件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Chaos's basic interaction actions. Used to invite Chaos to visit your home. Unlocks the City Hangouts event.

UseContext.SourceString: 解锁卡厄斯特殊交互动作。解锁都市偕游事件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Chaos's special interaction actions. Unlocks the City Hangouts event.

UseContext.SourceString: 解锁卡厄斯特殊都市偕游事件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Chaos's special City Hangouts event.

Description.SourceString: 「泡芙？……番茄酱泡芙，可以。」
Description.LocalizedString: Cream puffs? …Ketchup cream puffs? Sure, why not.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Tea Time

Description.SourceString: 全海特洛市最美味的泡芙！
Description.LocalizedString: The tastiest cream puff in all of Hethereau!

UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: True Strength

Description.SourceString: 真正的强者，是懂得驾驭自身力量的人。
Description.LocalizedString: True strength belongs to those who have mastered their own power.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Storm Calmer

Description.SourceString: 肆虐的狂风，是时候停下了。
Description.LocalizedString: Even the raging gale must come to rest.

UseContext.SourceString: 「浮游小姐」整日穿梭于异象空间，难免会落下几片珍贵的羽毛。若能拾起这些羽毛交还给她，想必会收到她的谢礼。不过归还时，千万不要过问她掉落这么多羽毛是否会影响毛量……即使是出于关心。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Miss Levi spends her days traveling through the Anomalous Realms, so she's bound to drop a few precious feathers along the way. If you can collect these feathers and return them to her, you'll receive a thank-you gift in return. However, when returning them, whatever you do, don't ask whether losing so many feathers affects her plumage… even if you mean well.

Description.SourceString: 可在异境补给站兑换「浮游小姐的谢礼」
Description.LocalizedString: Can be exchanged for "Miss Levi's Thank-You Gift" at the Otherworld Supply Stop

UseContext.LocalizedString: Anomaly Tales quest item: "On the Sea Breeze…"

Description.SourceString: 刀尖断裂，铁锈层层剥落，镶嵌的装饰已被海水蚀出孔洞。刀柄缠着的布条腐蚀发黑，露出下面刻着的歪歪扭扭的小字：「杰瑞讨厌下雨，讨厌黑夜，讨厌火焰。」
Description.LocalizedString: The tip has snapped off, rust flakes from the blade in layers, and the inlaid decorations have been eaten away by seawater. The cloth around the hilt has rotted black, revealing a crooked little inscription carved underneath: "Jerry hates rain, hates night, and hates fire."

ItemName.LocalizedString: Tablecloth: A Fresh Find in Tomatoes

UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to change the tablecloth style.

Description.SourceString: 安魂曲被抓拍到的一张照片。如果天上那个圆圆的东西是番茄的话，想必能做出好多好多番茄酱吧……
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Lacrimosa. If that round-shaped thing up there were a tomato, it could make a lot of Tomato Jelly…

UseContext.SourceString: 「赤龙的眼光-关于乐趣的品味」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: "Red Dragon: Taste in Hobbies" quest item.

Description.LocalizedString: A special mystery box set from "Fleeting—A Gala under the Moonlight" pop-up event. It includes all four standard Asahi Inori dolls, with a chance for each box to play a secret melody when opened.

UseContext.SourceString: 「赤龙的眼光-关于乐趣的品味」任务道具

Description.LocalizedString: A surprise mystery box from "Fleeting—A Gala under the Moonlight" pop-up event. Inside waits one of four Asahi Inori-inspired dolls—and perhaps a newly designed hidden style, tucked away like a playful musical note.

UseContext.SourceString: 「赤龙的眼光-关于乐趣的品味」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: "Red Dragon: Taste in Hobbies" quest item.

Description.LocalizedString: A chibi articulated figure created for the "Fleeting—A Gala under the Moonlight" pop-up event. Its intricate design and expressive parts come together like a bright, lively melody.

Description.SourceString:
「顶级品质的鲜牛奶！就连外星人都会被它的美味所吸引！」\
那一天，金牌售货员对着两眼放光的电波少女如是说道。
Description.LocalizedString:
"Top-of-the-line fresh milk! Even extraterrestrials can't resist its delicious flavor!"
That's what the famed salesperson told the starry-eyed, air-headed girl that day.

UseContext.SourceString: 「同频的心跳-追逐异星的少女」任务道具
UseContext.LocalizedString: "Hearts in Sync: Offworld Girl" quest item

Description.SourceString: 向宇宙的尽头呼唤爱吧，当彗星经过时候，你还会听见最温暖的回声。
Description.LocalizedString: Reach out for love from all ends of the universe. When a comet passes by, may you be greeted with a warm response.

UseContext.SourceString: 与伙伴同行时的友谊见证，增进感情的同时或许也会收到同伴的回礼。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A token of friendship shared while traveling with your companions. Strengthen your bond, and you might even receive a gift in return.

UseContext.SourceString: 普通品质的鱼食，使用后能提升鱼类饱食度。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Standard fish food. Used to fill a fish's Hunger Bar.

Description.SourceString: 看来世界上又多了一个喂鱼放空的人呐。
Description.LocalizedString: Looks like the world has one more person who feeds fish just to zone out.

UseContext.SourceString: 品质极高的鱼食，使用后能提升鱼类饱食度。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Premium fish food. Used to fill a fish's Hunger Bar.

Description.SourceString: 生命的意义在于生命本身。此时此刻鱼存在，鱼缸也充满无限可能。
Description.LocalizedString: Life's meaning is life itself. Here and now, the fish exists—and the tank is full of endless possibility.

UseContext.SourceString: 鱼缸设备，能够自动调节水温，并保持在最适宜的温度。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A fish tank device that automatically adjusts the water temperature, keeping it at the ideal level for its fish.

Description.SourceString: 嘘，温度刚好，鱼儿做梦会回到它出生的那条河流吗？
Description.LocalizedString: Shh… the water rests at the perfect temperature. When fish dream, do they drift back to the river of their birth?

UseContext.SourceString: 用于鱼缸水质管理，能够提升水的ph值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to manage fish tank water quality, raising the water's pH.

Description.SourceString: 放一点点就好，可别弄出苏打喷泉啦！
Description.LocalizedString: Just a tiny drop will do—don't go turning it into a soda fountain!

UseContext.SourceString: 用于鱼缸水质管理，能够降低水的ph值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to manage fish tank water quality, reducing the water's pH.

Description.SourceString: 总觉得鱼缸里下了一场雨，鱼儿的鳞光也跟着亮了起来。
Description.LocalizedString: It feels as though rain has fallen inside the fish tank, leaving the fish's scales shining brighter than before.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Ember Trail

Description.SourceString: 空气里只留下一道正在冷却的、红色的叹息。
Description.LocalizedString: Only a fading red sigh lingers in the air.

Description.SourceString: 你们书写了一个全新的结局。

Description.SourceString: 你们的英雄事迹已经传遍沃伦大陆的每一个角落。吟游诗绵传唱的歌谣、幼小绵绵爱听的的睡前故事里，都有你们的名字。
Description.LocalizedString: Word of your heroics has reached every corner of Warren Continent. Fuzzy Bard sings of you, and Tiny Fuzzy hears your names in every favorite bedtime story.

Description.SourceString: 今天的海特洛市依旧欣欣向荣。
Description.LocalizedString: Hethereau is as lively as ever today.

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」C.S.U二组成员真红的名片。
收容组每天打交道的异象多半不具备辨识文字的知性，工作的危害程度也没高到会像E.T.D那样时常碰上需要向受害市民抱歉地递出名片的窘境——那还有什么场合会用得上这些印发的纸片呢？只是某种猜测，也许管理局内部有人会把它们当做集换式卡牌来收集……
Description.LocalizedString:
Namecard of Shinku, a member of the Bureau of Anomaly Control's CSU-2.
Most Anomalies handled by the Containment Units each day are not exactly known for their reading skills, and the work rarely places them in ETD's awkward position of handing out namecards while apologizing to affected civilians. So when would these little printed slips ever prove useful? One can only guess—but perhaps someone within the Bureau collects them like trading cards…

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」C.S.U二组成员奥涅伊洛伊的名片。
一张照片，还有一个名字。这是她出生时父母所起的名字，在遥远的传说里这似乎也是一位司梦的神明。名字像咒语似的贴在她头上，她的异能是拜此所赐吗？或是那位神明早知道自己要将奇迹加诸她身，于是暗自在她父母起名时，挑起关于这名字的念头？纠结错乱的问题在她脑子里飘来飘去，撞到脑门掉到地上，没有回音，没有答案。
Description.LocalizedString:
Namecard of Oneiroi, a member of the Bureau of Anomaly Control's CSU-2.
A photograph, and a name. It is the name her parents gave her at birth—and in some distant legend, it also seems to belong to a god who rules over dreams. The name clings to her like an incantation. Was her Esper Ability granted because of it? Or had that god already foreseen the miracle that would be bestowed upon her, quietly planting this name in her parents' minds before they chose it? Tangled, disordered questions drift through her thoughts, bump against her forehead, and fall to the floor—without echo, without answer.

Those setting out for the first time must learn such things before all else.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：剑士之姿
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: The Blademaster

Description.SourceString: 风会记住剑士的痕迹。
Description.LocalizedString: The wind shall remember the swordsman's path.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：授勋日
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Glory Days

Description.SourceString: 荣光加冕，长夜有明。
Description.LocalizedString: Crowned in glory, the long night finds its light.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：猎龙者
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Dragonhunter

Description.SourceString: 万千风暴向心口收束，猎龙之人将踏上她的征途。
Description.LocalizedString: Countless storms gather in her heart, and the dragonhunter sets forth on her quest.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：黎明破浪者
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Dawn Patrol

Description.SourceString:
"昭示着好胜心的专业竞赛泳装。海滨似乎总有让人变得坦率的魔力，又或者在水中破开浪潮的畅快感也推了一把。
「在享受夏日这件事上也要全力以赴。」"
Description.LocalizedString:
A pro-grade racing swimsuit that reveals her competitive spirit. The beach has a way of drawing out one's true self—or perhaps that is simply the thrill of cutting through the waves.
"Go all out—even when you’re enjoying summer."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：地海高校生
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Student of Terrasea

Description.SourceString:
让人联想到青春感的学院风穿搭。据说每个人在这段时期都会逃避和追逐阴影中的那个自己……即使没有也会想办法找一个出来。
「不要随便用这种蠢透了的方式来解读……唉，算了。」
Description.LocalizedString:
A neat, preppy outfit with the fresh charm of campus life. They say youth is spent either fleeing from one's inner shadow or chasing after it… and even those without a shadow will find a way to cast one.
"Don't read something that ridiculous into it… Ugh, whatever."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：迷宫屋主
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Labyrinth Lily

Description.SourceString:
真红的居家服装，打定主意要在自己的收藏围绕下不受打扰地度过一阵悠闲时光时的打扮。龙的决心不容挑战。
「……不行。今天已经决定了，无论如何都不出门。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Shinku's loungewear for quiet days spent idling undisturbed among her treasures. Once a dragon has made up her mind, no force can shake her resolve.
"…No. I've already decided. I'm not going out today, no matter what."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：一般过路人
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Normie Heroine

Description.SourceString: 真红低着头，试图在人群中隐去身影一一毕竟，只要没人靠近，就不会有人受伤，对吧?
Description.LocalizedString: Shinku kept her head lowered, trying to vanish into the crowd. After all, if no one came close, then no one would get hurt… right?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：夏日梦
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Summer Dream

Description.SourceString: 躲在花花绿绿的梦境里，注视这个漫长的夏天。
Description.LocalizedString: Hidden within a bright and colorful dreamscape, watching the long summer drift by.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：星月夜
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Starlit Night

Description.SourceString: 月亮坠落了一千次。只有一千次而已吗？
Description.LocalizedString: The moon has fallen a thousand times. Has it truly been only a thousand?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：术法吟唱中
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Channeling...

Description.SourceString: 术法的火花在指尖跳动，而伊洛伊还在构想梦的第一页。
Description.LocalizedString: Arcane sparks dance at her fingertips, while Iroi writes the first page of a dream yet unfinished.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：大魔导师
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Archmage

Description.SourceString: 吟唱未停，梦的边界悄悄延展一寸。
Description.LocalizedString: The chant goes on, and the edge of the dream quietly stretches another inch.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：织梦者
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Dreamweaver

Description.SourceString:
她将群星编入梦境。
一片宇宙的重量，对于睡着的伊洛伊来说刚刚好。
Description.LocalizedString:
She weaves the stars into the dreamscape.
As Iroi sleeps, the weight of a universe rests lightly upon her.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：自由如风
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Wild as the Wind

Description.SourceString: 跑起来的话，自由的气味会比脚步先到哦。
Description.LocalizedString: Run, and the scent of freedom will reach the road before your footsteps.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：林野猎手
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Sylvan Hunter

Description.SourceString: 从第一片落叶开始，到最后一道足迹结束，追猎从未停歇。
Description.LocalizedString: From the first fallen leaf to the final footprint, the hunt never ceases.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：幽火照影
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Aurora Flame

Description.SourceString: 身似幽火，面朝荒野，风的女儿理应无拘无束。
Description.LocalizedString: Like a ghostflame before the wilds, the daughter of the wind was born to roam free and unbound.

UseContext.SourceString: 角色等级经验，用于角色提高等级。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to increase character level.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：为你点亮
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Light It Up

Description.SourceString: 始于玩家，赋予玩家。
Description.LocalizedString: From players, for players.

UseContext.SourceString: 「浮游小姐」整日穿梭于异象空间，难免会落下几片珍贵的羽毛。若能拾起这些羽毛交还给她，想必会收到她的谢礼。不过归还时，千万不要过问她掉落这么多羽毛是否会影响毛量……即使是出于关心。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Miss Levi spends her days traveling through the Anomalous Realms, so she's bound to drop a few precious feathers along the way. If you can collect these feathers and return them to her, you'll receive a thank-you gift in return. However, when returning them, whatever you do, don't ask whether losing so many feathers affects her plumage… even if you mean well.

Description.SourceString: 可在异境补给站兑换「浮游小姐的谢礼」
Description.LocalizedString: Can be exchanged for "Miss Levi's Thank-You Gift" at the Otherworld Supply Stop

UseContext.SourceString: 与伙伴同行时的友谊见证，增进感情的同时或许也会收到同伴的回礼。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A token of friendship shared while traveling with your companions. Strengthen your bond, and you might even receive a gift in return.

UseContext.SourceString: 可作为礼物赠送给角色并增加300点好感度，赠送给残虹时可增加1200点好感度。（该礼物不受每次赠送次数限制）
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be given to characters as a gift, increasing Affection by 300. Grants 1,200 Affection when given to Zankou. (No gifting limit.)

Description.SourceString: 镂空雕刻成花枝的红色发簪，颇有古韵的现代工艺品。或许适合送给钟爱红色花卉、爱好古典装扮的人？
Description.LocalizedString: A red hairpin carved in an openwork floral-branch design—a modern craft with a touch of old-world charm. Perhaps this would be just the thing for someone who adores red flowers and traditional attire?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得贴纸：花刃
UseContext.LocalizedString: Sticker: Petalblade

Description.SourceString: 花开似刃，刃落如花。
Description.LocalizedString: Petals unfurl into blades, striking at those who'd dare to harm its roots.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：全虹
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Zenkou

Description.SourceString: 原来彩虹真的有七种颜色——全虹如此说道。
Description.LocalizedString: After torrential rain and storms, that's when a rainbow shines the brightest.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：绯夜花庭
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Nightbloom Garden

Description.SourceString: 赤霞如幕，花庭似梦。
Description.LocalizedString: Crimson clouds shroud the sky, cloaking the garden in a dreamlike state.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“余烬花名”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Name in the Embers

Description.SourceString:
前秘密组织「红字」成员、现格赫罗斯岛囚犯残虹的名片。
其实「残虹」或者「赤葵」这样的名字并非是她与生俱来的东西。名字总是拥有神奇的力量，有人因它被记住，有人因它获得新生，也有人在某一天彻底失去原本的自己。残败的长虹高悬天边，赤葵的根系铺满记忆，总有些事物早已和那一座座废墟一样，被埋进了花园的最深处。
Description.LocalizedString:
Namecard of Zankou, a former member of Scarlet Letter and now a prisoner on Ghroth Island.
Truthfully, "Zankou" and "Red Nightshade" aren't the names she was given at birth. You know, names have a unique, strange power. They allow people to be forgotten, but also remembered in return. They give others a new life, while simultaneously making others lose theirs. Under the stormy skies, a "Red Nightshade", buried and forgotten, roots through the dirt and mud, awaiting a dazzling rainbow's light.

UseContext.SourceString: 解锁残虹副驾驶乘坐功能。可以邀请残虹来「小小麻雀」同台竞技。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Zankou's passenger seat feature. Used to invite Zankou to compete in Little Sparrow.

UseContext.SourceString: 解锁残虹基础交互动作，可邀请残虹来家做客。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Zankou's basic interaction actions. Used to invite Zankou to visit your home.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Zankou's special interaction actions.

UseContext.SourceString: 解锁残虹特殊都市偕游事件。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Unlocks Zankou's special City Hangouts event.

UseContext.SourceString: 与伙伴同行时的友谊见证，增进感情的同时或许也会收到同伴的回礼。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A token of friendship shared while traveling with your companions. Strengthen your bond, and you might even receive a gift in return.

UseContext.SourceString: 可作为礼物赠送给角色并增加300点好感度，赠送给灵可时可增加1200点好感度。（该礼物不受每次赠送次数限制）
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be given to characters as a gift, increasing Affection by 300. Grants 1,200 Affection when given to Linko. (No gifting limit.)

Description.SourceString: 可爱的小幽灵夜灯，似乎是某灵异电影中反派的Q版形象周边。或许适合送给喜欢灵异题材、或者熟悉幽灵的人？
Description.LocalizedString: An adorable ghost nightlight. It's apparently based on a chibi version of a villain from some supernatural movie. Perhaps it would excite someone who's into the paranormal, or familiar with ghosts?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得贴纸：幽灵频道
UseContext.LocalizedString: Sticker: Ghost Channel

Description.SourceString: 连接成功。今日小贞心情：？？
Description.LocalizedString: Connection successful. Xiaozhen's mood today: ??

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：可灵
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Bingo

Description.SourceString: 「可可抽奖可以去拜托灵可，灵可可灵了！」
Description.LocalizedString: For the prize draw, just ask Linko—Linko's got the lucky touch!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：世界来电
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: World Calling

Description.SourceString: 请稍候，另一端正在接通。
Description.LocalizedString: Please hold on a moment. Connecting you now.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“迷路电波”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Stray Signal

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D六队成员灵可的名片。
灵可常常在想，也许自己从小到大的愿念，现在应该都如同未接收到的电波一样，漂浮在世界上的某个角落。它们绕过高楼、树梢和天线，有时撞上一只路过的小鸟，偶尔又躲进一台旧电视里。如果有一天，你看到了一张照片，听到一个名字，或收到了一条不知道从哪里传来的讯号……说不定只是她迷路了很久的一句「你好」。
Description.LocalizedString:
Namecard of Linko, a member of ETD-6 in the Bureau of Anomaly Control.
Linko often wonders whether her dreams are completely out of her reach, like frequencies playing endlessly, only to never be picked up—slipping past towering high-rises, treetops, and antennas alike. If, one day, you see a photo, hear a name, or catch a signal from somewhere you can't quite place, it might just be her, sending out a long-lost "hello".

Description.SourceString: 皇冠样式的家族火漆印章，可以彰显持有者非同一般的身份。或许适合送给极具家族荣誉感的人？
Description.LocalizedString: A crown-shaped family wax seal that highlights its holder's distinguished status. A seal befitting someone with a strong sense of familial ties and honor.

UseContext.SourceString: 可作为礼物赠送给角色并增加300点好感度，赠送给浔时可增加1200点好感度。（该礼物不受每次赠送次数限制）
UseContext.LocalizedString: Can be given to characters as a gift, increasing Affection by 300. Grants 1,200 Affection when given to Hotori. (No gifting limit.)

Description.SourceString: 铜鎏金制的貔貅小香炉，年份久远，工艺精湛，有招财纳福的寓意。或许适合送给热衷于海淘古董、又十分爱财的人？
Description.LocalizedString: A small antique Pixiu Censer made of gilt copper and crafted with exquisite skill. It symbolizes wealth and good fortune. Perhaps it would suit someone who loves collecting antiques from overseas—and maybe loves money just as much?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得称号：碧波之星
UseContext.LocalizedString: Title: Jade Star

Description.SourceString: 你的愿望是什么？无论是什么我都不一定能帮你实现。嗯，不一定。
Description.LocalizedString: What's your wish? Whatever it is, I may or may not be able to make it come true. Sorry!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得称号：闪耀的碧波
UseContext.LocalizedString: Title: Jade Gleam

Description.SourceString: 再向上走一些，就能见到星星了。
Description.LocalizedString: Climb a little higher, so that you may soar among the stars.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得称号：漂浮水位线
UseContext.LocalizedString: Title: Rising Tide

Description.SourceString: 远远望见冠军的宝座……
Description.LocalizedString: The champion's throne, glimpsed from afar…

UseContext.SourceString: 获得称号：向上的曙光
UseContext.LocalizedString: Title: Rising Dawn

Description.SourceString: 但还差得远呢，继续努力！
Description.LocalizedString: You've still got a long way to go—keep going!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得称号：赛场守门员
UseContext.LocalizedString: Title: Court Keeper

Description.SourceString: 醒醒，你已经在周赛的赛场上了。
Description.LocalizedString: Wakey, wakey! You've got a match to win!

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后提升球员才能
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to increase the player's talent

Description.SourceString: 一片写满了排球技巧的面包，吃下去就能提升才能。小心吃撑。
Description.LocalizedString: A slice of bread packed with… volleyball moves? Eat it to boost your talent. Just… don't eat too much, okay?

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：排球
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Volleyball

Description.SourceString: 一个普通的排球。想必过不了多久，你就会把它换掉。
Description.LocalizedString: A common volleyball. You'll probably replace it before long.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：海特洛日出
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Hethereau Sunrise

Description.SourceString: 海特洛日出的时候，哪座城市日落了？
Description.LocalizedString: The sun rises on one Hethereau, and sets on another.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：香槟薄荷
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Champagne Mint

Description.SourceString: 凉凉的薄荷来帮你驱散热浪！
Description.LocalizedString: Cool mint is here to help you beat the heat!

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：萌虎新星
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Rising Tiger

Description.SourceString: 一击必胜！冲吧，柯林斯！
Description.LocalizedString: One spike, one win! Go, Coluccis!

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：赤龙坚甲
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Red Dragon Shell

Description.SourceString: 球身坚硬，小心碰头。
Description.LocalizedString: The ball is harder than it looks—watch your head!

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：网罗梦境
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Dreamcatcher

Description.SourceString: 要是对手睡着了，我们就赢啦。
Description.LocalizedString: If the other side dozes off, we'll win!

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：花缭乱
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Petalstorm

Description.SourceString: 别被迷惑了双眼。
Description.LocalizedString: Your eyes may deceive you.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：并非忍者
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Not a Ninja

Description.SourceString: 那是星星的图案啊，不是手里剑！
Description.LocalizedString: It's a cute star pattern, not a shuriken!

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得排球：黄金之心
UseContext.LocalizedString: Grants Volleyball: Heart of Gold

Description.SourceString: 这颜色，这光泽！这就是身份的代表、地位的象征！
Description.LocalizedString: This color, this sheen! The very mark of status, the symbol of prestige!

Description.SourceString: 在雾巢某处山谷底部的洞穴内捡到的日志。日志的主人是过去的参赛者，看上去与巨大的歧骸同归于尽。日志上记载着他来参加游戏的原因，以及游戏的部分真相。
Description.LocalizedString: A log found in a cave at the bottom of a valley somewhere in Fogden. Its owner was seemingly a former contestant who appears to have died alongside a massive Oddity. The log itself records why the contestant entered and also reveals the truth behind its existence.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：月下闲庭
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Moonlit Courtyard

Description.SourceString:
残虹的居家服装。宽松的浴袍搭配木屐，适合做一场无人打扰的长梦。
「夜色漫长啊，今夜又会发生什么呢？」
Description.LocalizedString:
Zankou's loungewear. A loose robe and wooden clogs, perfect for drifting into a long, uninterrupted dream.
"The night's still young… I wonder what it has in store."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：夜幕裁梦
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Twilight Noir

Description.SourceString: 光影流转，暗流涌动。黑夜吞没现实的时候，或许夜半的美梦已经被悄然改写。
Description.LocalizedString: Light shifts, and something stirs beneath the surface. When night overtakes reality, even the sweetest dreams may be quietly rewritten.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：秋色闲章
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Autumn Vignette

Description.SourceString: 残虹研习现代时尚后为自己定制的私服。比起平日里的打扮，这套行装更方便她融入城市的人群，但至于其是否时尚，仍有待商榷。
Description.LocalizedString: Zankou's custom casualwear, created after studying modern fashion. It helps her blend into the city crowd, though whether it actually looks fashionable is still up for debate.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：堇色流火
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Searing Lavender

Description.SourceString: 当缭乱的花火在眼前交织，有时难免令人惶惑，眼前的景致究竟是真实，还是一场不愿醒来的幻梦。
Description.LocalizedString: As fireworks bloom across the sky, the dazzling display can make reality feel like a dream. Is this moment real, or a beautiful illusion you never want to wake from?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：待机状态
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Couch Potato

Description.SourceString:
灵可的居家服装。简单宽松的版型，让每一次伸懒腰都毫无负担。
「如果灵感来敲门，当然要穿得方便一点去开门。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Linko's loungewear. The loose, comfy fit gives her plenty of room to stretch.
"When inspiration comes knocking, you have to be ready to answer."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：星间漫游
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Surfing Among Stars

Description.SourceString:
灵可的奇思妙想总是没有边界，自从淘到这套时装之后，她就总在想自己有没有可能能接收到世界以外的电波。
她的背包里装着一座小小花园，也装着继续前行的勇气。植物会长大，旅途也是。
Description.LocalizedString:
Linko's imagination knows no limits. Ever since she found this outfit, she's wondered whether she can tune in to signals from beyond this world.
Her backpack holds a tiny garden and the courage to keep going. Plants grow, and so does the journey.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：暮春物语
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Faded Spring

Description.SourceString:
灵可的校园风时装。精致的制服、轻快的步伐，还有永远不会按计划进行的路线。
「绕一点远路，说不定就会多一点惊喜哦。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Linko's school-inspired outfit. A crisp uniform, a spring in her step, and a route that never quite goes as planned.
"Take the scenic route. You might find a surprise or two."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：新航线
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Chartered Waves

Description.SourceString: 于海浪间穿梭的黑色身影，或许也能找到独属于他的新航线，至于航线的终点会是什么……管他呢。
Description.LocalizedString: A dark figure races across the waves, carving out a route of his own. Where does it lead? Eh, he'll figure it out.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：海盐金平糖
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Saltwater Taffy

Description.SourceString: 亮闪闪的玻璃糖纸会被阳光照出彩虹的颜色，而这一颗，是薄荷口味。
Description.LocalizedString: A shiny candy wrapper catches the sunlight and shimmers with every color of the rainbow. This one's mint.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：灿阳逐浪
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Sunny Surf

Description.SourceString: 柯林斯家族的领地已经扩张到了海洋板块，娜娜莉船长已经准备就绪！出发，为了家族！
Description.LocalizedString: The Coluccis are expanding into open waters, and Captain Nanally is ready to set sail! All aboard, for the family!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：「赤葵」
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Red Nightshade

Description.SourceString: 残虹效命于「红字」时的行装。在处理麻烦的任务时，她偏爱更张扬夺目的装扮，毕竟吸引注意本身就是狩猎的一环。
Description.LocalizedString: Zankou's attire from her days with The Scarlet Letter. When a job gets messy, she prefers something bold enough to turn every head. After all, getting noticed is part of the hunt.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：夏日澄空
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Cloudless Summer

Description.SourceString: 当纸飞机乘着海风飞向大海的另一头，这个夏天会留下什么？
Description.LocalizedString: A paper plane rides the sea breeze toward distant shores. What will this summer leave behind?

UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Endless Summer

Description.SourceString: 向着海边，出发！
Description.LocalizedString: Off to the beach!

UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Imaginist Court

Description.SourceString: 理想馆排球场的照片。盛夏海边的沙滩排球？醒醒吧，当然是在有空调的室内场地打球更舒服了！
Description.LocalizedString: A photo of the volleyball court at Imaginist Arena. Beach volleyball by the seaside in midsummer? Dream on. An air-conditioned indoor court is obviously way comfier!

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后获得头像框：闪耀今夏
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Summer Glow

Description.SourceString: 独属于这个夏天的纪念。
Description.LocalizedString: A memento of a summer like no other.

UseContext.SourceString: 可在「即刻落槌」玩法中使用获得拍卖品。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used in Going, Going, Gone! to obtain Auction Items.

Description.SourceString: 珍珠置于骨碟之上，黄金在高脚杯中流淌。
Description.LocalizedString: Pearls gleam upon plates of bone, and gold runs bright within the goblets.

UseContext.SourceString: 即刻落槌赛季任务奖励
UseContext.LocalizedString: Going, Going, Gone! Season Quest Reward

Description.SourceString: 是海贝还是珍珠？要落槌之后才知道。
Description.LocalizedString: Is it a seashell or a pearl? You won't know until the gavel falls.

UseContext.SourceString: 即刻落槌赛季任务奖励
UseContext.LocalizedString: Going, Going, Gone! Season Quest Reward

Description.SourceString: 运气与眼力缺一不可。
Description.LocalizedString: Luck and a keen eye, hand in hand.

UseContext.SourceString: 即刻落槌赛季排名奖励
UseContext.LocalizedString: Going, Going, Gone! Season Ranking Reward

Description.SourceString: 槌落时，「宝船」亦是您的收藏品。
Description.LocalizedString: Once the gavel falls, the Treasure Ship will be yours to command, Captain.

Description.SourceString:
「魔女之家」主人黑羽的名片。
无论黑羽怎样尝试，知无不言的水晶球总是在她问起自己的命运时沉默。每到这时她会看着水晶球里旋起的迷雾发呆，想象着自己生于何处，长于何处，葬于何处。想着想着她便沉沉睡去，不知道自己将做一个奇特的梦，梦里她作为一只乌羽的鸟儿飞过人们头顶，数百年的光阴跟在身后，于是她将歌声遍洒大地，无休止地飞过一季又一季春秋。
Description.LocalizedString:
The namecard of Blackbird, proprietor of The Witch's House.
No matter how hard Blackbird tries, the crystal ball—so willing to reveal everything—always falls silent when she asks about her own fate. On each attempt, she stares at the mist swirling inside the ball, lost in thought, imagining where she was born, where she grew up, and where she'll be laid to rest. As her mind wanders, she drifts into a deep slumber, unaware that a peculiar dream is awaiting her: she's a bird with black feathers, soaring over people's heads, with centuries trailing behind her, as though scattering her song across the earth as she flies on endlessly through the many cycles of the world's seasons.

Description.SourceString: 可供收藏留念，可观的收藏数量将被「伯爵先生」认为是同好收藏家，或可大幅提升最终游玩结算分数。
Description.LocalizedString: Collectible mementos. A large collection that will earn you recognition from The Count as a fellow collector, and may greatly boost your final score.

UseContext.SourceString: 可于趣奇诡乐屋中寻获，似乎意在吸引更多游客前来。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Found in Spooky Cookies—it seems intended to attract more visitors.

Description.SourceString: 可供收藏留念，可观的收藏数量将被趣奇诡乐屋认为是资深游客，或可提升最终游玩结算分数。
Description.LocalizedString: Collectible mementos. A sizable collection will mark you as a seasoned Spooky Cookies visitor and may boost your final score.

UseContext.SourceString: 于趣奇诡乐屋中使用，可降低自身惊吓值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in Spooky Cookies to reduce your Fright.

Description.SourceString: 喷洒后可减少惊吓，驱散恐惧，回复心中理智。
Description.LocalizedString: Spraying this item reduces Fright, dispels fear, and restores your peace of mind.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后变身为曲曲仔。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to transform into Cookie Coo.

Description.SourceString: 曲曲仔，头戴蓝白条纹派对帽、顶着红鼻头的快乐曲奇饼，是派对上永远最嗨的那一个。
Description.LocalizedString: Cookie Coo, the cheerful cookie who's the life of the party! With a blue-and-white striped party hat and a bright red nose, this cookie will always be popular.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后变身为棒棒仔。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to transform into Snappy Snap.

Description.SourceString: 棒棒仔，戴着黑色圆顶礼帽、留着白色八字胡的长条夹心饼干棒，绅士派头十足，夹心的口味是它的秘密。
Description.LocalizedString: Snappy Snap—a long, mysteriously-filled biscuit sporting a black top hat and a white handlebar mustache. This biscuit is loaded with gentlemanly swagger, though its filling remains a secret.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后变身为酥酥仔。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to transform into Flaky Flake.

Description.SourceString: 酥酥仔，系着粉色发带、穿着黄皮鞋的心形蝴蝶酥，轻轻一碰就咔嚓作响，酥脆掉渣又可口的小甜心。
Description.LocalizedString: Flaky Flake, the heart-shaped palmier with a pink ribbon and yellow shoes. It gives a crisp little crackle at the slightest touch—a crispy, crumbly, delicious little sweetheart.

UseContext.SourceString: 使用后变身为松松仔。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to transform into Waffly Waff.

Description.SourceString: 松松仔，顶上坐着黄油块、身上淌着糖浆的方块华夫饼，软糯Q弹，香气四溢的小甜饼。
Description.LocalizedString: Waffly Waff, a square waffle topped with a slab of butter and drizzled with syrup—soft, chewy, and delightfully sweet.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：噗卡奇遇
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Puka Adventure

Description.SourceString: 在噗卡乐园迈出属于你自己的冒险之旅！
Description.LocalizedString: Set out on your own Pukaland adventure!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：噗仔
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Pukaboo

Description.SourceString: 噗卡乐园欢迎你的到来！
Description.LocalizedString: Pukaland welcomes you!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：游园记
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Pukaland Journal

Description.SourceString: 让生活噗卡一下！
Description.LocalizedString: Add a little Puka to your life!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：温馨港湾
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Cozy Haven

Description.SourceString: 一杯热可可开启一天元气满满！
Description.LocalizedString: Nothing kick-starts the day quite like a cup of hot cocoa—and maybe a second one for good measure.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：咫尺之间
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Like Clockwork

Description.SourceString: 故事，未完待续。
Description.LocalizedString: The story continues…

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：笑笑
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: All Smiles

Description.SourceString: 據說戴上它的玩家，嘴角都會不自覺上揚。
Description.LocalizedString: They say anyone who wears it can't help but smile.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：环环相扣
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Linked Up

Description.SourceString: 海特洛没有夜晚。
Description.LocalizedString: Night never falls in Hethereau.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：超级玩家
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Power Player

Description.SourceString: 乐趣无极限！
Description.LocalizedString: Fun Without Limits!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：「魔女」的祝福
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Witch's Blessing

Description.SourceString: 请收下吧，来自「魔女」的祝福。
Description.LocalizedString: Please accept the Witch's Blessing.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：終極盛合
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Ultimate Platter

Description.SourceString: 小朋友才做選擇，我全都要！將所有美味與好運一次打包！
Description.LocalizedString: Why choose when you can have it all? All the flavor, all the luck—wrapped up in one perfect package!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：采购日
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Shopping Spree

Description.SourceString:
「我看看清单……船员娜娜莉继续前进！」
「是！薄荷船长！」
Description.LocalizedString:
"Let's see who's on the list... Crew Member Nanally, onward!"
"Aye, Captain Mint!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得手机壁纸：金币雨
UseContext.LocalizedString: Phone Wallpaper: Making It Rain

Description.SourceString: 挥金如雨便是财富的象征。
Description.LocalizedString: Nothing says wealth like making it rain.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得称号：噗卡大亨
UseContext.LocalizedString: Title: Puka Tycoon

Description.SourceString: 原则一：永远不要亏钱。原则二：永远不要忘记原则一。
Description.LocalizedString: Rule No. 1: Never lose money. Rule No. 2: Never forget Rule No. 1.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：激励金已到账
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Cha-Ching!

Description.SourceString: 感谢您的劳作与付出，这是应得的报酬。
Description.LocalizedString: Thanks for all your hard work. You've earned this.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：方斯传奇
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Fons Legend

Description.SourceString: 海特洛里真的有活着的传奇。
Description.LocalizedString: So there really are living legends in Hethereau.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得手机壁纸：噗卡拾光
UseContext.LocalizedString: Phone Wallpaper: Puka Moments

Description.SourceString: 噗卡乐园全天在线，快乐时光随时响应！
Description.LocalizedString: Pukaland is open 24/7—because fun doesn't keep office hours!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得手机壳：奇妙一刻
UseContext.LocalizedString: Phone Case: Pocket Wonder

Description.SourceString: 乐园在手，奇遇我有。
Description.LocalizedString: Pukaland in hand, adventure on demand!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：青春注脚
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Classroom Hijinks

Description.SourceString:
学习和兴趣完全可以兼得的嘛！
「这位是特工Z世代的『源』！虽然在三姐妹中年纪最小，但也是很可靠特工！特别是在第178话……」
Description.LocalizedString:
Studies and hobbies can totally go hand in hand!
"This is Orion from Gen Z! She may be the youngest of the three sisters, but she's still one seriously dependable agent! Especially in Episode 178, when she..."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：摸鱼大师
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Master Slacker

Description.SourceString: 大隐隐于市。柔软简洁，随处可见的服饰最适合混入各种生活区。嘘，低调点——咱们在带薪摸鱼呢。
Description.LocalizedString: The best disguise is looking like you belong. Soft, simple, and easy to overlook—perfect for slipping into just about any neighborhood. Shh, keep your voice down. We're technically supposed to be working.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：小熊曲奇
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Gingerbear Biscuit

Description.SourceString: 虽说早雾总嚷着「太小孩子气」，但谁会不喜欢香甜松软的小熊曲奇呢？
Description.LocalizedString: Sakiri may insist they're "way too childish," but really—who could say no to a sweet, fluffy Gingerbear Biscuit?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：牧星者
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Wandering Stars

Description.SourceString:
每一个占卜之人都渴望解明万物的隐喻，命运于她而言，恰似天幕中不歇流转的繁星。
「于穹顶万千星座中，我窥见你与我辉映的命运。」
Description.LocalizedString:
Those who read the stars spend their lives searching for meaning in every sign. To her, destiny is written in the endless dance of the heavens.
"Among all the stars above, I saw yours and mine bound to the same fate."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：红与黑
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Rouge et Noir

Description.SourceString: 黑羽诸多收藏中的一件套装。不同于往日风格，夺目的红怒放在复古的衣装上，张扬而动人。看来除了古董，黑羽在着装方面也有着相当挑剔的品味。
Description.LocalizedString: One of the many outfits in Blackbird's collection. It's a bolder look than usual, with vivid crimson set against vintage tailoring—flashy, elegant, and hard to miss. Turns out Blackbird is every bit as discerning about clothes as she is about antiques.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：不凋羽
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Unfazed Denim

Description.SourceString: 黑羽的居家服装。无事的时候，黑羽会对原本平平无奇的衣物做一些颇具个人风格的改造，而这套至今仍是她最爱的休闲穿着。
Description.LocalizedString: Blackbird's favorite loungewear. When she has time to kill, she likes taking perfectly ordinary clothes and giving them a distinctly Blackbird makeover. This set, somehow, has yet to be dethroned.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：茜色丝绒
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Cozy Velvet

Description.SourceString: 只有在重要节日才会穿出来的服饰。「一年也穿不了几次，就不必考虑什么节能穿搭了吧？」
Description.LocalizedString: An outfit saved for special occasions. "I only wear it a few times a year. Surely I can let the whole energy-saving thing slide, right?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：吧台特调
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: House Special

Description.SourceString: 「问问题可以，先点杯饮料。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Ask away—but order a drink first."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：舞台之星
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Shining Idol

Description.SourceString: 全身心投入的飒爽英姿，成为舞台上最闪耀的星星。
Description.LocalizedString: Give it everything you've got, own the stage, and be the star everyone remembers.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：全金属摇滚
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Full Metal Rock

Description.SourceString: 每个少女都有不为人知的狂野一面。当年在学校收取「保护费」的事情，或许不是传闻？——「那只是在学校开演唱会的票钱！」
Description.LocalizedString: Every girl has a wild side she doesn't advertise. So maybe those old rumors about her running a protection racket at school weren't entirely made up. "Those were concert tickets! I was putting on a show!"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：节能生活
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Off the Clock

Description.SourceString: 「非必要的事情不做，必要的事情一律从简。」
Description.LocalizedString: "If it's not worth doing, don't bother. If it is, do the bare minimum."

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：微风精灵
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Windflower

Description.SourceString:
去朋友家串门时穿的，清爽而舒适的休闲装扮。
戴上眼镜时整体印象会迷幻般地变调，感觉要开始讲课……或者是讲述一段新的、人与人的故事了。
Description.LocalizedString:
A fresh, comfortable casual outfit for dropping by a friend's place.
Add the glasses, and there's something almost dreamlike about the look—as though they're about to give a lecture… or tell another story about how people connect.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：千年虫之谜
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Y2K Mystique

Description.SourceString:
*使用并进入当前编队后，会改变界面表现。

一度流行过的复古未来时尚风潮。镭射！荧光！像素！怀旧科技制品！
「真好啊~人们以乐天的态度和欢悦的心情，『想象』着技术发展的绚丽未来——」
Description.LocalizedString:
*Changes the interface appearance when this outfit is equipped and its wearer is in your current lineup.

A throwback to a once-popular retro-futurist fashion trend. Holographic finishes! Fluorescent colors! Pixels! Retro tech!
"How wonderful! People once 'imagined' a dazzling, high-tech future with such hope and excitement—"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：花海追想
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Drifting Petals

Description.SourceString:
仿佛是在妖精居住的梦幻岛上会有的学园制服，一抹美妙的童话色彩。
「冬去春来，是时候和你最好的朋友结个伴，去踏青郊游如何~？」
Description.LocalizedString:
A school uniform straight out of Neverland, where fairies live—a little touch of storybook magic.
"Winter's over, and spring is here! Why not head out and enjoy it with your best friend?"

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：X%
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: X%

Description.SourceString:
对于极少放假的工作狂来说，这是极低概率才会出现的穿着。
为什么会有人在不用上班的休息时间……反而看起来心情更差的样子？
Description.LocalizedString:
A rare sight: a workaholic finally taking a day off.
So why do they look even more miserable when they don't have to work…?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：蓝雪
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Blue Snow

Description.SourceString:
秋冬季在室外需要多披上一件风衣，莫名很适合搭配一杯热咖啡的印象。
那条围巾轻盈而柔软地缠绕住脖颈，不可思议的是比看起来更加保暖。
Description.LocalizedString:
In fall and winter, a trench coat is the perfect extra layer for heading outdoors. Somehow, it just seems to go with a hot cup of coffee.
The scarf feels soft and light around your neck, yet keeps you surprisingly warm.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像：不逝于雨
UseContext.LocalizedString: Avatar: Untouched by Rain

Description.SourceString:
特别的户外防水服饰，可能会导致被判定为雨夜的杀人鬼或死神一类的角色。
——洗刷不去的颜色所代表的是，绝不容许消逝的一切瞬间。
Description.LocalizedString:
An eye-catching waterproof outfit that could get you mistaken for a killer on a rainy night—or even the Grim Reaper.
—Colors that won't wash away, for moments we refuse to let fade.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“电掣油驰”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Roar Recharged

Description.SourceString: 电与油的混合轰鸣，携带传承的精神续作。
Description.LocalizedString: Electric power meets the roar of the engine—a worthy successor carrying its legacy forward.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得头像框：问道
UseContext.LocalizedString: Frame: Wayfinder

Description.SourceString: 跻身洪流中，何须渡旁津。
Description.LocalizedString: Once you're part of the current, why seek another crossing?

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：康庄大道
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: The Open Road

Description.SourceString: 所行之道皆为我之道。
Description.LocalizedString: Every path I take is my own.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片“地平线幽灵”
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Horizon Spectre

Description.SourceString: 尾灯残影后，在地平线的尽头，疾驰着若隐若现的幽灵。
Description.LocalizedString: Beyond the fading trail of taillights, a ghostly silhouette races along the edge of the horizon.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得手机壳：无可替代
UseContext.LocalizedString: Phone Case: No Substitute

Description.SourceString: There is no substitute.
Description.LocalizedString: There is no substitute.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：明日之星
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Tomorrow's Star

Description.SourceString: 此刻，站在聚光灯的中心，光环为你加冕。
Description.LocalizedString: Standing in the center of the spotlight, a halo crowns you.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：舞台中心
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Position Zero

Description.SourceString: 今夜的灯多亮了一个像素点。
Description.LocalizedString: Tonight, the lights shine one pixel brighter.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：晦夜
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Moonless Night

Description.SourceString: 夜色沉沉如水。
Description.LocalizedString: Night, murky and still as water.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：头等奖
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Grand Prize

Description.SourceString: 欢迎光临「午夜」猫……人……猫……报刊亭！
Description.LocalizedString: Welcome to "The Midnight" Cat… Er, human… N-no, cat… newsstand!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：大智慧
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Big Brains

Description.SourceString: 这也是计划的一环。
Description.LocalizedString: All a part of the plan.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：夜色斑斓
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Neon Nights

Description.SourceString: 月亮是最闪耀的灯球。
Description.LocalizedString: The moon: the brightest disco ball of all.

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：鸫鸫鸫
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Knockingbird

Description.SourceString: 乌鸫抓到了超级大的谕石！
Description.LocalizedString: Blackbird just snagged a huge Oracle Stone!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：小小的朋友
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Tiny Friend

Description.SourceString: 一个人出门太寂寞了，带上这个吧！
Description.LocalizedString: Going out on your own sounds lonely. Take this with you!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得配饰：射手之眼
UseContext.LocalizedString: Accessory: Eagle Eye

Description.SourceString: 某个电子游戏中提高命中率的酷炫装备。
Description.LocalizedString: A cool piece of gear from some video game that boosts accuracy.

UseContext.SourceString: 在「炭团的宝藏」玩法内售货机中购买道具。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Used to purchase items from vending machines in Coal Lump's Treasure.

Description.SourceString: 「炭团的宝藏」玩法道具
Description.LocalizedString: Coal Lump's Treasure Item

UseContext.SourceString: 获得称号：花糖礼赠
UseContext.LocalizedString: Title: Sweet Benefactor

Description.SourceString: 谢谢，谢谢你，炭团的朋友！
Description.LocalizedString: Thank you… thank you for being Coal Lump's friend!

UseContext.SourceString: 获得称号：最强大的朋友
UseContext.LocalizedString: Title: Bestie Supreme

Description.SourceString: 强大，强大的朋友，礼物，送给你！
Description.LocalizedString: Such a strong friend… This is for you!

UseContext.SourceString: 全队角色回复25%的最大生命值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Restores all allies' HP by 25% of their Max HP.

Description.LocalizedString: Coal Lump's Treasure Item

UseContext.SourceString: 全队伤害提升30%，持续10秒。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Increases all allies' DMG by 30% for 10s.

Description.LocalizedString: Coal Lump's Treasure Item

UseContext.SourceString: 立刻充满前台角色的极轨终结能量，并刷新极轨终结的冷却时间。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Immediately restores the active character's Ultimate Energy to full and resets their Ultimate's cooldown.

Description.SourceString: 「炭团的宝藏」玩法道具
Description.LocalizedString: Coal Lump's Treasure Item

UseContext.SourceString: 全队移动速度提升30%，持续25秒。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Increases all allies' Movement Speed by 30% for 25s.

Description.SourceString: 「炭团的宝藏」玩法道具
Description.LocalizedString: Coal Lump's Treasure Item

UseContext.SourceString: 角色身边生成棉棉，棉棉具有一定的生命值，并且会吸引附近怪物的仇恨。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons Fluffs next to the character. Fluffs have their own HP and draw aggro from nearby enemies.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: User X

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D六队队长Exe的名片。
虽说是名片，但上头所写的名字只有他的「网名」，下头有小小一行关于读音是字母「X」的备注。不知是不愿提供有关自己的真实信息，还是他素来只习惯被用那个代号来称呼。或许这个名字有寄托着什么别的含义，除了免不了让人联想到的电脑文件扩展名这一点之外……
Description.LocalizedString:
A Namecard for Exe, captain of the Bureau's ETD-6.
The only name printed on it is his "online handle," with a small note underneath explaining that it's pronounced like the letter "X." Is he keeping his real identity under wraps, or is he just used to going by that alias? Maybe there's more to the name than its obvious connection to the .exe file extension…

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D六队副队长曳尔沐的名片。
作为E.T.D六队中承担了对外交流沟通事务的人员，这张名片将会很频繁地被送到社会上各行各业人们的手中。因此采用了干净漂亮的设计款式版本，印刷了相当多的张数。不可思议的是，如果仔细盯着上面的信息看的话，会觉得名字和照片的部分都有些模糊，但标注的电话号码那一栏异常清晰……
Description.LocalizedString:
A Namecard for Elyms, a lieutenant in the Bureau's ETD-6.
As ETD-6's communications officer, Elyms deals with people from all walks of life, so the card has a clean, attractive design and was printed in large quantities. Oddly, the name and photo look a little blurry, but the phone number is crystal clear…

UseContext.SourceString: 获得名片：穿越网线
UseContext.LocalizedString: Namecard: Across the Web

Description.SourceString: Exe被抓拍到的一张照片。他那只能替他处理一切事情的「手」……？看起来完全有可能在你网上冲浪的时候，突然绕出来浮现在背后，戳戳你的肩膀……
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Exe. That "hand" of his can apparently handle just about anything for him… It might even pop up behind you and tap you on the shoulder while you're browsing the web.
